### **Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland**
![Image 542: An aerial view of a city near a body of water, with a large red and white striped tent in the foreground](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/05/21/237301566/11728890ad1e0bd0d78523b94463915b_5596614257075705006.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

After the inventor Lepine-Pauline, with the support of the journalist Charlotte, the Traveler, and Paimon, modified the Kamera Lens for Image Recognition Sample Collection and turned it into a high-precision zoom photography assistant, it became popular in the film industry of Fontaine. After the new-generation product hit the market right as the Kamera lens was evolving, many directors and merchants began to cooperate with Lepine-Pauline, and she became a rising supplier in the film industry. People trusted her devices, so she was chosen to help build Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, an amusement park based on the films, located on the banks of Fontaine. 

![Image 543: The stylized blue bear is featured on a badge, with a gold banner displaying blue and gold triangles at the bottom](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/05/21/237301566/92bed48472da6cd84514b79ba05f11c9_3169450854699397023.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The main symbol of the park was Surintendante Chevalmarin, whose official guardian is Lady Furina. She won second place in the last "Most Popular Character" poll for the comic film category, and was even dubbed "the pinnacle of round, bouncy cuteness." Many people have expressed interest in designing cushions based on her image, and Furina will receive sixty percent of the sales revenue to make better meals for Chevalmarin. Furina herself did not perform in Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland because she was aware of the scale of her roles. When she takes center stage, all attention is on her, but as a guest, she has to step back and let others shine. So, instead of performing herself, Furina decided to help from behind the scenes and became a consultant for one of the attractions.

![Image 544: Sara from Genshin Impact is selling stuff at her shop named Good Hunter on a sunny day](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/05/21/237301566/1769e2d133378587b491a3f822e9f374_3221948225875671699.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland was created by enthusiasts, and Spina di Rosula was invited to be responsible for planning, construction, and operation. In just one day, an amusement park was created on the empty beach near the Marcotte Station. To attract visitors, the head of Spina di Rosula, Navia, called her friend and chef, Escoffier, to cook for the visitors and the park's workers. For her dishes, Escoffier ordered the best vegetables and fruits from Natlan, which were delivered by Ororon and Varesa. After the opening of the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, Varesa stayed and opened a stall with products from her garden to advertise her brand. 

![Image 545: Dehya stands in an open-air store with weapons and decor items](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/05/21/237301566/7a0ea954c4d83603c3f13b4ea6db5d44_291863966133473902.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Blazing Beasts — mercenaries from Sumeru — were invited to the park as special guests. Some time ago, the Flame-Mane, Dehya, and several other members of the Eremites were invited to star in an adventure film in Fontaine. The film received good reviews, so once the director found out about the amusement park, they were invited as guests. During the filming of the film, Dehya got too carried away by one of the fight scenes and accidentally destroyed half the set, after which she was kicked out. And the mercenary who played one of the main villains was supposed to perform a spectacular dance with a sword in front of the main character, but the main actor was so hungry and in a hurry to finish the scene that he improvised and pretended to shoot him with a gun. After thinking about it, the director decided to leave this scene and, to everyone's surprise, the audience liked it.

![Image 546: A young woman with cat ears stands on a stone platform in a futuristic seaside setting](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/05/21/237301566/c848bf916e0a222af38abc76b5ff7534_5913601133956639369.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In total, the park opened three main attractions: Eclectic Escapades, Movie Masterpieces, and Mellow Manor. Since the enthusiasts who organized the park are not full-fledged experts, but usually design event booths, special guides were developed, and consultants were invited for each attraction. Furina became a consultant for "Movie Masterpieces," in which visitors had to recreate classic scenes from famous films and play the role of legendary characters in order to overcome all the difficulties and achieve the goal. The second attraction was the "Eclectic Escapades," which incorporated popular techniques from action films, where the hero must quickly make their way through narrow alleys while being chased from all sides. The consultant for the attraction was the magician's assistant, Lynette, who enjoyed watching people's faces when they fell. The third attraction was the "Mellow Manor," inspired by light-hearted and humorous films. Various animals were placed on the territory of the attraction, including trained Fungi, large squirrels, and finches raised on special food, Blubberbeasts, alpacas, and others. 

![Image 547: Furina looks over the sea filled with lamas, docks, market and mountains in the background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/05/21/237301566/bfa5bac3fafd118b3805844fe77a1709_8540944012192505581.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The work on the Mellow Manor was joined by the nurse of the Fortress of Meropide Sigewinne, the magician Lyney, and a special Blubberbeast that the Traveler and Paimon once saved from traffickers in Natlan and returned to Fontaine. Sigewinne wanted to visit the amusement park after hearing Navia's stories, and since there was little work in the Fortress, she agreed to become a consultant. Recently, the prison allowed inmates to spend their Credit Coupons on watching movies for good behavior, and Sigewinne was in charge of the projector in her free time, so she watched many different cartoons about animals. Unlike Sigewinne and Lynette, Lyney prefers to watch psychological horror films instead of cartoons. Before the park opened, he decided to watch all the films of a director specializing in this genre, so it took him a few days to recover from watching them. When he finally gathered his strength and went to the amusement park, he liked the attraction with animals, and even wanted to use some of them for his new tricks.

![Image 548: Bustling harbor town in the style of the game Genshin Impact is awash in orange light at sunset, featuring piers, boats, and trees along the coastline](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/05/21/237301566/403abe74f03797510874d1a2b932a1af_3152989965481882773.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In gratitude for their help in organizing the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, Lepine-Pauline gave the Traveler a special bow. Many years ago, a group of weapons researchers from the Fontaine Research Institute created this prototype to push the limits of long-range bow performance, and Lepine-Pauline's team was to design a sight for it. But then, both the Maison Gardiennage and the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol adopted muskets as their standard issue, and stopped ordering bows in bulk since they require so much training to master. The research group and the team were disbanded, and the prototype remained with Lepine-Pauline, unused, until it was used as a prop in a science fiction film about "Mechanically Enhanced Warriors." The invisible protagonist, "The Prophet," used it to silently take down all sorts of enemies. The bow became popular among fans of fantasy films, so Lepine-Pauline brought it to the amusement park to demonstrate it, and decided to give it to the Traveler, the heart and soul of the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, the one who united all the legendary characters. After learning of the bow's original purpose, fans hoped that it would fall into the hands of a true master who could reveal its full potential, and Lepine-Pauline would like the Traveler and their friends to continue the bow's story beyond the screen.

**Fountain of Lucine**
----------------------
![Image 575: Fountain of Lucine with towering fountain jets stands tall in front of a blue and purple night sky](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/0869fb9f8dca7349e0f03067eb378aba_4492399590553116315.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Fountain of Lucine is the place where all the water flowing through Fontaine converges, so people like to make wishes here. The origin of throwing coins into the fountain comes from tossing Hydro Sigils into the Fountain of Lucine, which is, in fact, the correct way of making a wish to the fountain. To this day, newlyweds in love throw coins into the Fountain of Lucine, wishing for peaceful and happy lives.

All Fontainians were Oceanids once, who, according to a legend, emerged from the tear of the first Hydro Archon, Egeria. The increase in the number of the Oceanids did not require any pairing off or matchmaking. After gaining sufficient understanding and emotion, they approached the Hydro Archon or an elder for permission to "reproduce," which resulted in their division into little Oceanids. Some believed their "reproduction" served as a permit, granting permission for the dreams and desires within Oceanids to be bestowed with a new name — much like the names of childhood dreams throughout the ages. After some Oceanids became humans, they forgot about their origin. They still asked permission to "reproduce," but it was considered a symbolic act. They threw coins into the Fountain of Lucine, wishing for the children, and then their wishes were granted. People believed that the spirits in the water would bless them with healthy and happy children. When Neuvillette turned the Fontainians into ordinary people, they were able to reproduce like all other inhabitants of Teyvat.

![Image 576: The blue glowing form of Focalors, the Hydro Archon, is surrounded by a group of people dressed in vintage clothing](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/d5998d077443b38b8c3b0eaea1c5530d_6161919709467730642.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

People's tears contain the most vivid emotions: tears of absolute happiness, fear, and grief. The Fountain of Lucine is a place where water from all over Fontaine flows, so even tears that fall to the ground end up here. People who are highly sensitive to the Hydro element are able to hear these emotions contained in someone's tears. Thus, the Traveler could hear Furina's tears, struggling over Fontaine's prophecy. In addition, one day they drank the water of the Primordial Sea, which increased sensitivity, and heard the voice of a mysterious Oceanid calling Vacher. This Oceanid asked Vacher not to search for Vigneire, an adventurer who was dissolved by the water of the Primordial Sea, anymore. Vacher was her beloved once, and after losing Vigneire, he began to dissolve other women in an attempt to return his beloved out of grief. When Vacher finally found Vigneire many years later, she didn't even want to talk to him. The consciousness of all the women he had dissolved over 20 years attacked him, and Vacher died of great fright.

![Image 577: Two robots stand on an illuminated surface in front of large, blurred steps and towering foliage in the background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/6652cd2808a2f41f493ac5d24aeab69e_6648293047281276847.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

To the right of the fountain, a scene with the Icewind Suite is located. According to the original plan of Mr. Bossuet, a senior technician of the Fontaine Research Institute, Coppelius and Coppelia were clockwork meka dedicated to the art of dance. After Bossuet's retirement, Maillardet took over the project. He understood the concepts of "mechanics" and "dance" in his own way, so as generations passed, the functions of the "mechanical dancers" were improved, but gradually moved away from Bossuet's original design. Pneumousia was added, making them not only good at dancing but also highly capable fighters. Two different combat modes for Coppelius and Coppelia were created based on the differences between Pneuma and Ousia, Nemesis of Coppelius, and Dirge of Coppelia.

![Image 578: Set of automatons standing near the grand entrance to a castle](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/dfd5fd2d9091b6707f7815a52814b91b_7003823008981125908.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Mechanical dancers can perform many plays. For example, one is about how Coppelius lost the battle with temptation and was punished for it, about how Coppelia falls in love, but unrequitedly, and therefore almost dies. Or how Coppelia goes on a journey to rescue Coppelius from captivity. The script of "Clockwork Coppelia" was never published, but some people have collected and organized all the records to reconstruct part of the intent of Coppelius's work. One such story tells how Coppelius's plan was exposed before the Marechaussee Hunters, and how he said his final farewells to Coppelia before his punishment. Coppelius asks Coppelia to sing for him one last time.
_"Wind a thread about my heart, and with it, bind me tightly! Lock me up in chains and fetters, and let me be destroyed in your eyes._

_For mine heart is decided, from today forth, I shall not seek those that make me happy, but bring happiness to those I choose."_

Another play tells how Coppelia confesses the purpose of her journey to the youth traveling with her and resolves to follow her creator, who, in her eyes, has already passed on. She believes that when her rusted gears return to the same ash as Coppelius's bones, all sin will be forgotten.

_"Never again need I see the sun, moon, or stars, never again need I hear the birds singing joyously in the forests, never again need I force this lonely heart of mine to continue beating on in a world that is already bereft of he who bestowed it upon me."_

Ms. Qiu and her film crew can be seen near the fountain. They all come from Qiaoying Village, which is famous for its tea. Due to the high competition in the tea business, they decided to take up filming commercials for the village's tea merchants. The group made a lot of Mora from these films, but soon there were other skilled people in the village whose films featured real opera singers. So, Ms. Qiu and the others came to Fontaine to get advice from experts in filmmaking. Here they met Geisert, a master of using light and shadow to convey a narrative. His films have not yet gained much popularity in Fontaine, but they interested Ms. Qiu. While filming their film, the crew lost their camera and later dropped the film with the footage in the water. Thanks to the help of the Traveler, all the footage was returned. Later, Ms. Qiu and her team returned to Qiaoying Village to continue filming.

**Opera Epiclese**
------------------
![Image 597: Tall building at night with stars in the background, architecture has columns of light coming from top of building](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/2ba661a9d9402275bf6efa1d57b274db_6496666899448784632.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Opera Epiclese is the most magnificent building on Erinnyes. When the Fontainians speak of the "opera house," that's what they are normally referring to. The opera house has another, more important role, besides serving as a site for various cultural performances. It is also a courtroom in which all cases in Fontaine are judged. Ever since the first diluvian period, the Opera Epiclese has stood atop the consecrated Island of Erinnyes. Overlooking the city above the waters, it symbolizes the new era's commitment to the rule of law and the pursuit of justice. The true and the fantastical, the comedic and the tragic find a stage here equally. An ancient Fontainian playwright once said: _"All the world's a stage, and all us merely players."_

![Image 598: Scales of justice with two water droplets in golden frame in front of an abstract pattern in a temple like atmosphere](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/f9637e460d788f9ba3c8144200245850_185335217513250755.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Huge scales called the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale stand on the stage of the opera house. This device was designed by the Hydro Archon, Focalors, and she placed her divinity along with the Hydro Gnosis there. The Oratrice converted the people's faith in justice into Indemnitium, a type of energy that powers Fontaine. If this power, accrued over five centuries, has only been used to sustain Fontainians, it could have lasted for millennia, but it has its purpose. Along with the Chief Justice, this device passed sentences in court, and its sentence has always been crucial. It once falsely accused the Fatui Harbinger, Childe, of connection to the serial dissolution case and declared the Hydro Archon guilty and to be punished via the death sentence. Although the Oratrice was used for trials, in truth its main purpose was to kill the God of Justice along with the Divine Throne when the time came. Focalors understood that only power of this magnitude could hope to destroy the Hydro Archon's Divine Throne, shaking the rules established by Celestia and breaking through the institution that is The Seven. After the main trial of the Hydro Archon, the Oratrice was destroyed, and now only the Chief Justice Neuvillette makes final verdicts.

![Image 599: A fountain sitting on a large blue and white platform against a background of green fields](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/9779a4d8709c1dca6b5b7821380802e8_1246924660559150398.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

There is a legend in Fontaine that the nation was once ruled by the Hydro Dragon, and every time the dragon cried, the sky became clouded, and rain poured down. To stop the rain, you had to shout into the sky: _"Hydro dragon, Hydro dragon, don't cry!"_ Often, after tragic court hearings, even on the sunniest day, it suddenly starts raining. This was the case when the former head of Spina di Rosula Callas Caspar, accused of murdering a friend, chose a judicial duel and refused to surrender even on the verge of death.

In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations, and to ensure the best viewing experience for all audience members, no outside food is permitted within the Opera Epiclese. Visitors in violation of the rules will be expelled and punished by the Maison Gardiennage in accordance with the law. Serious offenses will be prosecuted and brought to trial, and the offender will be sentenced in accordance with the law. Moreover, visitors must be properly dressed when entering the Opera Epiclese. Should their attire not meet the prescribed standards, staff members have the right to refuse entrance. Entry is strictly by tickets, which must be booked in advance. The opera house hosts many theatrical performances and legal proceedings. Among the performances was a stage play, "The Saga of Aurelius," a trilogy based upon the epic legend about the hero Aurelius from the fallen empire. The Melusine Philharmonic Orchestra also performed there with excerpts from "Epic of Elynas" and "Ode to Judges," and the magician Lyney performed with the program "Great Magician's Night of Fantasy'' and a new "water tank escape" trick. In addition, the awards ceremony, "The La Verite Prize," takes place in the opera house. This award was organized by The Steambird and is the most prestigious and famous media award in all of Teyvat. It is used to recognize and commemorate the greatest individual and collective achievements in media, including newspapers, magazines, journals, and other media fields. Here, the trial of the magician Lyney took place, as well as the trial of serial dissolutions, the case of changing the appearance of Melusine to human, and the case of the captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, Vautrin, who avenged his Melusine friend, who died due to the fault of people.

![Image 600: Character with a mask, wearing a blue dress and a blue hat decorated with flowers, sits in a room with a wooden floor and walls decorated with gears](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/ca88a3b197920e422586eaf5437c18a1_6457601456087519122.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

One day, the magician's assistant, Lynette, received a threatening letter after the successful opening of the play, "The Lost Puppet." At first, another actress, Gillian, was supposed to play the main role in the play, but suddenly the director put Lynette, who did not have much experience in plays, in her place. Feeling a look of hatred on her, Lynette decided to get to the bottom of what was happening. It turned out that the letter was left by Gillian's younger sister, who blamed Lynette for what was happening. And the look of hatred came from the director of the play: he took Lynette for the role only because of her fame as a magician's assistant. For her sake, he had to rewrite the ending of the play and simplify the role of the main character. When Lynette learned the truth, she persuaded Gillian and other members of the troupe to return to the old script and cast Gillian in the lead role. Since the actress was wearing a mask, no one noticed the substitution at first, and when the identity of the main actress was revealed, everyone was too in love with her performance to talk about the deception.

![Image 601: Beach landscape features a campfire on the sand, a wooden crate with a burning torch on top, a small wooden stool, and a book](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/951d56c950a013efe8f98dbe35f438ab_3789249281752746513.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Not far from the opera house, a Lumidouce Bell, meaning "separation," and a letter left by Melusine Talochard to her dead friend, a Mek named Curve, can be found. Curve was a sentient lie detector whose creator wanted him to learn to understand human lies and to lie himself. His creator died in a legal duel 30 years ago, defending his creation, and later, Talochard found Curve in an evidence room and decided to continue the creator's work. In the end, Curve died defending Talochard, having previously deceived her. In the letter, Talochard reprimanded her friend for lying but expressed her feelings to him.
_"Still, I don't think Dr. Mosso was right when he said that "a curve is the shortest distance between two people."_

_There are definitely some times when you should just shoot your shot straight._

_For example, I miss you."_

**Chemin de L'Espoir**
----------------------
![Image 618: Underwater scene with fish swimming around the ruins and small characters on the ground](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/e03e590c0a0526f10458c82cfa4f7644_2256739914580943326.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Chemin de L'Espoir is located on the border of the Court of Fontaine and Beryl Region. One day, a scientist from the Fontaine Research Institute, while observing maritime creatures, rescued a Blubberbeast pup from a ray-style clockwork meka that lost control. An examination showed that the pup was much weaker than a normal individual and could not survive in its natural environment. Then the researcher decided to leave it at the observation station, not far from Chemin de L'Espoir, and named it Berrypuff. When the institute's management withdrew the budget of the scientific group and directed it to "An Innovative Circuit Design Using Clockwork Meka to Simulate the Rock-Paper-Scissors Game and Its Sociological Impact," the scientist had to return.

![Image 619: The game artwork displays an underwater scene with turquoise sea flora and a cute animal character similar to a seal swimming in the water](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/14/237301566/be076eb2982ff151a3b2016d1e00f52a_5861088240744374599.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Since he could not take Berrypuff with him, he left enough food for it to grow up and return to its natural environment. When Paimon saw the researcher's notes, she wanted to see how Berrypuff was doing. It turned out that all the food had been eaten long ago, and the Blubberbeast pup was exhausted. At first, it was timid about the treat, but in the end, it ate it greedily. After some time of regular feeding and helping other animals, Berrypuff grew up and was able to live with its friends.

Annapausis is located on one side of the location. One day, a little Oceanid named Ann's friends were in trouble, and she went from Annapausis to Chemin de L'Espoir for help. The Traveler and Paimon, who were passing by, responded to her request and went to Annapausis to save her friends.

In this subarea, the world quest Ann of the Narzissenkreuz can be found.

**Annapausis**
--------------
![Image 626: Undersea structure, with a glowing blue hue, features a grand staircase leading to an arched entrance framed by jagged, luminous ice formations](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/49d24a96fef93fb7be4eecee46e5aec2_1260587063053983973.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The gentle breeze winds through the flowery meadows in Mont Esus, setting the creaking arms of windmills to turn lazily. The peaceful and relaxed atmosphere here causes people to naturally find themselves dwelling on their most pleasant memories. Some foothills of Mont Esus by the sea, close to the Palais Mermonia. Visitors can feel the gentle breeze as they step onto the vast flower fields. According to ancient records, a magnificent palace was once built here. Named after the flowers, it sought to sing praises of love and to nurture abandoned orphans above the countless waters. Though the high tower of old no longer graces this land, the flowers remain as fragrant as ever.

![Image 627: A library with books piled in corners, green lighting from windows, and plants potted in white vases](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/2fbf213e6038f931cac251314bb1e094_4471715943495480188.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Before the Cataclysm 500 years ago, Annapausis was the site of the Narzissenkreuz Institute, Fontaine's orphanage. After the fall of Remuria, the Fontainian Government decided to incorporate the Institute for raising orphans and the children of criminals into the public welfare system. In honor of the remains of the previous civilization, on the site on which the institute was located, it received the name the Narzissenkreuz Institute. As a token of gratitude to the Hydro Archon Egeria, the gentle Oceanid Lyris was placed at the head of the Institute. More than 500 years ago, Basil Elton, who grew up in the orphanage herself, became the Vice Director of the Narzissenkreuz Institute. Although sunlight never reached the Institute, it was always warm and bustling with life.

![Image 628: Indoor scene with a turquoise pool in the foreground, stone walls on either side overgrown with vines, and a arched stone doorway leading to a structure with an ornately patterned door](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/40c96ad80eee04673daa306a2336d348_655296209389150717.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Basil told the children stories about Princess Lyris and the evil dragon Narcissus. During the Cataclysm, the Narzissenkreuz Institute was abandoned and ceased to exist. Basil Elton led the fleet of the Fontaine Armada and went to fight the creatures of the Abyss, and Lyris never understood the connection between the Cataclysm and the disappearance of the students, so she was later seen wandering near the abandoned institute. Later, she joined the radical organization, the Narzissenkreuz Ordo. Many students, including Mary-Ann Guillotin, became members of the Marechaussee Phantom or the Special Patrol, and others began to travel around the world.

![Image 629: A stone fountain featuring seashells sits in the centre of a courtyard, with turquoise flowers and plants around its base, situated within a stone architecture featuring two arch-topped windows on either side](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/5749eb5fe1c6150e312e3dace1af1385_7675987577840607620.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

During the battle between agents of the Marechaussee Phantom and members of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, among whom were Lyris and Mary-Ann Guillotin, an explosion occurred. Mary-Ann Guillotin was on the verge of death, and Lyris hugged her, merging their consciousnesses together. From this merge, a new oceanid, Mary-Ann, was born. She was no longer Mary-Ann Guillotin nor Lyris. Wanting to remain in past memories, Mary-Ann created "The Real Annapausis," willingly becoming its captive. She created a fairy-tale house for herself, where she lived in her dreams.

![Image 630: A desk in a study room with books scattered all around, a Tiffany lamp is placed to the desk next to a treasure box](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/5556f5c7eb72f065bdb58d0358ec6225_3637372094441727177.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

One day, Mary-Ann was able to create another oceanid, Ann, after seeing her in a dream. Since Ann was part of Mary-Ann, she received part of the memories of Lyris and Mary-Ann Guillotin. Her main memory was the tale about the dragon Narcissus, which Basil Elton told to the children in the orphanage. Ann believed that her goal was to save Princess Lyris from the fairy tale, whom she thought Mary-Ann was.

![Image 631: Building in Genshin Impact is shown in a promotional image](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/71e34ef47bb29300b435db053b65c94f_614068150990437535.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Oceanid Ann, with the help of the Traveler and Paimon, went to Annapausis to save her friends and Princess Lyris from the dragon sleeping on the institute building. To enable Ann and the Traveler to get to the princess's castle, Ann's friends had to sacrifice themselves and merge together. When Ann and the Traveler walked through the endless labyrinth and found the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz, they discovered a book of fairy tales, through which they entered "The Real Annapausis." It turned out that Mary-Ann was the princess all this time, and she did not want to return to reality. She told Ann to live her life and do what she wanted, and then kicked them out of "The Real Annapausis," destroying the portal in the book through which they got there. When Ann discovered the truth about her and Mary-Ann's origins, she wanted to separate the identities of Oceanid Lyris and Mary-Ann Guillotin, but Mary-Ann accepted her past and decided to leave her prison.

**Institute of Natural Philosophy**
-----------------------------------
![Image 648: The interior of an underwater temple is shown, featuring a large archway with an ornate window, and a triangular object in the center of the room](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/d3c43378510602f79692a0986a134830_8723508925775503871.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The old building of the Institute of Natural Philosophy is located near Chemin de L'Espoir. It was once a thriving research facility, but now it lies in ruin beneath the waters of Fontaine. The director of the institute was Dwight Lasker, an old friend of Emanuel Guillotin, Karl Ingold, and Basil Elton, with whom he grew up in an orphanage. After the Cataclysm that occurred 500 years ago, an energy crisis arose in Fontaine, so the main focus was the search for new energy sources. Significant efforts were made to transport Primal Constructs to the Institute for thorough examination due to the noticeable technological gap between the Primal Constructs found in the ruins of Sumeru's desert and the clockwork machines prevalent during this era. Two young prodigies of the Institute, Alain Guillotin and Rene, used the characteristics of Ousia and Pneuma to construct a new kinetic core, which eventually led to the first controlled annihilation reaction.

![Image 649: A teal, abandoned library with bookshelves and ornate columns](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/33d5f8bd8f63ac929831ecb7f6333fc9_3911375361667502873.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

After annihilation reactions were proven to be successful, research shifted to Kinematics. The experiments that took place here involved Khaenri'ahn machines, such as Ruin Graders, and were noted to be so dangerous an emergency damage control strategy was implemented for safety. Alain's experiments into machines were perceived by other researchers as an intention to create a mechanical dog as proof of his accomplishments in Kinematics and material science. Alain's assistant had suggested creating such a thinking machine, a thinking Kamera to be precise, so that it would take photos of those precious to Alain while he was busy. Alain found using a thinking Kamera for this reason to be pointless, but he found such a machine useful for security and surveillance applications. Seymour, Prototype 4ACV07, was the thinking machine Alain created for Mary-Ann Guillotin and takes the form of a mechanical dog. Seymour was created by Alain to protect his adoptive sister Mary-Ann and was made with the most advanced optics from the Fontaine Institute of Natural Philosophy.

![Image 650: Purple orb in the middle of a room with a staircase in the background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/8a98a3fe4e8892d95de942cdb5b4384a_5171414642038990369.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

While Alain and other researchers focused on Kinematics, Rene and Jakob Ingold, who was a child at this time, had different research directions and they applied for a research lab of their own. Rene and Jakob eventually obtained their own lab, and they limited access to it due to the dangerous nature of their research. Rene acquired something powerful to research that appeared after the disaster, which was very dangerous for most people, but Jakob felt his constitution became "better" after being exposed to it. This research eventually led to an experiment on Carter, albeit in an attempt to save his life, which had disastrous effects on him.

![Image 651: Library setting has a large window design and detailed stone work](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/a5e344956b90a85cd6f59bd777aa21a0_5502165261104750215.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

At the end of the Central Quartier of the Institute, the gathering place of an esoteric society known as the Narzissenkreuz Ordo can be found using an indecipherable book. This book leads to the Tower of Ipsissimus in the Morte Region. Although Rene found it quite sad that people from the Institute of Natural Philosophy had somewhat turned into his believers, he established the Narzissenkreuz Ordo within the Institute to give his followers a sense of belonging. The Ordo did not go unnoticed among the leaders of the Institute, but as there was no evidence of aggression or any invasive nature, the case was not pursued through official investigative channels. After the Institute disbanded, some of its former members joined the Narzissenkreuz Ordo at Mr. Ingold's invitation. Much of the continued research focused on the ancient civilization of Remuria. This led to the uncovering of an ancient copy of an unknown document within the Institute of Natural Philosophy, containing Remurian characters that seemed to be some form of phonography. This ultimately aided in the decipherment of unknown esoteric Remurian documents.

![Image 652: An old room with pictures on the wall, desk, bookshelves, and overgrown with green plant life](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/b655e72f4ed0f21a7ae2081b22497ac2_2626998614409286131.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

One day, the Traveler and Paimon met Virgil from Spina di Rosula in the Court of Fontaine, and he asked them to help find the vault of the secret society "Liliacruces Forum." He wanted to use everything they found against the other members of the organization, Sonny and Luka. When Virgil realized that the so-called Liliacruces Forum was actually the Institute of Natural Philosophy, he attempted to get rid of the Traveler and Paimon in order to take their Mora. After escaping from the invincible Ruin Guard, the Traveler and Paimon met Sonny and his partner Luka, who were looking for Virgil. Together, they discovered a shipment of illegal Sinthe that Virgil and his henchmen were trying to sell. After a "very long and serious conversation," Virgil was never seen again.

**Salacia Plain**
-----------------
![Image 687: An illustration of the underwater world showing wreckage](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/072881a06e8c34693edd183c4b5369b0_9094134046735131972.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

At the bottom of the sea plateau lies the wreckage of Fontaine's great white fleet. In the past, it traversed the seas and was Fontaine's supreme pride and glory. The First Hydro Archon, Egeria, blessed people with the authority and wish to conquer all waters of the world. However, that lofty ambition was insufficient to overcome the laws of fate, and the fleet was destroyed during the Cataclysm in the fight against the creature from the Abyss, Elynas. To this day, on the brass masts are inscribed the words: _"I have conquered the waves of the four seas."_

![Image 688: A magical, otherwordly portal is surrounded by green flora](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/0a0e595ed19c3e3b25ff2735b2dd4bca_5381044595080936841.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The All-Devouring Narwhal, that once devoured the birthing waters of the planet, has departed without a single trace, but those in the know will forever live, surely, in the terrifying shadow of that omen of the end. At the bottom of Salacia Plain, a single shard of shattered spacetime remains, and through it, one may perhaps be able to witness that titanic creature once more.

![Image 689: Brightly lit underwater scene shows plantlife and a stone structure, with fish swimming about](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/268b1f6b69ff5042a72c094f46d7615f_974544334668566640.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

On Salacia Plain, a base for Sinthe production, a drug created from the diluted water of the Primordial Sea, is located. Once, there was a source of the Primordial Sea, which was discovered by the adventurers Vacher and Vigneire. Vigneire, touching the water, dissolved before the eyes of her beloved. He wanted to follow her, but he was not a native of Fontaine, and the water of the Primordial Sea had no effect on him. Out of grief, Vacher began to look for ways to bring Vigneire back. One day, he found the notes of Jakob Ingold, a member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, who had conducted experiments using the water of the Primordial Sea many years ago, and decided to use this research in his experiments. Vacher began kidnapping Fontainian women the same age as Vigneire in an attempt to revive his beloved. To remain above suspicion, Vacher decided to get rid of his old identity and came up with a story about a businessman, Marcel, who had just arrived in Fontaine. He found the name Marcel in Vigneire's diary, where she chose names for her and Vacher's children.

![Image 690: A steampunk-themed fantasy scene in blue and teal, featuring a clockwork portal surrounded by flora](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/5419631f4e8f3e738d71c2bb91a2bf5a_3745364846672000071.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

During his research, Marcel noticed that a small amount of Primordial Sea water, diluted in ordinary water, is not lethal even for the inhabitants of Fontaine, but has intoxicating properties. Marcel named this drink Sinthe and started an underground business producing it. This drink could excite your mood and produce many pleasant hallucinations. With long-term use of Sinthe, many side effects occur, including a loss of the ability to focus or control one's emotions. Upon withdrawal, the person experienced flashes of paranoia and anxiety while lacking the energy to do anything. Marcel became the head of the Confrerie of Cabriere, a guild in Poisson. In the beginning, they were only reselling some daily goods, but later they became one of the richest guilds around with a lot of business connections in the city.

![Image 691: Elaborate blue room with ornate decorations](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/8e613d6a279e9b6aecd32197080c788d_283546402810276141.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Due to the side effects of long-term use of Sinthe, three years ago, the head of Poisson, Callas Caspar, banned its distribution in Poisson and began an investigation. He soon saw a connection between Sinthe and serial dissolutions. Due to a fatal illness, he knew that he would not be able to complete the investigation, so he conveyed information about the location of Marcel's base to his butler, Melus. Three years later, Callas's daughter, Navia, continued her father's work. According to information from Melus, the Traveler and Paimon discovered the base and evidence, thanks to which they were able to prove Marcel's guilt. After this, all shipments of Sinthe were destroyed by the Maison Gardiennage.

**Thalatta Submarine Canyon**
-----------------------------
![Image 710: Underwater scenery features a sunken landscape with blue algae and flora](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/35a337fb4135eaf0b319a103f3111774_1820756750216828241.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Thalatta Submarine Canyon lies on the border between the Court of Fontaine and Liffey Regions. Since the Fortress of Meropide, an underwater prison, is located nearby, all non-Maison Gestion approved activities are prohibited in the canyon. The Callas aquabus line used to pass through above the canyon, connecting the Court of Fontaine and the Fontaine Research Institute, but the recent explosion of the Central Laboratory destroyed the route.

![Image 711: A skeleton lying underwater with a school of fish](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/b84619323b3bb3e996037dbae4b5c34c_8093791603701049664.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Near the underwater canyon, the director of the Fishing Association, Delaroche, resides. Even though she is the director, she has not been able to catch a single fish. Previously, she was an ordinary employee of the Fontaine Research Institute, responsible for purchasing materials, negotiating with suppliers, and bringing down prices, but most of the time, just waiting for the suppliers to respond. While waiting, she wandered the city streets until she met new friends from the Fishing Association, and they introduced her to the joy of fishing. Delaroche fell in love with this activity, and her life took on new meaning. In gratitude, she supplied the fishermen with various equipment from the Institute, which helped them get a large catch. Since Delaroche had established connections with various merchants and was always ready to come to the rescue, everyone decided to elect her as the head of the Association. But even when she was at her post, she could not catch a single fry. It turned out that Delaroche uses bait that dissolves in water. When the Traveler helped her with bait, she decided to use baits that were too hard for the fish to swallow. As a result, the Traveler and Paimon left her a recipe for a simple and effective bait as a gift in the hope that now the head of the Association will learn to fish. One day, Delaroche met the Melusine Iara and taught her fishing techniques. Due to the specifics of Delaroche's skills, Iara was unable to catch a fish, so she decided to place a ball octopus in her pond and practice on it.

![Image 712: A store selling bottles is on the ground](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/5500eb75239bf906c294c00d3116e1a2_3111597696006581700.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

On land near the canyon, a secret laboratory for the production of Imitation Sinthe, a new drug that appeared after Sinthe disappeared from the market, was located. Pierre, a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute, prepared drugs in the laboratory, placed them in special impenetrable bags, and then transported them in barrels across the river. Thanks to the actions of the commander of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, Chevreuse, as well as the magician Lynette, the case of Imitation Sinthe was solved.

![Image 713: A cartoonish mountain stands under a deep blue sky, with trees covering its grassy slopes and a large stone doorway at its base](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/2338eb3ca69c12de4c3c8714007f56c3_5293197501277928341.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

On the foothills of Mount Esus, there are ruins left over from the ancient civilization of Remuria. In distant times, when the first Hydro Archon had not yet returned from confinement, another God King, Remus, dreamed of building a prosperous empire out of harmonious music atop the waves. But the great ambition of building a utopia failed to come to fruition, and the arrogance of humanity sank into their depths along with their pride. The golden music is long silent, only the cold music of the tides still echoes upon the remains of their grand altars.

Near these ruins, the artist Salsa once painted a landscape, but her view was obstructed by structures created by adventurers. Therefore, Salsa decided to fight the designs and created the "Alliance of Artists to Overthrow the Evil Organization and Protect the Future of Fontaine." It turned out that all these structures were installed by an adventurer and installation artist, Ubu. Since Salsa did not appreciate his innovative approach to art, she moved all of his installations to fit into the landscape. The two artists could not agree on whose work could be called art, so Ubu left, defeated and promising to become a great artist.

![Image 714: The night scene shows a fairytale landscape with a house glowing with lights, tall blue mountains, and sunflowers blooming near a stone path and wooden fence](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/7e52e77d1469e6d10872915204179249_3383037245356813744.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Further along Mont Esus, beyond the Court of Fontaine, a small village is located. Earnshaw lives here with his daughter's dogs: Hero, Princess, and Prince. Earnshaw's daughter, Agnes, was a freedom-loving woman and left her father. He expected him to return, so he didn't even read the letters she sent him. It turned out that Agnes ended up in the Fortress of Meropide, where she gave birth to her daughter, Lanoire. She was beautiful, like a small flower emerging from a crack in a rock, and grew persistently and selflessly even where there was neither sun nor rain. After some time, Agnes fell ill and died in the fortress, without having time to prepare documents for her daughter. With the help of Lanoire's friend, Caterpillar, the guard Estienne, the Traveler, and Paimon, Lanoire escaped from the Fortress of Meropide and was reunited with her grandfather. When Caterpillar, whose real form is a hilichurl, decided to visit Lanoire for her birthday, Earnshaw feared for his granddaughter and called the Gardes for help. Since Caterpillar had lost the ability to transform into a human, he said goodbye to Lanoire, told her to never talk to anyone who looked like him, and disappeared.

![Image 715: Rustic building nestles amidst lush greenery, framed by mountains and trees](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/beda50a3f18afbf2db21abc5a291d7f6_5119203836278577435.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In the same village lived the sick mother of a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute, Potton. Potton was ugly, and no one wanted to communicate or cooperate with him. Only criminals entered into an agreement with him. During his research, Potton created a face-changing agent, the main component of which was the liquid remaining from the Fontainians dissolved by the Primordial Sea. Potton changed his appearance and became Rawat. He first spent all his money on treating his mother, but nothing helped, and she could not even recognize her son after the change. Rawat decided not to miss the opportunity and earn more, and the main component of the product was provided to him by the head of the Confrerie of Cabriere, Marcel, who was behind the production of Sinthe and the serial dissolution of women. When Rawat's mother was dying, he decided to change his appearance to his original one for the last time to say goodbye to her, but his mother had already lost her sight and did not recognize him even by touch.

**Smuggling Case**
------------------
![Image 748: Lumine from Genshin Impact holds a black cat while Lynette stands next to her with a questioning look](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/730bca1faf33d9ee6662257679b3a37e_1681958897372036870.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

One day, the magician's assistant, Lynette, found a cat in the Court of Fontaine and named it Bonnie. She tried to find Bonnie's owners by placing an ad in The Steambird, and a man and a woman answered her ad. After examining the cat, the man decided that he had made a mistake, and the woman said that the cat belonged to her friend. Lynette suspected that the woman might be a Garde, so she revealed her name, Elodie. Elodie was investigating a case of smuggling across the border, and the real owner of the cat was one of her main suspects. When he realized that the Gardes were looking for him, he ran away and was separated from Bonnie. Elodie hoped that the owner might return for the cat, so she answered the ad in the newspaper.
Elodie revealed that Bonnie's owner was Pierre Lefevere, a researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute. The Lefevere family was once a famous aristocratic family involved in many crimes. One of the family members "bought" Lynette many years ago, before she joined Fatui and the House of the Hearth. In recent years, almost all the family members, including the head, were killed by an unknown assassin. Most of the remaining members died of hunger and disease, and the survivors changed their names. Pierre hid in the institute under a different name, but when the Gardes searched his belongings, they found a pendant of an illegitimate member of the Lefevere family.

The contraband that Pierre was transporting was a new type of drug called the Imitation Sinthe. When the Gardes confiscated all Sinthe and arrested the head of the Confrerie of Cabriere, Marcel, who was behind the production of Sinthe, people began to look for a new way to get drugs. Due to the measures taken after the Sinthe incident, criminals became smarter and managed to transfer their sales abroad. When the Marechausse Phantom began an investigation to track down all the people in Fontaine who were capable of producing such a drug, they came across Pierre. Elodie knew that if she took Bonnie to the Gardes, Pierre would definitely not come for it, so she asked Lynette and the Traveler to keep an eye on the cat.

Lynette felt that something was wrong with Pierre's story, so she went to the Fontaine Research Institute to find the truth. There, she met her brother Lyney and the captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, Chevreuse. As Lynette suspected, her brother, who had been acting suspiciously in recent days, was investigating Pierre Lefevere. Chevreuse and Lyney revealed that Pierre had become addicted to Sinthe, so he tried to use the Institute's resources to create a substance with a similar effect. Although Pierre claimed he had done this only for research purposes, the Institute denied him access to the relevant materials. He was placed on leave until the investigation was completed, but due to staff shortages, the investigation was postponed.

Since the Imitation Sinthe left clear traces at the production sites, Lynette, Chevreuse, Lyney, and the Traveler investigated a suspicious place on the coast near the Thalatta Submarine Canyon. From the evidence they collected, they concluded that Pierre was using floating barrels to transfer drugs and had an accomplice. If Pierre was only responsible for producing the Imitation Sinthe, the second person would have to be responsible for transporting the goods across the border. Lynette and the Traveler went to the Lumidouce Harbor to examine the registration logs and look for clues.

Once at the harbor, Lynette and the Traveler discovered that the gendarme Elodie was in charge of protecting Lumidouce Harbor. In the registration logs, they found records of a "Humane Society" that rehomed animals abroad. The head of the organization was Bernard, the man who responded to the ad about Bonnie. Lynette and the Traveler figured out that the Humane Society was using cats to transport the Imitation Sinthe so that no one could detect it. Pierre fed the drugs to the cats in special corrosion-resistant bags and transported them in floating barrels with holes for air. When Bernard examined Bonnie, he felt her stomach to make sure she did not have the Imitation Sinthe.

When Lynette, the Traveler, and Elodie arrived at the Humane Society in the Court of Fontaine, they captured Bernard. He admitted that the organization was in a sorry state, but one day he received an unexpected letter. He was offered a large sum of money to transport animals abroad, and he accepted. Although Bernard constantly communicated with Pierre by letter, he never met him in person. When the Marechaussee Phantom began investigating, Bernard received a final letter stating that Pierre had gone on the run.

![Image 749: Anime scene of Genshin Impact characters Aether and Kirara, looking down with their hands outstretched towards an orange tabby cat sitting behind bars](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/f29c1f09b2771fd5a0777d8e7a47f7ae_5387780713107973599.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

After Bernard was caught, Lynette felt that the case had been solved too quickly. Since Pierre was so careful and secretive, it was suspicious that he carried a pendant with him that linked him to the Lefevere family. The Institute had cut off Pierre's access to the materials, but he somehow continued to make the Imitation Sinthe. The letter that Bernard had received also seemed strange: if Pierre had known that Bonnie did not have the drug, he could have warned Bernard about it. And if the cat had them, she would have been the main evidence that had to be disposed of. Having collected all the evidence, Lynette and the Traveler came to the conclusion that there was a third person in the case, unknown to both Pierre and Bernard. And this third person had long ago decided to sacrifice them for the sake of their own salvation in the case.

![Image 750: Two people are collapsed on the ground while a third character and a fourth stand over them](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/7ff2c69be445fca05f4d14dbbadcf597_6647531383212523036.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Lynette and the Traveler realized that all this time, only one person had been leading them astray by telling them that Pierre belonged to the Lefevere family: Elodie. She was the one who had set the Marechaussee Phantom on Pierre and then lured him into a trap so that he would disappear. She was the one who had led the investigation to the "Humane Society" by noticing their name in the registration logs. Elodie had organized the records of the society's activities when filling out the logs in such a way that anyone reading them would immediately notice, and the logs themselves did not contain information about the port administration's activities during the shifts that Elodie worked. In addition, she often changed shifts, and they coincided exactly with the activities of the "Humane Society."
Elodie's real name was Elodie Lefevere, and she was the illegitimate daughter of the family. She became a Garde before the fall of the Lefeveres, and actively participated in the interrogations and arrests of family members in order to avoid suspicion. Thanks to the help of Chevreuse and Lyney, who arrived in time, Elodie was caught and taken into custody.

**"The Little Oceanid"**
------------------------
Once the director of a small theater troupe, Aurelie Fumeau, gathered around herself many people who were left without a livelihood or who had lost the meaning of life, and convinced them to join her troupe. She wrote scripts herself, performed on stage, and mentored each of them. Dulphy was born with an incurable illness, and once her family found out it couldn't be treated, they abandoned her. For several years, she agreed to any job, tried to manage her illness with various medicines, and during a severe flare-up, she lay in an alleyway for days at a time. When Aurelie found Dulphy, she said that she had a beautiful voice and offered to teach her to sing. The director taught her to sing and perform, helped her find money for medicine, and took care of her. Another actor, Lauwick, was the son of a murderer and grew up in an orphanage. Other children bullied and beat him, and one day he ran away. When he had already lost all faith in humanity, he met Aurelie. The actor Pauleau was in love with Aurelie. One day, he confessed his feelings to her, but she said that the whole troupe was like siblings to her. Pauleau replied that he would always help the troupe and her and hoped that in the future she would be able to rethink what she wanted in her life.

![Image 759: Rizzley stands facing a water spirit in front of a waterfall, surrounded by greenery and flowers](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/3f16e48d617b6aa26aaf536382267060_4438483246328783880.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Aurelie's last work was the musical "The Little Oceanid", which tells the story of a young Oceanid who, despite her family's protests, turned into a human. She dreamed of living like everyone else and even found friendship and love. Everything seemed perfect, but one day her true nature was revealed, and her world began to crumble. _"If you become human, you can reveal your secret to no one. You will face suffering and loneliness... Is this truly what you want?"_ This was the most important line in the entire script and a symbolic statement about the life and legacy of the troupe's leader. She kept silent about all the trials and tribulations that befell her as the troupe's leader and devoted all her energy to them. Aurelie never managed to finish the play, as she became a victim of serial disappearances. Among the belongings of the young girls dissolved by the killer, Vacher, was Aurelie's diary. When the girl was dissolved before her eyes, the diary broke off. It turned out that she was trying to protect her troupe because one of the members got involved in distributing Sinthe. Before she disappeared, she told everyone to leave the Court of Fontaine and wait for her outside the city, but she never came. Even as she sat in silence, waiting for her death, she did not regret her decision, because she was an older sister to the troupe.
_"Someone else was taken. That makes six._

_Or perhaps the seventh? Someone tried to escape yesterday but was caught. She hasn't been seen since._

_Was that yesterday? Maybe not. I've long since lost track of time._

_Sorry. I don't know if writing this is of any use, or how much longer I can do it for._

_I can already see my fate approaching. But what terrifies me even more is..._

_The thought of seeing others from the troupe here._

_Have I truly protected them?_

_Sorry. I'm so sorry. I can write no more..._

_I think I have a fever and my old stomach troubles have returned. But nobody has given me any medicine._

_I suppose I am more fortunate than Crecy... the pain keeps her awake all night._

_I suppose they think that anything goes so long as the experimental subjects can be used up before they die..._

_It is so damp here. I have given her my blanket._

_So cold, so cold. So cold._

_As long as one persists, all things will pass._

_There will be a reward for hard work._

_I like to tell them such things._

_But it is I who am losing my grip."_

Since the troupe lost its leader, everything went downhill. Conflicts began to arise between them, the chronic illness of the lead actress worsened, the two main actors did not give confirmation, and the troupe could not agree on the ending of the play. Some believed that it was worth making a happy ending so as not to convey their pain to the audience, while others believed that it was worth writing a real tragedy, like in life. Pauleau, playing the main character's beloved, locked himself in the house to concentrate on writing the ending. When the deadline came, there was still no news from him. Vilmant, playing the main villain, took Aurelie's death very hard and did not appear in the city. It was he who caused the death of the leader. Since the troupe stayed afloat thanks to donations from the audience, their financial situation was difficult. One day after a performance, a merchant approached Vilmant and offered generous sponsorship, and in exchange, the troupe would provide the audience with drinks during the performances. Vilmant thought it was a good deal and agreed without even consulting Aurelie. When the merchant came to pick up the goods, it turned out to be Sinthe. He immediately explained everything to the leader, and she told the merchant that the troupe could not agree to this collaboration. In a rage, the merchant threatened to sue for damages, but Aurelie promised to solve the problem herself. Suddenly, she ordered everyone to leave the city and never returned.

![Image 760: Two people in formal clothing hugging at center stage, with audience members clapping around them](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/9bb39399ec37320c36d2d48c893f27d3_4105530908660648218.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When Dulphy's illness worsened, Lauwick approached the Adventurers' Guild to find a replacement, but since the show was in a few days and the troupe had no extra funds, no one would agree. The Traveler and Paimon answered the call and decided to ask Furina, who had left her post as the Hydro Archon, to perform in the musical. She was categorically not ready to return to the stage but agreed to consult with the troupe to learn more about their leader. The story of "The Little Oceanid" resonated deeply with Furina, as she had hidden her true nature for centuries and could not confess to anyone.

![Image 761: A couple in Mondstadt, holding hands and gazing at each other, is surrounded by the hustle and bustle of Windblume](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/9bd175952169fd798ef277b698c627c4_7182161654946682694.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Pauleau's proposed scenario told how an Oceanid found love and friendship in a bustling city, but people began to notice that all the fresh water in the area was gradually disappearing, the soil was becoming dry, and the plants and flowers were withering. Little Oceanid Clio and her lover decided to do something and get to the bottom of it together. Eventually, they discovered that all the waste and pollution created by people over the years had caused the fresh water to leave the earth as if driven by its own consciousness. Clio, as a water spirit, immediately understood what the water felt and told her lover about it and her true nature. Her lover accepted her as she was, and together, they tried to find a way to bring back the water, but someone overheard her secret and blamed her for the disappearance of the water. In the end, she made the courageous decision to sacrifice herself to save her lover and all of humanity.

![Image 762: Two figures stand in the foreground, one kneeling and the other standing, with ruined buildings and a figure in a hat in the background, illustrated in a sepia tone](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/81c5511285823adc210bf6617f607899_5377925362636029369.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Dulphy wanted to make the most truthful ending possible, with the little Oceanid reflecting Aurelie. She proposed that the little Oceanid be hunted to death by the people who hated her, her lover ensured that her secret would never be revealed, and humanity would continue on its path to extinction. This ending would show the random and meaningless end that their leader met, sacrificed for the sake of an experiment by a man who had no relation to her. Pauleau, who was in love with Aurelie, did not agree with this ending, as he wanted a better ending for her. Together, they decided to go to Vilmant to reach a compromise on the script.

![Image 763: Furina, Paimon, and other characters standing indoors](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/36da57c7a9ae684337f296112dd2c3b2_326484596133705830.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When the troupe learned the truth about Aurelie's death, some were furious, but Furina helped them put their differences aside until the end of the performance. The troupe's leader wanted to build a warm home for all her brothers and sisters and shield them from the storms that rage in the world outside. Although the troupe tried to make her the heroine of the story, she was already a heroine to them. And if the troupe wanted to do justice to Aurelie, they had to reconcile their differences and force themselves to finish the play. After reading Aurelie's diary, found in the evidence at the Palais Mermonia, the troupe unanimously decided on the ending of the musical.

![Image 764: Furina wearing a blue hat is watching a blue pendant from Genshin Impact](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/16/237301566/3c6afb427c6ef8a356be11255a56f366_8640582259843648901.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

During the final performance at the Opera Epiclese, which Furina had helped to book, Dulphy's illness worsened again, and she asked Furina to sing the final song. Although Furina had broken her promise to herself never to go on stage again, she was glad to be back. In the last scene, Clio sacrificed herself to bring back fresh water and save the people. According to the script, she was not to take up the Vision that would appear before her as she disappeared, but instead allow it to fall into the ocean depths alone. But during the actual performance, a real Vision appeared, and it belonged to Furina. As Furina grasped it, its reflected radiance seemed to contain her heart, filled once again by this performance.

_"If I could only return to the water's embrace_

_Wouldn't the world be a lovelier place?_

_Dear Mother, would you be able to forgive_

_As the dancing water flows, so too we would live_

_The city would nourish_

_And you too, my dear, would flourish_

_But love alone could be to no avail_

_Only farewell, I fear, would prevail_

_Thus are our lives filled with joy and sorrow_

_I'll be here always, forever and tomorrow_

_To behold the world's undying beauty_

_And that shall live on in perpetuity…"_

Despite the great success of "The Little Oceanid," the actors decided to disband the troupe. Some of them were ready to continue acting, while others wanted to take care of their health. Furina, inspired by Aurelie's life, decided that she was not as against returning to the stage as she had previously thought. From that moment on, she wanted to spend her time learning real stories about real people and how they touch the lives of others around them. She wanted to watch them blossom and wither, see them refined on the page, retold on the stage, and remembered long into the future.
