**The Phantom Weasel**
----------------------
![Image 773: A cartoon-style man is wearing a top hat, monocle, and cape, with his arms outstretched on a background of balloons](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/e818dd7998eeddde206dec78179ad33e_6405113114023587122.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

More than ten years ago, a phantom thief, known as "The Weasel," became active in the Court of Fontaine. Nobody knew his true identity, and the authorities never managed to catch him. He had a bad reputation: he targeted whatever people held dear, and no one was safe from his predation. He would just as soon steal a necklace from a rich merchant's safe as he would a toy doll given to a commoner child for their birthday. If not for an accident, The Weasel could have continued to roam free, but ten years ago, a magician named Cesar fell to his death in a botched high-altitude escape performance. When the police went through his personal effects, they found a hoard of stolen loot and gadgets used for criminal activities, and that was how The Phantom Weasel's identity was revealed to all. Many did not believe that Cesar could be a criminal, because he was constantly giving gifts to children. Sometimes he would ask them to write down what they wanted on paper, and during the next performance, he would pull the gifts out of thin air. But after his death, a rumor spread that Cesar had asked children to write their wishes on paper so that he could steal their most precious possessions. After Cesar's death, there were fewer thefts in the city, and people began to forget about him, until one day, ten years later, The Weasel wrote a warning letter and hung it right on the gates of the opera house: _"Three days from now, when evening falls, I shall take from you that which you hold most dear at the opera house, just as you did to me ten years ago."_
Three days later, the magician Lyney was scheduled to perform at the Opera Epiclese in the evening, so he wanted to expose The Weasel so that his concert would not be canceled. He asked the Traveler and Paimon to join the investigation and temporarily act as his assistants. The first step was to find out who Cesar really was, because if he truly was The Phantom Weasel, the real Weasel would be dead, and the warning letter was just a copycat criminal. And if he was not The Weasel, the real Weasel would be alive and have gone into hiding ten years ago. They decided to start with Cesar's fiancée, Jemma, who visits his grave every week. She often spoke into the void and told him the latest news. People thought that Cesar did not deserve the love of such a woman, because he was a criminal. When Jemma appeared at the cemetery, she was wounded and looked scared, so she refused to answer Lyney's questions. Even though they left her alone, it felt like she was hiding something.

The next day, they decided to meet Cesar's student Lorenzo, who had inherited his secrets of magic and craft. Before long, Lorenzo was the next big magician in town, his fame surpassing even that of his master, and it made him very wealthy. He's since left the magic scene and became a wealthy businessman with his fingers in a lot of different pies. He claimed that the real Weasel had died, and it was the imitator who left the letter. _"Look, you of all people should know that a magician never reveals their secrets — and in any case, dead men don't talk. So if you really care about your magician's pride, then you'll forget about Cesar and move on."_ The conversation with Lorenzo also did not give answers, but left the feeling that he was hiding something. Leaving Lorenzo, Lyney noticed surveillance. These people threatened Jemma and wanted to deal with Lyney and the Traveler, but were defeated. Lyney assured Jemma that she was not in danger, and she told him about Cesar's workshop in the Fleuve Cendre.

![Image 774: An anime character with blonde hair, a mustache, and a monocle is wearing a top hat and standing in front of a circus tent](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/b0551370bfd19b46ec4fe3b36fa9652d_1250815489837056911.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The path to the workshop was protected by tricks and riddles, and the workshop itself was hidden behind a secret door in the closet. Inside was Cesar's diary, where he talked about meeting two children who wanted to learn how to do tricks. They were so persistent in their requests that Cesar could not refuse them. The children turned out to be incredibly talented and had unusual thoughts, so the magician was sure that over time, they would surpass him. Cesar even wanted to take them on tour, but they refused, and one day he overheard them talking about "Father" and the "mission." As they parted, he shared with them his view of the world: _"It's full of lies and falsehoods, and that is why we must find our own truth."_

![Image 775: Tower with a bright light and stained glass has a crowd of people looking up at it in a cartoon image](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/d44dd0b7396f2f1a18c350b1e58e8394_3429944331062021140.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In addition, there was a box for a "high-altitude escape" trick in the workshop. During this trick, the magician slots themselves into a magic box in full view of the audience. The box is then suspended high in the air, and a short while later, the base automatically opens. At this point, a dummy will fall out of the box, but it looks real enough to grab the audience's attention, and they start wailing and screaming. Meanwhile, the real magician, who has by now blended into the crowd, waits for a good moment to make their appearance and puts on a hysterical performance: _"Oh no! Is that me!? Did I just fall to my death!?"_ The audience's gaze then turns to the magician, and by the time they realize what's happened, the dummy has vanished — as if everything that just happened was some sort of shared illusion. Cesar himself invented this trick but was never able to perform it. When the box opened, it was not the dummy that fell out, but the magician himself. The box was hanging under the highest point of the opera house, and Cesar fell down from there. Since he was an ordinary man without a Vision, he could not hope to survive that fall.

![Image 776: A blue-lit room with a chair surrounded by balloons](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/854b78664bac19993a3afbb48633f436_2902605763594240420.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Cesar constructed the box for the performance himself. Inside, there was a device that only the magician himself would know about. Once the magician is inside and the box is lifted up into the air, the audience's view of the box is fixed at a certain angle. From where they're standing, they have a clear view of the front, sides, and bottom, but the back and the top are no longer visible. At this point, the magician presses a button inside the box, opening a secret door out of view. For the trick to succeed, the magician must constantly keep the audience in suspense. Many days and nights of careful research and painstaking practice would have gone into this, all culminating in a performance just a few minutes long, but one that still manages to transform the shock and grief of a tragic accident into the joy and laughter of a mesmerizing magic trick.

![Image 777: A golden, ornate clock hangs in the middle of a whimsical, illustrated background featuring planets, stars, and a carousel](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/32433c0810fa2939c80f3845ede4b64d_4614309716793006158.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The magic box Cesar was using at the time of his death had the secret button positioned on the right-hand side, and he always used his right hand as his dominant hand in public. However, most of the props were equipped with mechanisms on the left-hand side, and the box in the workshop also had a button on the left. Cesar pretended to be right-handed, since a magician can't afford to have their most basic habits stand out too much. People naturally focus their attention on the most important details of the task or situation at hand, but a magician needs to be able to redirect an audience's attention at will, so as to avoid arousing their suspicion. The essence of magic is getting people to believe a lie. If even the truth raises eyebrows, the falsehoods become all the more difficult to mask. Cesar had to pretend to be right-handed so that the audience did not notice anything. But in his most stressful and nerve-wracking moments, and when no one was watching, a reflex would kick in, and he'd use his left hand, so he placed the button in the box on the left.

![Image 778: Interior scene of a large room with a high ceiling with red drapes, golden gears and pillars, gift boxes, playing cards, and balloons on a red carpet](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/e5380bd4b5b67fd8dd7e1e9304d593d1_8475401829466710368.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

During the trick, Cesar had to get a dummy in a matter of seconds, throw it down to distract the audience, and then open a secret door and get out. Someone took advantage of the fact that he was left-handed and switched the box. When the magician reached for the button with his left hand, it was not there. He spent a few extra seconds searching, and then the bottom of the box automatically opened.

Only a person close to Cesar had access to the props and knew which hand was Cesar's dominant, as close as his student Lorenzo was. It was his people who threatened Jemma and Lyney. He admitted that he hated Cesar because he forbade him from using tricks to get rich, while he poured everything into his street performances. Every other apprentice was living it up at their master's expense, but Lorenzo lived in poverty. He was afraid to leave since one word from Cesar could ruin his life, so he decided to kill his mentor. Lorenzo also admitted that he was The Weasel, but Lyney did not believe him.

![Image 779: Four children wearing blue and brown outfits stand outside a large stone building in Genshin Impact](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/9a9c14f5a9824fbde045f15f2224df0a_4941767773692007662.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The next day, during Lyney's performance, Lynette accused Jemma of being The Weasel all along. Her parents died young, and the orphan had to fend for herself. She'd scrounge waste paper from garbage bins to draw on, using twigs and dirt for lack of ink and pen. She'd sew ugly ragdolls from whatever scrap material she could get her hands on. At that tender age, she should have been happy, instead, she stood in the shadows and watched with envy as all good things in the world passed her by. Her pain became a breeding ground for dark thoughts, and she began to hate people's happiness, be it rich or poor. 

![Image 780: Two people in elaborate outfits stand in front of a building](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/ad6e883acad6d3275f6e298717ef4fbe_3758304263417455177.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

At the time when The Weasel was terrorizing the entire Court of Fontaine, the police were deploying more and more forces to stop her. So, The Weasel came up with a cunning plan: to hang her crimes on someone else, and she settled on a renowned magician, Cesar. She deceived him into trusting her and realized that the magician had a pupil who harbored a grudge against him. At her encouragement, Lorenzo tampered with Cesar's magic box, causing him to fall to his death. Afterward, Lorenzo seized his master's property, and The Weasel set about tarnishing Cesar's reputation. Over time, Lorenzo began to be tormented by guilt, but Jemma, remaining free, could take care of his loved ones, so he could not reveal her secret.

![Image 781: Three cartoon people in hats standing on the stage of a circus-themed theater with props and balloons](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/541f38464b1f23bae886861f68cfbecc_1247595964134204938.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Neither Lorenzo nor Jemma wrote the threatening letter, as Lyney himself wrote it with a message to The Weasel. Lyney and Lynette were the children who learned magic tricks from Cesar. They remembered the good he had done for them, so they decided to clear his name of crimes he had not committed. Lyney remembered Cesar's advice to find his truth. Truth can take many forms — prized possessions with nostalgic value, fervent hopes and dreams, and irreplaceable people. For Lyney, this truth was Lynette. Life took many things from Jemma, and the wounds in her heart could no longer heal. Stealing helped her forget and ease the pain, but after Cesar's death, she stopped stealing. Lorenzo was willing to give everything up for Jemma's sake, and all these years, he helped ease the pain that only theft could previously cope with. Besides the murder, they were the only friends each other had, and deep down, Lorenzo was her "truth" that nothing could replace. As Lyney had promised, he took the thing most dear from Jemma — Lorenzo.
_"Congratulations on your freedom, Jemma._

_Your freedom will cost you dearly. From now on, you'll be all alone in a world full of lies and falsehoods. I do hope you'll be able to bear it — you've still got a long life ahead of you, after all."_

![Image 782: An anime-style image featuring a man in a top hat and long coat standing on a platform beneath a large, ornate clock tower](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/08/18/237301566/b6068bda26f5706f1579698404535e21_6888700832704576636.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In Cesar's memory, Lyney performed the "high-altitude escape" trick, and the morning after the performance, Jemma surrendered to the Gardes. Her last wish was to see Lorenzo again.

10.title: Fontaine Underwater Exploration Locations and Tips - Genshin Impact Guide - IGN
10.description: Half of Genshin Impact's Fontaine region in underneath the waves. Luckily, you can swim through Fontaine's underwater areas without having to worry
10.content:
advertisement

Half of Genshin Impact's Fontaine region in underneath the waves. Luckily, you can swim through Fontaine's underwater areas without having to worry about oxygen. Your only problem is aggressive stingrays - and perhaps not knowing every underwater mechanic.

This Genshin Impact **Fontaine underwater exploration guide** will show you where to go and what to do in the nation of Hydro.

How to Swim in Fontaine
-----------------------

First things first; your swimming ability works a bit differently once you're in Fontaine. As long as you're in the region, **you can't drown** by exhausting your stamina. Your new stamina bar (which is blue instead of yellow) is still depleted by using the sprint button (swimming faster) though.

You will immediately unlock your new swimming ability by interacting with a Statue of the Seven in Fontaine.

Fontaine Underwater Map
-----------------------

Although you can dive anywhere in Fontaine as long as the water is deep enough, including certain cave areas, you'll be doing most of your underwater exploration in the large ocean. If you dive down and open your map in the southern part of Fontaine, you'll see the following underwater region:

As you can see, some underwater areas are quite shallow, while others have deep trenches. The trenches are great places to farm materials, find puzzles, or discover caves.

As of Genshin Impact version 4.1, the underwater map has received an expansion towards the north:

In Genshin Impact Version 4.2, another major underwater area was added to the eastern part of Fontaine:

### Other Fontaine Underwater Locations

The following Fontaine underwater maps are smaller than the main ocean, but still very much worth exploring:

*    Merusea Village, in the Beryl region. This area is locked behind the world quest called A Brush of Seafoam and Crimson.

*    The caves west of the Court of Fontaine. This area is accessed through an underwater tunnel and linked to the world quest called The Narzissenkreuz Adventure.

*    The ruins in the middle of the ocean. You'll unlock them through the Aqueous Tidemarks world quest.

*    The Fortress of Meropide, in The Liffey Region. You'll reach this underwater prison during Archon Quest Chapter 4, Act 3. 

*    The underwater tunnels below The Liffey Region. Go through a tunnel east of the [Millennial Pearl Seahorse boss arena](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Millennial_Pearl_Seahorse), and you'll discover this area. 

Fontaine Underwater Exploration Mechanics
-----------------------------------------

Fontaine's underwater region is full of puzzles and enemies - not so different from the rest of Teyvat, in other words. To fight enemies, you can use a normal attack, but this isn't very effective. Luckily, you can "borrow" certain abilities from underwater creatures called the Xenochromatic Hunter's Ray/Blubberbeast/Armored Crab/Jellyfish.

The best way to become more powerful in underwater combat is by using a **Hunter's Ray ability**. Find a blue ray (as shown in the picture below, left side), hit it with a normal attack to gain its ability, and use your Skill button to trigger this ability. Using this on opponents will hit them with a Hydro blade, thus quickly depleting their HP.

Alternatively, you can use a **Blubberbeast ability**, which releases a string of soundwaves if you hold down the Skill button. The blubberbeast is shown on the right side of the picture.

Fontaine's underwater region is also full of breakable rocks (indicated by their blue glow). To break them, you need to use the **Armored Crab ability**, as shown in the middle of the picture. It works the same way: hit the crab, then use your Skill to trigger the ability.

Since the release of Genshin Impact 4.1, you may encounter **blue jellyfish** as well (see picture above). The jellyfish ability allows you to drop a bomb and explode it whenever you like. Press the Skill button once to fire a bomb, press twice for the explosion.

Genshin Impact Version 4.2 added the **xenochromatic ball octopus** ability, which is found both underwater and on land. The octopus ability is typically found near puzzles, as it grants you the power to move objects (such as dew bubbles), use its energy to charge puzzle mechanisms, and cleanse corrupted locations.

The most common underwater puzzles are pneumousia puzzles. They typically require you to pick up yellow (Pneuma) and purple (Ousia) orbs, then use a normal attack on mechanisms of the opposing color. For a more detailed explanation, take a look at our [Pneuma and Ousia guide](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/How_to_Use_Pneuma_and_Ousia).

You may also encounter **Echoing Conches**, which can reveal hidden treasures upon interaction, and underwater currents. The currents often involve a **fantastical floating ball** challenge, which requires manipulation of the stream to move the ball. Oftentimes, the key to solving such a puzzle is to block the stream with your blue crab ability.

The eastern part of the underwater map, which was added in Genshin Impact 4.2, contains many **energy orb** puzzles (see picture above). To solve the puzzles, you typically need to use a nearby xenochromatic ball octopus’s ability to charge the energy orb and launch it in the correct direction.

Fontaine Underwater Exploration Tips
------------------------------------

Finally, here are some tips to make your underwater adventures in Fontaine a success:

*    Pick up recovery orbs to recover your stamina. They're always surrounded by three yellow fishes (see picture below). 
*    Swim through Hydro rings for a speed boost. Yelan is swimming right in front of such as Hydro ring in the picture below.
*    Watch out for underwater turrets (left side of the picture)! If you encounter one, use the blue crab ability to destroy it.

12.title: Genshin Impact Version 4.1 Continues to Reveal More Areas and Stories of Fontaine on September 27
12.content:
![Image 1: Characters from Genshin Impact including Arlecchino, Wriothesley, Furina, Neuvillette and Aether are featured as the main characters for the Genshin Impact Version 4.2](https://fastcdn.hoyoverse.com/content-v2/plat/113183/d0bb935d016c47d477f24d6eef778839_1803146625092229021.jpeg)

Global interactive entertainment brand HoYoverse has announced that Genshin Impact Version 4.1 update "To the Stars Shining in the Depths" will arrive on September 27. Fontaine will expand northward, where the main story continues with Neuvillette and Wriothesley joining the cast of playable characters, as well as the Fatui Harbinger "Arlecchino" making her debut. Rewards including Intertwined Fates ×10, Primogems ×1,600, and 2 exclusive gadgets will be issued as Genshin Impact celebrates its three-year anniversary with fans and players around the world.

Check out Genshin Impact Version 4.1 trailer here:

[https://youtu.be/i7wgl1v1_5M](https://youtu.be/i7wgl1v1_5M)

Following the introduction of the prosperous Court of Fontaine, the upcoming northern area will reveal the history and mystery of the nation from different perspectives. Concealed in the deep sea, the Fortress of Meropide holds not only exiles from all over Fontaine but also vital functions and mysteries. The latest Archon Quest will pick up here as the Traveler searches for Childe. Floating in mid-air, the "Allogravity-Condensed Water Bodies" and ruins tell of a deadly attempt by the Fontaine Research Institute to survive a prophesied great flood.

Dangers await as players explore the new underwater area and ruins. The new Boss Enemy "Millennial Pearl Seahorse" is a beautiful beast that deals Electro damage. Another Boss Enemy "Experimental Field Generator" is an out-of-control research device used to counteract the effects of gravity, giving players the ability to leap higher and evade its attacks.

Two Fontaine characters in high positions will both become playable as five-star Catalyst wielders, and players can find out more about them in their Story Quests. Neuvillette, the Iudex of Fontaine, can unleash straight-line surging torrents dealing Hydro damage via Charged Attacks, and Wriothesley, the Administrator of the Fortress of Meropide, is adept at using melee attacks to deal Cryo damage. Both characters are capable of consuming health to cast certain types of attacks and then recovering their health afterwards. Neuvillette and Hu Tao will be available in the first round of Event Wishes, followed by Wriothesley and Venti.

In addition to the adventure in Fontaine, a poetry festival in Mondstadt and Liyue offers a good opportunity to reunite with friends and honor friendship and love. The festival also features various mini-games and an exclusive 4-star Catalyst to be redeemed.

More rewards can be claimed as Genshin Impact's third anniversary approaches. The special daily login event is back with up to Intertwined Fates ×10 and other bonuses. During Version 4.1, players can also check their in-game mailbox to claim Primogems ×1,600, Fragile Resin ×4, and two unique gadgets "Portable Aerodynamic Gelatinous Bubble Generator" and "Itty Bitty Octobaby."

Genshin Impact Version 4.1 will be arriving on September 27. With cross-progression and Co-Op functions, players can enjoy their adventure across PlayStation®, PC, Android, and iOS. The game has been rated T for Teen by ESRB on PS5, PS4, PC, and Google Play, and 12+ on iOS. For more information, please visit Genshin Impact's official website (genshin.hoyoverse.com) or follow @GenshinImpact on Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook.

9.title: How to Use Pneuma and Ousia - Genshin Impact Guide - IGN
9.description: The Genshin Impact Fontaine region is full of mysterious orbs called Pneuma and Ousia. Together, Genshin Impact's Pneuma and Ousia are used to solve
9.content:
advertisement

The Genshin Impact Fontaine region is full of mysterious orbs called Pneuma and Ousia. Together, Genshin Impact's Pneuma and Ousia are used to solve Pneumousia puzzles. Yes, that probably sounds quite complicated, but it's actually not that difficult to use Pneuma and Ousia once you've got the hang of it.

This Genshin Impact **Pneuma and Ousia guide** will help you understand this Fontaine-based exploration mechanism.

9:31

Autoplay setting: On

[Genshin Impact Lynette Guide - Best Builds, Weapons, Artifacts, and Teams](https://www.ign.com/videos/genshin-impact-lynette-guide-best-builds-weapons-artifacts-and-teams)
Pneuma and Ousia Explained
--------------------------

While traveling through Fontaine, you'll encounter purple and yellow glowing orbs. They are called the Pneuma and Ousia Blocks: the **Pneuma Block** is yellow, while the **Ousia Block** is purple. Your character can collect these blocks and release their energy through normal, charged, or plunging attacks.

The energy from Pneuma and Ousia orbs is also known as **Arkhe** energy or **Pneumousia energy**. There are two main reasons why you would need to use this mechanic:

*    To gain a combat advantage.
*    To solve a puzzle.

### Pneuma and Ousia Attacks

The **Mek opponents** in Fontaine are aligned with either Pneuma or Ousia energy. This includes enemies such as an Underwater Survey Mek, an Assault Specialist Mek, or a Recon Log Mek.

You can see which type of Arkhe these enemies have by looking at their colors: do they have a **purple glow**? This means they have Ousia alignment. Do they have a **yellow glow**? This means they have Pneuma Arkhe. The opponents in the picture below, for example, have Pneuma Arkhe.

If you use the opposite type against them, you can quickly gain the upper hand by creating an **annihilation reaction**, which causes an Overloaded effect and decreases the opponent's energy.

### Pneuma and Ousia Puzzles

While exploring Fontaine, you will come across pneumousia puzzles, including the pneumousia relay and pneumousia storage box. The key to solving these puzzles is usually the same; look at their glow (purple or yellow) and **hit them with the opposite energy type**.

For example, you may encounter the pneumousia relay puzzle shown in the picture above. It has both purple and yellow pneumousia relays: pick up a purple Ousia orb and hit the yellow **Pneuma relay** to balance it (turning it blue). Likewise, pick up a yellow Pneuma orb and hit the purple **Ousia relay**. This will solve the puzzle.

Innate Arkhe Characters
-----------------------

Some Genshin Impact characters have **innate Arkhe**, which means that they are inherently aligned with either Pneuma or Ousia, and don't need to pick up Pneuma or Ousia blocks. Only characters from Fontaine and the Hydro Traveler have such Arkhe powers.

Here's an overview of the current Arkhe characters and their alignment:

*   **Hydro Traveler**: Pneuma
*   **Lyney**: Pneuma
*   **Lynette**: Ousia

                Home/ Tutorial/ Arkhe - Pneuma & Ousia      Arkhe - Pneuma & Ousia
      Gameplay Research
      A useful Fontainian mechanism for both exploration and combat that uses two opposing forces: Pneuma and Ousia      Attributes         Name Arkhe: Pneuma and Ousia   Type Combat and Exploration Knowledge   Region Fontaine   Version Released 4.0   Related Entries
      Pneuma, Ousia, and Their Mutual Annihilation

      Underwater Pneumousia Energies...
        Arkhe       Arkhe is one of the main energy sources used in Fontaine. Fontainian vision holders inherit either Pneuma or Ousia alignment as a special attribute while Hydro Traveler has Pneuma alignment. It consists of two opposing forces: Pneuma and Ousia.PneumaOusia            When Pneuma Aligned energy meets Ousia Aligned energy, an Annihilation reaction will be triggered. The Annihilation reaction as a special interaction is useful in both exploration and combat.Obtaining an Arkhe alignmentThere are two ways to get a Pneuma or Ousia alignment:Fontainian characters and Hydro Traveler have an innate Arkhe alignmentThe player can pick up Pneumousia blocks while exploring Fontaine.Any character can pick up a Pneuma or Ousia block and obtain the specific alignment for 60s. It will remain despite teleporting to a different location or swapping the deployed team, or until another block is picked up. Fontainian characters can use their specific attacks to immediately trigger the effect corresponding to their Arkhe with a fixed cooldown. They can also pick up either blocks regardless of their innate alignment.    Picking up a Pneuma energy block will give Pneuma alignment    Picking up an Ousia energy block will give the Ousia alignment    Picking up an Ousia energy block while having obtained Pneuma alignment previously will cause AnnihilationApplicationLand ExplorationArkhe application with characters with innate alignmentFontainian characters and Hydro Traveler can apply Arkhe when they use a specific attack dependent on the specific character. It can be Normal Attack (Ex:    Furina,    Clorinde), Elemental Skill (Ex:    Traveler (Hydro),    Lynette), Ultimate Skill (Ex:    Wriothesley)When used according to the specifications, Arkhe is applied in a follow up attack that can deal Elemental DMG without Elemental application. Pneuma aligned characters release "Spiritbreath Thorns" while Ousia aligned characters release "Surging Blades". They have a separate cooldown and do not require a target to be unleashed.Pneuma - Spiritbreath ThornsOusia - Surging Blades            Spiritbreath Thorn and Surging Blade deal AoE damage, so they can trigger many Annihilation reactions at once.Arkhe application using Pneumousia blocksWhen a character picks up a Pneumousia block, the next Normal / Charged / Plunging Attack that hits an Arkhe aligned object or any enemy will apply the stored energy without dealing additional DMG. Bow users can use an Aimed shot to apply the Arkhe.Using Ousia energy on a Pneuma aligned enemyUsing Ousia energy on a Pneuma aligned object        Underwater ExplorationArkhe application with characters with innate alignmentWhen underwater, Normal Attacks are replaced with Transoceanic Sourcewater attacks, which can be used to release Arkhe energy. If the character has an innate Arkhe alignment, the Transoceanic Sourcewater will shine differently depending on the Arkhe alignment.Appearance of Transoceanic Sourcewater with a Pneuma aligned characterAppearance of Transoceanic Sourcewater with an Ousia aligned character        Arkhe application using Pneumousia blocks     Characters with innate Arkhe alignment can trigger energies without the use of Pneumousia Blocks.    If a character with an innate Arkhe alignment picks up a Pneumousia block getting the opposite Arkhe, the next attack will apply Pneuma and Ousia at the same time.CharactersThe Arkhe alignments of characters can be confirmed by several methods: the design of their vision, character preview page and Combat Talent page.Pneuma aligned Hydro Vision bearerOusia aligned Hydro Vision bearer        Characters with Arkhe alignmentCharacterArkhe alignment and Talent
      Traveler (Hydro)
             Alignment: PneumaVersion Released: 4.0Type: Elemental SkillTalent: After using Torrent Surge, a Spiritbreath Thorn is unleashed dealing Pneuma-aligned Hydro DMG (CD: 9s).
      Lynette
             Alignment: OusiaVersion Released: 4.0Type: Elemental SkillTalent: When she uses Enigma Thrust, a Surging Blade is unleashed dealing Ousia-aligned Anemo DMG (CD: 10s).
      Lyney
             Alignment: PneumaVersion Released: 4.0Type: Charged Attack - Level II aim attackTalent: The Prop Arrow causes a Spiritbreath Thorn to descend upon its hit location dealing Pneuma-aligned Pyro DMG (CD: 6s).
      Freminet
             Alignment: PneumaVersion Released: 4.0Type: Elemental Skill - Initial attackTalent: After using the upward thrust, a Spiritbreath Thorn in the form of another upward thrust is created dealing Pneuma-aligned Cryo DMG (CD: 9s).
      Neuvillette
             Alignment: PneumaVersion Released: 4.1Type: Elemental SkillTalent: When the Raging Waterfall descends, a Spiritbreath Thorn descends piercing enemies and dealing Pneuma-aligned Hydro DMG (CD: 15s).
      Wriothesley
             Alignment: OusiaVersion Released: 4.1Type: Elemental BurstTalent: After Icicle Impact ends, a Surging Blade will descend upon the opponent’s position dealing Ousia-aligned Cryo DMG (CD: 10s).
      Furina
         Ousia alignment    Pneuma alignment    Alignment: Pneuma and OusiaVersion Released: 4.2Type: Normal AttackTalent: When Furina’s Normal Attack hits, a Spiritbreath Thorn or a Surging Blade will descend based on her Arkhe alignment dealing Hydro DMG (CD: 6s).Furina's default alignment is Ousia. She can switch between alignments using Charged Attacks.
      Charlotte
             Alignment: PneumaVersion Released: 4.2Type: Charged AttackTalent: Upon using a Charged Attack, a Spiritbreath Thorn will descend and pierce opponents dealing Pneuma-aligned AoE Cryo DMG (CD: 6s).
      Navia
             Alignment: OusiaVersion Released: 4.3Type: Elemental SkillTalent: When Navia fires her Gunbrella, a Surging Blade will be summoned, dealing Ousia-aligned Geo DMG (CD: 7s).
      Chevreuse (Coming Soon)
             Alignment: OusiaVersion Released: 4.3Type: Elemental SkillTalent: After Chevreuse's Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire hits, a Surging Blade will be called forth that deals Ousia-aligned Pyro DMG (CD: 10s).
      Clorinde
             Alignment: OusiaVersion Released: 4.7Type: Normal Attack after Elemental SkillTalent: When Clorinde's Swift Hunt shots strike, a Surging Blade will be called forth that deals Ousia-aligned Electro DMG (CD: 10s).
      Sigewinne
             Alignment: OusiaVersion Released: 4.7Type: Elemental SkillTalent: Upon using Sigewinne's Blostering Bubblebalms, a Surging Blade will be called forth that deals Ousia-aligned Hydro DMG (CD: 10s).
      Emilie
             Alignment: PneumaVersion Released: 4.8Type: Elemental SkillTalent: After Emilie creates a Lumidouce Case using Fragrance Extraction, a Spiritbreath Thorn will descend in front of her and pierce her opponent, dealing Pneuma-aligned Dendro DMG (CD: 10s).
      Escoffier
             Alignment: OusiaVersion Released: 5.6Type: Elemental SkillTalent: After Escoffier activates her Cooking Mek in Cold Storage mode, a Surging Blade will be summoned, dealing Ousia-aligned Cryo DMG (CD: 10s).Weapons    When a character with innate Arkhe alignment is equipped with a Fontaine weapon, the weapon will emit a glow according to the character's specific Arkhe alignment.Weapons providing Arkhe alignmentSword of Narzissenkreuz
      Sword of Narzissenkreuz
             The weapon can be obtained by completing    Rowboat's WakeWhen the equipping character does not have an Arkhe: When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, or Plunging Attacks strike, a Pneuma or Ousia energy blast will be unleashed, dealing 160%/200%/240%/280%/320% of ATK as DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. The energy blast type is determined by the current type of the Sword of Narzissenkreuz.EnemiesBoss EnemyEnemyDescriptionIcewind Suite - Dirge of Coppelia
      Icewind Suite
             During Climax, Coppelia becomes Ousia-aligned, increasing the RES to all DMG by 25% during all 3 sequences of attacks while uninterrupted.Attacking with a Pneuma-aligned attack removes the RES increase and Her wind pulses's AoE and DMG will decrease (to 60%).3 Pneuma-aligned hits during a single Climax will interrupt it and stun the enemy for a short period of time.Icewind Suite - Nemesis of Coppelius
      Icewind Suite
             During Climax, Coppelius receives a Pneuma-aligned Cryo shield.Attacking with an Ousia-aligned attack will immediately break the shield.3 Ousia-aligned hits during a single Climax will interrupt it and stun the enemy for a short period of time.Experimental Field Generator
      Experimental Field Generator
             When the enemy teleports to the center of the arena and decreases the strength of gravity, it becomes Ousia-aligned and creates shockwaves that deals Geo DMG.3 Pneuma-aligned hits will interrupt it and the gravity will be restored.All-Devouring Narwhal
      All-Devouring Narwhal
                 While facing the enemy, it summons the Eye of the Maelstrom to deal AoE Hydro DMG.If the Eye of the Maelstrom is hit by by an Arkhe attack (8 non-Arkhe attacks), it will be destroyed and the Fury gauge will increase by a quarter.While facing the black shadow, an Eye of the Maelstrom will be charging up to deal Hydro, Electro or Pyro DMG. If it gets hit by an Arkhe attack, it will be destroyed and the shadow will lose 25% of its Max HP.Normal and Elite EnemiesEnemyDetailsAbyss EnemiesEnemies shares the same mechanism and 1 Arkhe (Pneuma or Ousia) attack can instantly destroy and paralyze the enemy for a long period of time.Large Shatterstone Breacher Primus & Shatterstone Breacher Primus
      Large Shatterstone Breacher Primus

      Shatterstone Breacher Primus
         When the enemy enters a stressed state periodically, it will gain a Geo shield.Large Overgrown Breacher Primus & Overgrown Breacher Primus
      Large Overgrown Breacher Primus

      Overgrown Breacher Primus
         When the enemy enters a stressed state periodically, it will gain a Dendro shield.Automaton EnemiesEnemies can be either Pneuma or Ousia and their alignments are distinguishable with attack patterns or its color.After a certain number of Annihilation reactions triggered on a specific enemy, it will lose its Arkhe alignment.Recon Log Mek
      Recon Log Mek
         Pneuma: Fires an AoE Electro bomb with delayOusia: Fires an AoE Electro trapAnnihilation reactions needed: 1Result: Unable to use elemental attacks for a period of timeGeological Survey Mek
      Geological Survey Mek
         Pneuma: Fires 3 consecutive Hydro projectilesOusia: Releases 3 consecutive AoE Geo shockwavesAnnihilation reactions needed: 1Result: Unable to use elemental attacks for a period of timeNimble Harvester Mek
      Nimble Harvester Mek
         Pneuma: Charges at the player with Anemo infusionOusia: Launches Geo dirt at the playerAnnihilation reaction needed: 1Result: Unable to use elemental attacks for a period of timeArea Alert Mek

      Suppression Specialist Mek
         Pneuma: Uses Dendro attacksOusia: Uses Pyro attacksAnnihilation reaction needed: 2Result: Unable to use elemental attacks for a period of timeAssault Specialist Mek

      Deepwater Assault Mek
         Pneuma: Launches an Anemo projectileOusia: Launches 2 homing Physical projectilesAnnihilation reaction needed: 1Result: Unable to attack for a period of time   Related Mechanisms       Mechanisms with Arkhe alignments can be dealt with by triggering Annihilation reaction on the puzzle using the opposite Arkhe alignment. A bow character can be helpful to apply the specific Arkhe energy from a distance.MechanismDescriptionPneumousia Storage Box    Showcase    A super-safe storage box that absolutely cannot be opened in any way!Tutorial:    Pneumousia Storage BoxPneumousia Relay    Showcase    A mysterious clockwork meka device created by the special energy system produced by Fontaine. It possesses three energy states: Ousia, Balanced, and Pneuma, respectively.Tutorial:    Pneumousia RelayThe Miraculous Antoine Roger Aircraft    Showcase    This is an experimental Aircraft that is propelled by energy generated from Pneumaousia Annihilation reactions. It will proceed along its set route upon being activated.Tutorial:    The Miraculous Antoine Roger Aircraft!Fixed Storage Device and Energy Transfer Device    Showcase    Storage devices can provide energy to Transfer and Research Terminals. Some devices are infused with an Arkhe alignment and requires Annihilation to activate.Tutorial:    Fixed Storage Device and Energy Transfer DeviceEnhanced Pneumousia Amplifier    This device will grant powerful buffs to the troublesome opponents faced by adventurers or bandits.Tutorial:    Enhanced Pneumousia AmplifierMiscellaneous    Showcase    Attacking the core of the device with the opposite Arkhe alignments will trigger Annihilation reaction which will spawn waves of enemies to defeat, after which the core will take the opposite Arkhe alignment.The process must be repeated until the anomalies are stabilized.The mechanism can be found both on land and underwater.   Miscellaneous Findings       Dual ApplicationWith the use of a Pneumousia block,    Lyney can to apply Arkhe twice. Through The Prop Arrow, he can unleash a Spiritbreath Thorn alongside another Spiritbreath Thorn/Surging Blade depending on the alignment of the Pneumousia block.Lyney with a Pneuma block    Lyney with an Ousia block    Non-Reactive Arkhe    Even though Arkhe application deals elemental damage, it does not apply said element and are thus unable to trigger Elemental Reactions.Co-op Mode    In Co-op mode, Arkhe will act independently and consider players separately. When collecting a Pneumousia block, only the player who collects it will receive the alignment and thus, the Arkhe will only trigger when the player with infusion applies it. Annihilation reaction will also not be triggered if different players collect the opposite alignments.Arkhe Infusion    When the player picks up a Pneumousia block and acquire Arkhe alignment, it can last for 60s when not applied, regardless of party deployment, active character defeat, and teleportation. The player can take advantage of it to complete the puzzles.           Submitted Draft
         Arkhe is one of the main energy sources used in Fontaine. Fontainian vision holders inherit either Pneuma or Ousia alignment as a special attribute while Hydro Traveler has Pneuma alignment. It consists of two opposing forces: Pneuma and Ousia.PneumaOusia            When Pneuma Aligned energy meets Ousia Aligned energy, an Annihilation reaction will be triggered. The Annihilation reaction as a special interaction is useful in both exploration and combat.Obtaining an Arkhe alignmentThere are two ways to get a Pneuma or Ousia alignment:Fontainian characters and Hydro Traveler have an innate Arkhe alignmentThe player can pick up Pneumousia blocks while exploring Fontaine.Any character can pick up a Pneuma or Ousia block and obtain the specific alignment for 60s. It will remain despite teleporting to a different location or swapping the deployed team, or until another block is picked up. Fontainian characters can use their specific attacks to immediately trigger the effect corresponding to their Arkhe with a fixed cooldown. They can also pick up either blocks regardless of their innate alignment.    Picking up a Pneuma energy block will give Pneuma alignment    Picking up an Ousia energy block will give the Ousia alignment    Picking up an Ousia energy block while having obtained Pneuma alignment previously will cause AnnihilationApplicationLand ExplorationArkhe application with characters with innate alignmentFontainian characters and Hydro Traveler can apply Arkhe when they use a specific attack dependent on the specific character. It can be Normal Attack (Ex:    Furina,    Clorinde), Elemental Skill (Ex:    Traveler (Hydro),    Lynette), Ultimate Skill (Ex:    Wriothesley)When used according to the specifications, Arkhe is applied in a follow up attack that can deal Elemental DMG without Elemental application. Pneuma aligned characters release "Spiritbreath Thorns" while Ousia aligned characters release "Surging Blades". They have a separate cooldown and do not require a target to be unleashed.Pneuma - Spiritbreath ThornsOusia - Surging Blades            Spiritbreath Thorn and Surging Blade deal AoE damage, so they can trigger many Annihilation reactions at once.Arkhe application using Pneumousia blocksWhen a character picks up a Pneumousia block, the next Normal / Charged / Plunging Attack that hits an Arkhe aligned object or any enemy will apply the stored energy without dealing additional DMG. Bow users can use an Aimed shot to apply the Arkhe.Using Ousia energy on a Pneuma aligned enemyUsing Ousia energy on a Pneuma aligned object        Underwater ExplorationArkhe application with characters with innate alignmentWhen underwater, Normal Attacks are replaced with Transoceanic Sourcewater attacks, which can be used to release Arkhe energy. If the character has an innate Arkhe alignment, the Transoceanic Sourcewater will shine differently depending on the Arkhe alignment.Appearance of Transoceanic Sourcewater with a Pneuma aligned characterAppearance of Transoceanic Sourcewater with an Ousia aligned character        Arkhe application using Pneumousia blocks     Characters with innate Arkhe alignment can trigger energies without the use of Pneumousia Blocks.    If a character with an innate Arkhe alignment picks up a Pneumousia block getting the opposite Arkhe, the next attack will apply Pneuma and Ousia at the same time.CharactersThe Arkhe alignments of characters can be confirmed by several methods: the design of their vision, character preview page and Combat Talent page.Pneuma aligned Hydro Vision bearerOusia aligned Hydro Vision bearer        Characters with Arkhe alignmentCharacterArkhe alignment and Talent

19.content:
advertisement

Genshin Impact Version 4.2, **Masquerade of the Guilty**, is here. This update continues **the adventure in Fontaine**, with a focus on some different Fontaine characters. Yep, that's right, it's time to a welcome Furina and Charlotte home!

This page acts as a breakdown for everything new in the 4.2 Update for Genshin Impact.

11:03

Autoplay setting: On

[Genshin Impact Freminet Guide - Best Builds, Weapons, Artifacts, and Teams](https://www.ign.com/videos/genshin-impact-freminet-guide-best-builds-weapons-artifacts-and-teams)
Genshin Impact Version 4.2: Masquerade of the Guilty
[**4.2 Release Date**](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Patch_Notes#Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Release_Date)
[**New Characters**](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Patch_Notes#Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_New_Characters)[**New Areas**](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Patch_Notes#Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_New_Areas)
[**New Story**](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Patch_Notes#Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_New_Story)[**New Events**](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Patch_Notes#Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_New_Event)
[**New Bosses and Enemies**](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Patch_Notes#New_Bosses_and_Enemies)[**New Weapons**](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Patch_Notes#New_Weapons)
[**Version 4.2 Patch Notes**](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Impact_Version_4.2_Patch_Notes#Version_4.2_Patch_Notes)

Genshin Impact Version 4.2 Release Date
---------------------------------------

The release date for Genshin Impact Version 4.2 is **November 8, 2023**.

Genshin Impact Version 4.2 New Characters
-----------------------------------------

Two new playable characters debuted in Version 4.2:

Furina Charlotte
✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦
**Vision**Hydro**Vision**Cryo
**Weapon**Sword**Weapon**Catalyst
**Elemental Skill**Salon Solitaire**Elemental Skill**Framing: Freezing Point Composition

### Furina Abilities

**Normal Attack:** Salon Solitaire: Invites guests of the Salon Solitaire to come forth and abet in her performance. This will summon either the three Salon Members (Ousia) or the Singer of Many Waters (Pneuma) based on Furinan’s current Arkhe alignment. Furina can change her Arkhe alignment via Charged Attacks.

**Elemental Skill:** Summons the Salon Members. The Salon members will attack nearby opponents, prioritizing the target of the active character. Their DMG increases the more characters there are in the party over a certain HP amount. Her Elemental Skill chances depending on whether she is aligned with Ousia or Pneuma. Her Elemental Skill summons the “Singer of Many Waters” to provide healing to nearby party members. The summons created by Furina’s Elemental Skill will remain on the field for a period of time even after Furina is switched out.

**Charged Attack:** Not only deals Physical DMG but also allows her to switch between Ousia and Pneuma Arkhe alignments. Furina uses her Charged Attack to switch to a Penuma Arkhe alignment.

**Elemental Burst:** Deals damage to surrounding opponents, and when the party members’ HP increases or decreases, Furina will accumulate Fanfare points. So Furina increases the DMG and the Incoming Healing Bonus of nearby party members based on the amount of Fanfare she has.

**Passive Talent:** Due to her knowledge of Deepwater Aberrants, Furina’s Passive Talent can decrease the cooldown on abilities gained from Xenochromatic Fontemer Aberrants. Whenever Furina’s summons is on the field, Furina gains the ability to walk on water.

### Charlotte Abilities

**Elemental Skill:** Framing: Freezing Point Composition: Using the keen instincts of an ace reporter, Charlotte showcases her photography skills with Monsieur Verite, dealing DMG to opponents in the viewfinder and applying Snappy Silhouette to them. During this effect’s duration, Snappy Silhouette will deal Cryo DMG to affected opponents at intervals. If you press and hold until the viewfinder expands to its maximum size and unlease your skill, this applies a Focused Impression, which lasts longer and deals more DMG.

**Elemental Burst:** Creates a Newsflash Field that continuously restores HP to party members within its range. Monsieur Verite will also join in and intermittently attack opponents during the duration of the ability.

**Passive Talent:**When paired with Fontaine characters, Charlotte receives a Healing Bonus, when paired with non-Fontaine characters, she receives a Cryo DMG Bonus.

**Zoom Lens:** Will trigger her Passive Talent called “First Person Shutter”. When you hold her Elemental Skill, the gadget will cause you to enter Photo Mode instead.

Genshin Impact 4.2 New Areas
----------------------------

The following new areas and their locales are available to explore in Version 4.2:

*   **Erinnyes Forest**
    *   **Loch Urania**
    *   **Foggy Forest Path**
    *   **Weeping Willow of the Lake**

*   **Morte Region**
    *   **Sealed Ruined Tower**

After the update, as long as Travelers have completed Archon Quest Prologue: Act III "Song of the Dragon and Freedom," a Teleport Waypoint will be automatically unlocked near Fontaine's Marcotte Station (If you have already completed this Archon Quest, the Teleport Waypoint will be unlocked after the update). You'll also receive the Primogem reward for this Teleport Waypoint when it unlocks automatically. If you've already unlocked this Waypoint, no new Waypoints will be unlocked.

Genshin Impact 4.2 New Story
----------------------------

Version 4.2 introduces the next chapter of the Archon Quest series, and several more World Quests set in the region of Fontaine:

| Version 4.2 New Archon Quests |
| --- |
|  |
| **Archon Quest Chapter IV Act V** "Masquerade of the Guilty" |
| _"Travelers will get to experience Act V of the Fontaine Archon Quest “Masquerade of the Guilty”. We’ll team up with Fontainian friends to delve deeper into the hurricane of events and face the impending destruction foretold by the prophecy. Travelers will gradually unveil new facts behind this crisis, and encounter an evil that has been lurking in the swirling depths.”_ |
| **Quest Unlock Criteria** | * Reach Adventure Rank 40 or above * Complete Archon Quest Chapter IV: Act IV "Cataclysm's Quickening" |
| **Furina's Story Quest Animula Choragi Chapter: Act I** "The Little Oceanid" |
| **Quest Unlock Criteria** | * Reach Adventure Rank 40 or above * Complete Archon Quest Chapter IV: Act V "Masquerade of the Guilty" |
| Version 4.2 World Quests |
| * Version 4.2 World Quest: The Wild Fairy of Erinnyes * Version 4.2 World Quest: Search in the Algae Sea * Continuation of the “Narzissenkreuz Adventure” questline * In the Wake of Narcissus Quest Chain * Questioning Melusine and Answering Machine * An Expected Plan * Wish-Fulfilling Treasure Hunt * Through the Looking Glass * Free Verse * Impromptu Poem of the Crimson Dawn |

Genshin Impact 4.2 New Events
-----------------------------

Version 4.2 introduces the following **new events** in Genshin Impact:

*    Thelxie’s Fantastic Adventures
*    Lil Fungi’s Fun-Tastic Fiesta
*    Graph Adversarial Technology Experiment Log
*    Misty Dungeon

New Bosses and Enemies
----------------------

*   **New Boss: Hydro Tulpa**
    *    Located in the Salacia Plain

*   **New Enemy Xenochromatic Ball Octopus**
    *    Travelers can borrow its abilities to cleanse away the contamination clots and contamination cores from the bacterial mats 

New Weapons
-----------

**Splendor of Tranquil Waters (5-Star Sword)**

*    When the equipping character's current HP increases or decreases, Elemental Skill DMG dealt will be increased by 8% for 6s. Max 3 stacks. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s. When other party members' current HP increases or decreases, the equipping character's Max HP will be increased by 14% for 6s. Max 2 stacks. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s. The aforementioned effects can be triggered even if the wielder is off-field.

Version 4.2 Patch Notes
-----------------------

*   **New Recipes:**
    *    Café Lutece, Fontaine: La Lettre a Focalors, Blubber Profiterole

*   **New Character Specialty Dishes:**
    *    Furina's specialty: "Pour la Justice"
    *    Charlotte's specialty: "Exclusive Scoop: Gourmet Column"

*    New Achievement categories such as "Fontaine: Dance of the Dew-White Springs (III)," and new Achievements added to the "Wonders of the World" category.
*    Adds some prompts for loading screens.
*   **New Namecards:**
    *    "Furina: Banquet": Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Furina
    *    "Charlotte: Exclusive": Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Charlotte

*    "Travel Notes: Whirling Waltz": Reward obtained via the BP system
*    "Fontaine: Completeness": Reward for completing all achievements under "Fontaine: Dance of the Dew-White Springs (III)"
*    New Fish: Maintenance Mek: Gold Leader
*    Adds Set 27 of "Paimon's Paintings" chat emojis.
*    New Gadget "Special Analysis Zoom Lens": after equipping this accessory, a normal Kamera can quickly adjust its focus. 
    *    Obtained after completing the World Quest "The Long-Failed 'Graph Adversarial Technology'..." after completing the event "Graph Adversarial Technology Experiment Log."

*    Increases custom marker limit to 200, and adds the batch marker deletion feature.
*    Adds the "Trounce Domain: Quick Challenge" function: once you reach Adventure Rank 40, you can Quick Challenge locked Trounce Domains through your Adventurer Handbook in Single Player Mode.
*    Adds the "Lower Difficulty" feature for Domains containing powerful enemies in quests: this feature can be activated by voluntarily leaving the Domain or after failing the challenge. The next time you start this challenge, you will start at the lower difficulty.
*    Fountain of Lucine: Increase in the Level Cap of Fountain of Lucine to Level 40.
*    "Genius Invokation TCG" Gameplay Update: 
    *    New Character Cards: Dori, Nilou, Baizhu, and their corresponding Talent cards.
    *    New invitation duels and guest challenges added to the Player List.
    *    New Action Cards: "Shadow of the Sand King," "Ocean-Hued Clam," "Stormterror's Lair," "Lyresong," and "In Every House a Stove."
    *    Adds "Deck Sharing Code" feature: in the "Edit" or "Preview Deck" menu, you can view the share code of the current deck or use the share code to import a corresponding deck, create a new deck or overwrite the current deck.
    *    The maximum number of decks in the "Deck List" will be increased to 20. The initial deck limit as well as the deck limit unlocked by increasing Player Level will be increased to 4.

*   **Adds the "Accelerate Duel" function:**
    *    (1) The new "Accelerate Duel" feature will be available in the Settings interface during duels.
    *    (2) Once enabled, dice roll animations, round hints, and other interface animations will be accelerated.

*    The Forge Realm's Temper is once again available. The theme of this edition is "The Forge Realm's Temper: Endless Swarm": 
    *    (1) Defeat endless waves of enemies during the rounds in "The Forge Realm's Temper: Endless Swarm" to accrue score.
    *    (2) After you complete the stage battle, you will gain a score and the corresponding rewards based on the highest score you got in the stage.
    *    (3) Different stages will contain different special rules that grant buffs. Use these rules well to fight more effectively.

*    Spiral Abyss, Floor 11 Ley Line Disorder changed to: 
    *    All characters in the party gain a 60% Electro DMG Bonus.
    *    All party members receive a 60% Hydro DMG Bonus.
    *    Updated the monster lineup on Floors 11 – 12 of the Spiral Abyss.

*    Starting from the first time that the Lunar Phase refreshes after updating to Version 4.2, the three Lunar Phases will be as follows: 
    *   **Phase I: Tidal Moon**
        *    ( When a character's HP increases or decreases, it will be counted. When it reaches a total of 12, a shockwave will be unleashed at the character's position, dealing True DMG to nearby opponents and clearing the count. 1 such shockwave can be unleashed every 4s.

    *   **Phase II: Uncanny Moon**
        *    When off-field characters deal Elemental Skill DMG to an opponent, an Uncanny Mark will be placed upon that opponent. When another active character hits a marked opponent with an attack of the same Elemental Type, a shockwave will be unleashed at that opponent's position, dealing True DMG. The Uncanny Mark lasts 5s, and Marks created through different attacks with different Elemental Types can exist independently. 1 such shockwave can be unleashed every 2s. When a character enters the field, the Uncanny Marks placed by that character on opponents will be removed.

    *   **Phase III: Soaring Moon**
        *    After a character takes the field, they will gain one stack of Soar every 2.5s. Each stack will increase the DMG dealt by this character by 8%. Max 3 stacks. A character with 3 stacks will unleash a shockwave at an opponent's position when they deal DMG to that opponent, dealing True DMG. This effect will be cleared when the character leaves the field. 1 such shockwave can be unleashed every 1s.

### Version 4.2 Adjustments and Optimizattions

**System:**

*    When the current quest requires you to complete other quests first, or if certain quest elements are occupied by other quests, you can click "View Details" on the Quest screen to view the prerequisites and redirect to the corresponding quests.
*    On the Story Quests and Hangout Events screens, if a quest requires you to complete prerequisite quests before you can accept it, you can click to view the prerequisites and redirect to the corresponding quests.
*    Unlocking and accepting Story Quests will now become two separate steps.
*    Beryl Region in Fontaine now has a new Teleport Waypoint. Adjusts the number of Teleport Waypoints required to unlock the achievement "Font of All Waters (I)." The original total number of Teleport Waypoints required to be unlocked is 39, and is now adjusted to 40 (if the achievement has been completed, the completion status of the achievement remains unchanged).
*    Optimizes the display logic employed between certain creature names and HP.
*    Optimizes touchscreen, keyboard and mouse controls for the scroll bar in certain interfaces (Inventory, Character, Craft, Forge, Quest) with the addition of a response area to the shaft of the scroll bar with support for scrolling to a specific position.
*    Optimizes the formatting of the Living Beings category of the Archive in order to support the display of longer text.
*    Optimizes the display method for some reading materials.
*    Optimizes the interactivity and performance of the Map interface: 
    *    Hints of the same kind will now be consolidated in the top-left corner of the Map.
    *    A button has been added for Spiral Abyss reward hints in the top-left corner of the Map: this button will be displayed whenever you have any Star's Bounty rewards to be collected from the current Spiral Abyss.
    *    If tapping the layer icons on the right of the Multi-Layered Map causes the selected map layers to exceed the display area of the screen, the Map will be automatically centered.

*    Optimizes the display rules for some red dots: 
    *    Red dots will now appear less frequently on interface icons.
    *    Some red dots will not reappear when a change in the login device occurs.

**Stellar Reunion:**

*    Adds a general update of the system interface with the addition of a separate way to access Events.
*    Adds "Reunion Locales," for which rewards can be collected upon completion of corresponding Expedition Quests.
*    Updates "Homeward Path," for which rewards can be collected upon completion of corresponding Archon Quests.
*    Updates "Reunion Blessing," for which "Stellar Reunion" daily double drop opportunities increase from 3 to 4 times, with the total number of opportunities increasing from 21 times to 28 times.
*    Adds "Returning Companions," for which 3 "Returning Companions" opportunities will be available during "Stellar Reunion." Unlocking Story Quests or Hangout Events will consume uses of "Returning Companions" instead of Story Keys.
*    Adds "Current Wish," where current Wish characters will be on display.
*    Updates "Passage of Time" rewards.
*    Removes the original "Reunion Rewards" screen, and merges its rewards into those of other modules.

**Genius Invokation TCG:**

*    Standardizes typography and phrasings for Genius Invokation TCG card descriptions.
*    Optimizes the interactivity logic of the Genius Invokation TCG interface: 
    *    Optimizes the display and red dot rules for Tavern Challenges.
    *    Now displays the number of cards you own and the purchase limit when buying cards.
    *    Optimizes the response area for Elemental Tuning during matches.
    *    Optimizes some pop-up windows, prompts, and icons in the system.

**Audio:**

*    Adjusts the frequency for the triggering of characters' "When It Rains" voice lines.
*    Adjusts the Korean and Japanese voice lines and corresponding text for certain quests.

**Other:**

*    Expands effective area of the acceleration current for the objective "Ride the winds to defeat Dvalin," in the Archon Quest "A Long Shot" in Prologue: Act III "Song of the Dragon and Freedom."
*    Drops and Materials added between Versions 3.3 to 4.2 can now be placed in the Parametric Transformer, with new development items amongst the converted products.
*    Optimizes shoulder posture animation for some humanoid enemies or NPCs.

### Version 4.2 Genius Invokation TCG Balance Adjustment

*    Adjusts the effect of the Event Card "Joyous Celebration," the effect after it is played is now: The element corresponding to your active character's Elemental Type will be applied to all your characters affected by elements.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required and effect of the Talent Card "The Scent Remained" for Character Card "Xingqiu": the number of dice required has decreased from 4 Hydro Dice to 3. After equipping this Talent Card, the Rain Sword(s) created can block DMG of at least 2 for your active character.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required for the Talent Card "Mirror Cage" for Character Card "Mirror Maiden": the number of dice required has decreased from 4 Hydro Dice to 3.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required for the Talent Card "Glorious Season" for Character Card "Barbara": the number of dice required has decreased from 4 Hydro Dice to 3.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required for the Talent Card "Absorbing Prism" for Character Card "Electro Hypostasis": the number of dice required has decreased from 3 Electro Dice to 2.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required and effect of the Talent Card "Steady Breathing" for Character Card "Chongyun": the number of dice required has decreased from 4 Cryo Dice to 3. The effect of "Starting Duration (Rounds) +1" for Chonghua Frost Field has also been removed.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required for the Talent Card "Crossfire" for Character Card "Xiangling": the number of dice required has decreased from 4 Pyro Dice to 3.
*    Adjusts the effect of the Talent Card "Naganohara Meteor Swarm" for Character Card "Yoimiya": after equipping this card, the initial number of Usages for Niwabi Enshou will be increased by 1.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required for the Talent Card "The Overflow" for Character Card "Candace": the number of dice required has decreased from 4 Hydro Dice to 3.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required and effect of the Talent Card "Awakening" for Character Card "Razor": the number of dice required has decreased from 4 Electro Dice to 3. The effect of "1 of your Electro characters gains 1 Energy" can now be triggered once per round.
*    Adjusts the effect of the Talent Card "Lightning Storm" for Character Card "Beidou": it is no longer necessary for the character to suffer DMG during Prepare Skill for Beidou's Normal Attacks this Round to cost 1 less Unaligned Element.
*    Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required and effect of the Talent Card "Sin of Pride" for Character Card "Kujou Sara": the number of dice required has decreased from 4 Electro Dice to 3, and does not require Energy. After Kujou Sara equips this card, she will no longer use Subjugation: Koukou Sendou, and instead use Tengu Stormcall once.
*    Adjusts the effect of the Talent Card "Featherfall Judgment" for Character Card "Cyno": its DMG Bonus effect is now changed to "When your Cyno, who has this card equipped, uses Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer while having an even number of levels of Pactsworn Pathclearer's Indwelling effect, deal +1 DMG."
*    Adjusts the effect of the Talent Card "Tamakushi Casket" for Character Card "Sangonomiya Kokomi": if Bake-Kurage is on the field, then increase its Usage by 1 instead. If Bake-Kurage is not on the field, then summon a Bake-Kurage with Usage: 1.
*    Adjusts the DMG dealt by Baron Bunny of the Talent Card "Bunny Triggered" for Character Card "Amber": the DMG dealt is increased from 3 Pyro DMG to 4.
*    Adjusts the Energy required for Character Card "Jean"'s Elemental Burst and its effect: the Energy required for the Elemental Burst is decreased from 3 to 2, and the 2 Anemo DMG dealt by the Dandelion Field summoned by the Elemental Burst is decreased to 1.
*    Adjusts the Energy required for the Talent Card "Lands of Dandelion" for Character Card "Jean": the Energy required is decreased from 3 to 2.
*    Adjusts the effect of the "Scarlet Seal" status for Character Card "Yanfei": Scarlet Seal can be stacked a maximum of 2 times.
*    Adjusts the effect of the Talent Card "Right of Final Interpretation" for Character Card "Yanfei": it is now adjusted to "When Yanfei has this card equipped and uses a Charged Attack: +1 DMG to enemies with 6 or less HP. If Scarlet Seal is triggered, then draw 1 card after the skill finishes calculating."
*    Adjusts the Elemental Skill effect of the Character Card "Shenhe": the Usages of Icy Quills created by her Elemental Skill is decreased from 3 to 2.
*    Adjusts the Elemental Burst effect of the Character Card "Rhodeia of Loch": the DMG dealt by the Elemental Burst is increased from 2 Hydro DMG to 4. For each friendly Summon on the field, "deals +2 additional DMG" is adjusted to "deals +1 additional DMG."
*    Adjusts the Elemental Burst effect of the Character Card "Arataki Itto": the DMG dealt by the Elemental Burst is decreased from 5 Geo DMG to 4. The Raging Oni King effect whereby the character to which this is attached to has their Normal Attacks deal +2 DMG, is now adjusted to +1 DMG.

### Version 4.2 Bug Fixes

**Quests:**

*    Fixes an issue whereby using the character Neuvillette to carry out the step "Use Visions to search for Starsplinter Iron" in the Archon Quest "Bygones Times Like Dust Passing" causes a bug in which the character model glows abnormally.
*    Fixes a text error in the Archon Quest "Lies Cast Shadows Under Gathered Lights."

**Enemies:**

*    Fixes an issue whereby Wind Operatives and Frost Operatives would continue to attack characters despite being defeated in certain situations.

*    Fixes an issue whereby there is a slim possibility of erroneous targeting by the enemy "Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire" when using its skill, "Curative Bullet."
*    Fixes an issue whereby the duration of Cryo application had a chance of being abnormally long when certain skills cast by enemies "Construction Specialist Mek: Ousia" and "Icewind Suite" hit the character consecutively.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the enemies "Ruin Drake: Earthguard" and "Ruin Drake: Skywatch" would abnormally freeze upon entering combat in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby certain skills used by the enemies "Angelic Sea Hare" and "Bubbly Seahorse" may cause lag in the Co-Op Mode.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the enemy "Ruin Grader" continues to attack character(s) despite being defeated in certain situations.

**Characters:**

*    Fixes an issue whereby after Lyney had cast his Elemental Burst and transformed into a Grin-Malkin Cat, weapons would abnormally disappear after teleporting in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue with Neuvillette's Lv. 6 Constellation whereby the actual duration of the effect of "the duration of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment [is increased] by 1s" was slightly shorter than what is described in the text.
*    Fixes an issue whereby when the Sourcewater Droplets produced by Neuvillette's Constellation Level 4 is absorbed, the model of the Sourcewater Droplet remains visible onscreen in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue under certain circumstances whereby Neuvillette's Passive Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" cannot be triggered by the coordinated attacks of some characters not on the field.
*    Fixes an issue whereby after Neuvillette had cast Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, related special effects of the skill would abnormally remain in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby after Wriothesley casts his Normal Attack and sprints, when he casts a Normal Attack again shortly after, there is a chance that the counter on his Attack combo will reset.
*    Fixes an issue whereby after Wriothesley casts his Normal Attack and sprints, when he casts a Charged Attack again shortly after, there is a chance that he will be unable to cast his Charged Attack.
*    Fixes an issue whereby after Wriothesley casts "Rebuke: Vaulting Fist," there is a small chance that Stamina would be consumed abnormally.
*    Fixes an issue that would occur when holding Nahida's Elemental Skill to interact with "Lumitoile" whereby related special effects for locking on were abnormally absent.
*    Fixes an issue whereby after Xiao had activated Bane of All Evil, Plunging Attacks that hit a single enemy would abnormally trigger the effect of his Lv. 6 Constellation in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby under certain conditions, the positions of some characters' Geo Construct effects do not match with their actual hitbox radius.
*    Fixes an issue whereby when playing on PC or PlayStation, fallen characters revived by the effect of Barbara's Lv. 6 Constellation will continue displaying elements applied or status effects from before their death.
*    Fixes an issue with Diona whereby Icy Paws fired by her Elemental Skill could not freeze water after hitting it.
*    Fixes an issue whereby some of the special visual effects for Hu Tao's Charged Attacks were not displayed after the Version 4.0 update.
*    Fixes an issue whereby some of Eula's special visual effects were missing when the character was defeated.

**System:**

*    Fixes an issue whereby, after having replaced a character's Elemental Skill with the gadget Wind-Blessed Harpastum, if you then obtained the abilities of Xenochromatic Fontemer Aberrants when moving underwater, using the corresponding ability would abnormally launch harpasta.
*    Fixes an issue whereby, after using the gadget Portable Aerodynamic Gelatinous Bubble Generator, when the character entered combat, use of the Elemental Skill that had been replaced could not be restored as normal.
*    Fixes an issue whereby, when taking photos while moving underwater, some character models would disappear abnormally after exiting photo-taking in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby, when teleporting while viewing the Party Setup Screen, weather conditions from the area you teleported away from would abnormally become fixed in the open world in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby Diona's avatar and the character model were inconsistent.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the achievement "Gravity Front" cannot be completed in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby there is a localization error for text related to Café Lutece.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the gadget Itty Bitty Octobaby remains in the ocean currents despite the character having left the ocean currents in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby a character in water is unable to use Normal Attacks or the Elemental Skill button in Hold Mode after disconnecting and reconnecting to the server.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the host's position (1P), when on a moving object, is not tracked in real time on the map in the Co-Op Mode.

**Audio:**

*    Fixes an issue with Lyney and Lynette whereby, when using their Normal Attacks from afar, attack sound effects would not become quieter over longer distances as they should.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the English version of Freminet's voice-over "About Clorinde" could not be played properly.
*    Fixes an issue whereby certain interface sound effects were missing when using a controller.
*    Fixes an issue whereby certain sound effects were missing on Sucrose's Character > Weapon interface.
*    Fixes an issue whereby certain item sound effects would be abnormally louder for a period of time after character teleportation.
*    Fixes an issue whereby after certain open-world scenery changed, related sound effects wouldn't change in response as they should.
*    Fixes an issue whereby sound effects were missing when Sorush appeared and disappeared.
*    Fixes an issue whereby a sound effect was abnormally missing in the Story Quest "A Familiar Threat."
*    Fixes an issue with the Story Quest "Ever-Surging Memories" whereby, when closing and restarting the game, music related to the quest would be abnormal.
*    Fixes an issue whereby there was a small chance that the Springvale NPC Finch's voice-overs would be triggered abnormally.

**Genius Invokation TCG:**

*    Fixes an issue whereby the DMG negation special effects of the Summon, Baron Bunny, in Genius Invokation TCG are missing.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the Character Card "Jadeplume Terrorshroom" would abnormally stack Radical Vitality after having taken Piercing DMG in certain situations.

**Other:**

*    Fixes layout issues with the scenery of some environments in Fontaine.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the special effect of the weapon "Mistsplitter Reforged" was abnormal.
*    Fixes an issue on mobile whereby the Wind Glider "Wings of Transient Dreams" would go blurry.
*    Fixes an issue whereby when characters moving underwater were frozen, or when characters moving underwater were switched as they entered land, brief anomalies in posture would result in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby characters are able to use Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts underwater in certain situations.
*    Fixes an issue whereby characters teleported to an underwater Teleport Waypoint have a chance of losing Xenochromatic Fontemer Aberrant powers that they have obtained.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the player-controlled character may continue performing the action of floating in water for an abnormally long time after surfacing in certain situations.
*    Fixes some text errors in certain languages and optimizes text. (Note: Related in-game functions have not changed. Travelers can view the changes in different languages by going to the Paimon Menu > Settings > Language and changing the Game Language.)
*    Text-related fixes and optimizations in English include:
*    Optimizes inconsistencies between voice-overs and the corresponding lines for certain characters by changing the text to better reflect the voice-over.
*    Adjusts the translations of certain place names.
*    Fixes an issue whereby the voice-over "About Clorinde" in Freminet's Profile could not be played.

[Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2023/08/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august)
======================================================================================================================================================================================================

Along with improvements on PlayStation platforms

*   ![Image 25: get2sammyb](https://images.pushsquare.com/users/4271/avatar.jpg?v=1529104267)
*   by [Sammy Barker](https://www.pushsquare.com/authors/get2sammyb)Fri 4th Aug 2023, 1:30pm

*   Share:
