The [Genshin Impact](https://www.pushsquare.com/games/ps5/genshin_impact) update you’ve been waiting for, Fontaine, is less than two weeks away: 16th August is the all-important date for the addition of the _fifth_ region in HoYoverse’s hit gacha game. The upcoming 4.0 update, named As Light Rain Falls without Reason, will add a ton of new content to the already enormous game, including underwater exploration, stories, and, yes, playable characters.

“Located northeast of the Sumeru desert, Fontaine is now ruled by Focalors, the Hydro Archon and the God of Justice,” the blurb explains. “Under her influence, trials have become important public events at the Opera Epiclese, where magic, farce, tragedy, and various sorts of performances also take place. The latest chapter of the Archon Quest also takes place here, and players will witness a masterful magic show by Lyney and Lynette as well as an ongoing trial.”

This is the Hydro region, so in addition to a sprawling aquatic city, you’ll also be able to dive underwater in a gameplay first. You can also expect to encounter new boss types, including a balletic clockwork duo in the Icewind Suite and an armoured crablord in the Emperor of Fire and Iron.

[![Image 26: Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August 2](https://images.pushsquare.com/02ff9a6f3ddb5/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august-2.445x245.jpg)](https://images.pushsquare.com/02ff9a6f3ddb5/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august-2.large.jpg "Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August 2")[![Image 27: Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August 3](https://images.pushsquare.com/53c043df88c7f/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august-3.445x245.jpg)](https://images.pushsquare.com/53c043df88c7f/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august-3.large.jpg "Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August 3")

[![Image 28: Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August 4](https://images.pushsquare.com/6009b8eda4a22/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august-4.445x245.jpg)](https://images.pushsquare.com/6009b8eda4a22/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august-4.large.jpg "Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August 4")[![Image 29: Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August 5](https://images.pushsquare.com/4a32ec82a7414/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august-5.445x245.jpg)](https://images.pushsquare.com/4a32ec82a7414/genshin-impacts-gigantic-fontaine-expansion-plunges-ps5-ps4-from-16th-august-5.large.jpg "Genshin Impact's Gigantic Fontaine Expansion Plunges PS5, PS4 from 16th August 5")

As for new character banners, you can look forward to five-star archer Lyney and four-star sword user Lynette, the latter of whom you’ll be able to add to your party for free as part of a seasonal event. Meanwhile, four-star diver Freminet, who wields a Claymore, will feature in the update’s second-half. Elsewhere, Zhongli and Tartaglia will get long-awaited reruns as well.

Of note, HoYoverse is upgrading the experience on PS5, adding in global illumination, motion sensor support, and even faster loading times. “Other optimisations include the multi-layered map and the new Party Setup backgrounds and animations intended to provide players with practical and interesting details in their adventures,” the press release adds.

[![Image 30: YouTube Video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Q0lYzpRv6gg/maxresdefault.jpg)Watch on **YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q0lYzpRv6gg "Play")

A pretty epic update, then, with potentially hundreds of hours of content on offer. It’s worth noting that you _will_ be able to visit Fontaine if you’ve completed Monstadt’s Prologue Act III quest, but you’ll need to have finished all of Sumeru’s content to unlock the new Archon Quests.

In other news, the Chinese developer is also marking the occasion with an art gallery event in New York, Paris, Taipei, and Tokyo. This will feature hundreds of never-before-seen concept art, sketches, draft designs, developer notes, models, miniatures, and figurines. Entry will be free, but the studio encourages pre-registering [through here](https://act.hoyoverse.com/ys/event/e20230804reserve/index.html?game_biz=hk4e_global&hyl_presentation_style=fullscreen&hyl_auth_required=true&hyl_landscape=true&hyl_hide_status_bar=true&utm_source=pr), as demand is likely to be high.

Lore

Before the explosion, the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering was the technological center of the entire Court of Fontaine. Alain Guillotin established the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering after leaving the Marechaussee Phantom. As the Fontaine Research Institute dedicates itself to studying machines and energy, clockwork meka research was the primary focus, with most mechanical inventions having come from this institute. Alain referred to the Suppression Specialist Mek as the "Cal. Scherbius" type as a tribute to his friend and assistant from the Institute of Natural Philosophy, Carter Scherbius.

![Image 90: A portrait of an older man with a moustache in a suit, stood on a green surface surrounded by books, boxes, and drawers](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/01/12/178140791/5a5a09915eec46c98da636ad075ad62c_4332656182640486915.PNG?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When Monsieur Bossuet became the supervisor, the institute was renamed the "Bossuet Research Institute." Junior Researcher Chisseray deemed that Mr. Bossuet's flawless decisions and wise leadership led to remarkable results in multiple research areas. Together, Bossuet and Chisseray introduced a new theoretical artificed core configuration. When compared to the traditional configuration created by Alain Guillotin, their calculations show that, in an ideal situation, the configuration's optimal output is slightly higher than the traditional one. The paper they created together elaborates on the operating principle and design requirements of the configuration and was selected as Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering's Outstanding Paper of the Year. As a result, Monsieur Bossuet was awarded the title of Senior Technician. After Mr. Bossuet left his post, everyone was scattered throughout the institute. According to Mr. Bossuet's original plan, Coppelius and Coppelia are clockwork meka dedicated to the art of dance. After Maillardet took over the project, Pneumousia was added, making them not only good at dancing but also highly capable fighters. Two different combat modes for Coppelius and Coppelia were created based on the differences between Pneuma and Ousia, Nemesis of Coppelius and Dirge of Coppelia. Edwin Eastinghouse is a former Senior Technician who conducted experiments using Arkhium to defy gravity with the hopes of lifting the elegant Court of Fontaine into the sky as a means to avoid the prophesied flood. His experiments were believed to be the cause of the massive explosion that destroyed most of the Fontaine Research Institute.

**Explosion**
-------------
When a flood was prophesied to destroy Fontaine, institute researchers shifted their efforts to safeguard the entire nation. Arkhium is a mysterious yellow-green ore. With its vast energy potential and ability to break earthly constraints, Arkhium was once considered the key to the gate of salvation. Edwin Eastinghouse used Arkhium in the creation of the "Prototype Cal. Breguet" to counteract the effects of gravity. This was the first step in a plan to turn the Court of Fontaine into a city in the sky, in the hopes that never again would the people have to worry about the waves that once swept over the land. The Arkhium in the device's core has the characteristics of "splitting" or "precipitation," and can take matter, or certain things outside of matter, and separate them. It is said that this process can be reversed, but the Fontaine Research Institute is infatuated only with the physical effects it can produce. Initial estimates indicated that the device could lift an entire block of buildings.

![Image 103: A building with a large, golden object in the center of it](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/01/12/178140791/5a9b87e6f53ae12929cb4959c5894875_5384356191286069350.PNG?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

While conducting research, the Arkhium core within the field generator suffered an overload, triggering a colossal explosion that laid waste to the institute, for which Edwin Eastinghouse is blamed. This event propelled substantial blocks of Allogravity-Condensed Water Bodies and fragments of the institute into the atmosphere. Consequently, the Experimental Field Generator lost control and now occupies this area of the institute. The explosion claimed the lives of several researchers. Many of those who escaped unharmed chose to later leave the institute. Edwin disappeared after the explosion, with many believing him to be dead. However, he was dismissed from his post as Senior Technician with further investigation pending due to being absent from work for a long period without having submitted any application. Given his unique personality and unconventional research methods, the institute leaders were comfortable with his absence. Arkhium has come to be perceived as an ill omen by some, who attribute evil properties to the stones, foreseeing disaster for the greedy and misfortune for the ignorant. Others still see the potential value in Arkhium and consider there to be hidden potential within that has yet to be fully tapped.
The Arkhium Kinetic Core is the fruit of Raimondo's joint research with Edwin Eastinghouse. They believed that if they constantly injected the kinetic core with enough energy, it would easily allow the Experimental Field Generator to run at full power. After creating the core, they both realized they could barely find a way to keep injecting it with enough energy to keep it at maximum power. Edwin and Raimondo tried powering it with a mixture of Pneumousia and Arkhium energy or by connecting large numbers of Arkhium ores in series to create a super-powered group, but neither worked. They came across the giant Arkhium, and although it was always in an inert state, they were certain that this ore had unprecedented purity. They believed that, with the right treatment, the giant Arkhium could output the large amount of energy needed. Edwin and Raimondo had a disagreement due to Raimondo offering a more conservative proposal when Edwin wanted to solve the problem quickly. After the explosion, Raimondo promptly led the disaster investigation and evaluation efforts. The mixture of intelligence and passion at the Research Institute yielded outcomes that exceeded all expectations, regrettably, there is seldom anyone left to acknowledge this remarkable achievement.

**New Fontaine Research Institute**
-----------------------------------
As a result of the disaster, the institute was forced to recollect and build a new location near the old ruins while maintaining what was not destroyed in the explosion. The institute currently in working order is referred to as the "New Fontaine Research Institute." Raimondo and Choiseul share the heavy responsibilities that belong to the post of Director. Raimondo is responsible for getting scientific work and research back on track, and Choiseul is responsible for everything apart from that. For example, Choiseul is responsible for arranging funds related to manpower, quarterly budget allocations, re-accommodating visitors, and getting rid of those journalists together with Raimondo. Their main goal remains the same — to rebuild the Fontaine Research Institute and work hard for the well-being of all the people of the Court of Fontaine.

![Image 114: Floating Ruin Machine is in a large stone chamber with ruined walls](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/01/12/178140791/60a8a709bcc74150d30ebfd5aa298d22_4873224519351592702.PNG?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Per Choiseul, the former site of the institute will be preserved forever and rebuilt as the Fontaine Research Institute Safety Education Center. Raimondo claims that once all of the retrievable research assets at the old site are recovered, the old Central Laboratory will be demolished, and the area's natural environment will be restored to its original state. This demolition will utilize the newly-researched "Experimental Field Generator." This device can deactivate the Gravity-Altering Field that surrounds the institute's ruins and land them on the ground safely. The energy source being used is the Tri-State Arkhium which is an inert variant of Arkhium that was created through a special transformation process. After entering the all-new "silent excitement state," it is much more stable than the original’s excited state.

**Present Day**
---------------
![Image 123: Ruins of an ancient city, in a low angle view, are floating in the air, with a bright blue sky in the background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/01/12/178140791/258395f804783bb62f419d8cd4e96f64_2512758376504830362.PNG?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Following the initial explosion, assumed to be caused by Edwin Eastinghouse, all of the institute's Arkhium fragmented, posing a perpetual risk of spontaneous excitation and subsequent explosion ever since. A secondary explosion, minor in comparison to the one caused by Mr. Edwin, occurred at the ruins of the Central Laboratory, which dispersed numerous condensing components of the Arkhium inhibitor into the surrounding waters. This secondary explosion was the result of energy flow affecting a small portion of Arkhium in the ruins. A suppression device was implemented, and the crisis was averted, however, a senior researcher named Mr. Nacker escaped. Mr. Nacker worked with Mr. Eastinghouse, and is believed to have triggered the small explosion in order to steal the Arkhium Kinetic Core to make a "small fortune."
Later, a special investigator named Miss Fusilier was hired to take charge of the stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core case. The main objective is to retrieve the Arkhium Kinetic Core as soon as possible, as it is an extremely unstable prototype. The investigation led Fusilier to Chaussivert, a self-proclaimed "Harbor-Watcher" of Lumidouce Harbor. Chaussivert disclosed critical information, which led the investigation to a shipment of goods that may reveal Mr. Nacker's whereabouts. A residence emitting clear residual energy readings all around was discovered as the investigation unfolds. Miss. Fusilier broke the house lock when none other than the missing Edwin Eastinghouse was found inside. Edwin surreptitiously pointed out Nacker's current whereabouts to be around the Fort Charybdis Ruins. Nacker revealed he was working on a "Field Generator" and was attempting to synchronize it with the Arkhium Kinetic Core in hopes of being the greatest kinetic engineer ever. It came to light that Edwin Eastinghouse led the investigation against Nacker on purpose, and he encouraged Nacker to go back to the institute and repent. Edwin wanted to get back to his research and claimed he wasn't present when the core exploded. After Nacker and Edwin exchanged a few words, Fusilier stated both of them harmed the interests of the institute and as the special investigator of the Fontaine Research Institute, she demanded both be taken to the institute to be dealt with accordingly. Upon arrival at the institute, after enough time has passed for Edwin and Raimondo to exchange words, the Maison Gardiennage's personnel arrived and took both Nacker and Edwin to the Fortress of Meropide.

![Image 124: Aquamarine-tinged factory buildings stand illuminated with pale yellow lights on a hazy or foggy day](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/01/12/178140791/ea2b4fc11e282606b6aa78e53f23d6fc_4886047579680593681.PNG?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Jurieu and Lourvine are former researchers of the institute who are now hired as technical consultants by Wriothesley at the Fortress of Meropide. Jurieu is one of the highest-ranked researchers at the Fontaine Research Institute and used to work under Edwin. While Jurieu used to be Edwin's assistant, Lourvine used to be Jurieu's assistant. Jurieu's main areas of research were Arkhium and gravimeters. During his time at the Fortress of Meropide, Jurieu focused his efforts on creating the "Skyship Wingalet," a true flying ship, which helped rescue Fontaniane's during the flood.
Fonta is a specialty drink created by the Fontaine Research Institute that is well-received by locals. Fonta only comes in sweet flavors, and sparkles appear for a few seconds upon drinking it. Fonta currently has a trial product in the works, a blood-red drink, which is being tested on a smaller scale to see how it might be received by customers due to some backlash. Promoters came to the Fortress of Meropide and offered to sponsor the Pankration tournament so they could push their new product, but the Duke refused to even entertain the idea.

Monsieur Bossuet became the supervisor of the Alain Guillotin Memorial Research Institute and renamed it the Bossuet Research Institute. Due to "failure to comprehend the meaning of his research," this project was ultimately taken away, which Coutrot said "will only obstruct the road to the technological singularity." **The Serpent's Bowels**
========================
![Image 127: The image depicts a glowing blue monument on a small hill, possibly a teleporter, with some floating stones over it and a person standing to the left of the hill](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/5bcd5796e223ef978f12d015cb86aac8_3525836883539017513.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Around six thousand years ago, during the war between the

First Descender Primordial One

and the Second Who Came, the nation now called Enkanomiya sank into the Dark Sea, hidden from the heavens. The entrance to Enkanomiya is now located in Inazuma, on Watatsumi Island, where the god of Enkanomiya led his people. The Serpent's Bowels connects Sangonomiya and Enkanomiya. The passage to the ancient civilization is hidden behind a huge door with Key Sigils. These five types of sigils were once used throughout Enkanomiya and only surfaced when the passage was opened. According to legend, with the awakening of Enkanomiya, a new set of sigils will be given to the people of Watatsumi. By activating all the Key Sigils, a gate opens that leads deep into the rock that previously seemed solid. At the end of the passage, the path to Enkanomiya is blocked by doors that can only be opened with a Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep. This key is said to be forged from the spilled blood of Orobashi and can only be used by those with a heart as pure as water itself. The Traveler and Paimon were sent to Enkanomiya by the High Priestess of Sangonomiya to obtain the Bloodbranch Coral needed to perform the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri ritual to stop the Holy Soil spreading on Watatsumi Island.

![Image 128: The glowing, blue cave is filled with tall, mushroom-like plants, standing in shallow water, creating an ethereal landscape](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/c4f9dcc9b8458b457395b74e0545a3d9_7849352208924339452.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Dragonbone Flower grows in The Serpent's Bowels, and when nourished with the Waters of Lethe, the flower will produce a fruit called the Dragonbone Orb. This orb is known to bards as the "Fretnaught Fruit," as it relieves a person of worries and brings peace. Thousands of years ago, before Orobashi appeared in Enkanomiya, there was a resistance against the tyranny that ruled civilization. When their leader was captured, the core of the resistance completely fell apart. The ordinary students who followed him were saved by being far from the epicenter of events. Those who were lucky enough to escape fled to previously prepared shelters, hoping to regain their strength. They believed that they needed time, and they would be able to lead the movement again. But everything required money, which they did not have, so someone suggested selling the Dragonbone Orbs. Its aroma could relax and calm anxious thoughts, sweeping away all worries, so it was expensive on the market. The recipe brought real wealth to the resistance, but soon some of the members began to avoid conflicts and battles, and later asked for permission to leave their ranks, since there was no longer a reason to fight. The collected Dragonbone Orb can be exchanged with Marjorie of Mondstadt, Linlang of Liyue, or Mikoshi Genichiro of Inazuma, but only Marjorie has heard the legend of the Fretnaught Fruit.

![Image 129: Waterfall is visible in blue and green with light mist above it](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/97805383565b33f6b2de6777468fe5eb_2199892019579680003.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In one of the waterfalls in the location, the sword of the Inazuman Iwakura Clan, Hakuen Michimitsu Amenoma, can be found. This clan was founded by the Electro Archon lieutenant's son, Mikoshi Michihiro. After his mother, Mikoshi Chiyo, was driven mad by the Nightmare after the Cataclysm, Michihiro renounced his name, becoming Iwakura Michihiro. The descendants of the Iwakura Clan never obtained a Vision, so their excellent swordsmanship was purely a result of their honing of mind, body, and technique. The Clan's secret blade technique was called Tengu Sweeper, and people said it can only be performed when there is not a single trace of confusion in one's heart. This blade once belonged to the clan's only heir, who received a Vision, Iwakura Mitsunari. When Iwakura Mitsunari lost his Vision during the Vision Hunt Decree, he disbanded his disciples, and they took up the path of the Kairagi. When they attacked the Traveler, the latter was forced to defeat them, and during the Traveler's meeting with Iwakura, the swordsman wanted to avenge his fallen disciples, but was also defeated. The blade left by the Iwakura master can be returned to the Blade-mound on Narukami Island, where the swords of fallen samurai are left.

![Image 130: A stone archway, illuminated with blue light, leads into a shadowy pathway with hanging lanterns](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/cd73c08a5fe0b409b1bb1447b0c40690_6720986774513411192.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Serpent's Bowels is located beyond the three corners that protect the Enkanomiyans, in the domain of the Dragonheir of the Depths. It is believed that one day a little boy bet with his friends that he could find the Dragonbone Flower, but instead he found a huge serpent in the cave, which he had never seen before. For some reason, looking at the titanic figure of the serpent, the child did not feel fear, but rather felt a certain kinship. Then the boy asked the serpent to become their god, and it agreed. Thus, Orobashi, who had fled to the Dark Sea from the Archon War, became the god of Enkanomiya. After the Enkanomiyans left the land, Enkanomiya once again belonged to the Vishaps, and the people of Watatsumi even fed them by throwing offerings into the Moon-Bathed Deep.

**The Narrows**
===============
![Image 176: The bluish-tinted, fantasy-like landscape features a stone path leading to ancient ruins, with glowing blue flora and a dark sky above](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/010094c80b9d07dd35b10c748cee0ec1_1793264237474938176.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The first location that can be reached from The Serpent's Bowels is The Narrows. The Narrows were, in the earliest times, sandwiched between the mountain face and an area known as the Roundlands, thus earning that location its name. However, the exceedingly strange tectonic shifts in Byakuyakoku caused the Roundlands to collapse into the depths, thus causing The Narrows to widen significantly. 

![Image 177: Interior of a stone structure with stairs, platforms, and a hanging light](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/cb965ce28f3eb3ef47e017fd5352a915_4884586008211074559.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The main library of Enkanomiya, where all of its books are stored, is located here. In addition, an image showing the topography of the area can be found in the library.

Emma Ema

used to be an administrator of the library. On the last day of Enkanomiya before rising to the surface, Emma had to return five more books, or her honor would be tarnished and she would have to look after the Deep Sea Spiritherb. The woman was so angry that her emotions were imprinted as a Shade of Tokoyo, and thousands of years later, when the Traveler and Paimon descended into Enkanomiya, she asked for these books to be returned. The missing books were "The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku," "Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku," "In the Light, Beneath the Shadow," and the records of experiments conducted by Michiya. "The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku" can be purchased from the Yae Publishing House in Inazuma. "Before Sun and Moon" was banned by the god of Enkanomiya, Orobashi himself, and stolen from the library, but the suspects were placed in a suspended prison beneath the Dainichi Mikoshi. When Orobashi read the book, Celestia sentenced him to death, which led to the god sacrificing himself so his people could live. Some of Orobashi's familiars, priestesses, and Jibashiri knew the truth, but were forced to hide it until it faded into legend. When all the books were returned to the library, Emma was happy she wouldn’t need to look after the Deep Sea Spiritherb and revealed that she dreams of opening a restaurant in Inazuma and becoming a sashimi chef. After returning the books, a portal in a looking glass will be opened, leading to the same place, but at a different time. Similar looking glasses can be found in the World Within the Book, the four Orthants, and the Tower of Ipsissimus in Fontaine, created by the founder of the radical organization, the Narzissenkreuz Ordo. Through one of these looking glasses, the Enkanomiyan library can be seen.

![Image 178: The image shows a dark blue and foggy landscape with ruins and glowing lights](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/b98dab47a0a8abcef051d31ca81d41ab_3457838903791186385.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Golden Bridle can be found behind the library. This Golden Bridle is needed to obtain the Bloodbranch Coral, which the High Priestess of Sangonomiya sent the Traveler and Paimon for. In addition, one of the three fragments of the Reins of Revival, needed for the trial, can be found in The Narrows. The fragment can be found in a secret room, the entrance to which is hidden by a Sunfire Phantasm that manifests when day and night change. Previously, the astronomical phenomena of Enkanomiya — the mirages and

The Sinshades Shades of Tokoyo

— were at first indiscriminately referred to as Eidolons and seen as the two sides of the same coin. With the arrival of Orobashi, the Enkanomiyans were able to understand these two phenomena and came up with different names for them. Mirages that appeared in the Whitenight were named Sunfire Phantasms, and those of Evernight, Ghostfire Phantasms. As time went by, both of them came to be referred to as Sunfire Phantasms, for they are essentially the same thing. When the Enkanomiyans studied the nature of mirages, they began to use them to hide secrets.

![Image 179: The image depicts a mysterious outdoor nighttime scene with stone structures and hanging lanterns](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/e63385245802af6d318cbd0d1dc54989_5616339091317560386.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The cave in the northwest of The Narrows was the shelter of an Enkanomiya resistance during the reign of the Sunchild. The Sinshade of Adonis can be met there, who reveals the secret of the Dragonbone Orb.

![Image 180: A scenic pond surrounded by rocks, greenery, and a statue in a video game environment](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/6c18fcb904982f961036381cdb9d47f2_8914256058226718975.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Above The Narrows, a portal is located. The schools of Ghostfish from a small lake in the northeast of the location can glide to this portal. This portal connects The Narrows to Yachimatahiko's Locus, where one of the towers protecting Enkanomiya is located. In The Narrows, a trial to receive an offering containing the remains of the thoughts of the creator of the Dainichi Mikoshi, Abrax, can be activated with five Key Sigils.

![Image 181: A tombstone decorated with candles and bones sitting on a hill](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/120d6ece6ae4a1bbd4f43ce1526b6c60_6802861421544778914.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In addition, in The Narrows, two tombstones of the Sunchildren, the rulers of Enkanomiya, can be found. The first line on the tombstones is written in the language of Enkanomiya, and the second in the language of Inazuma. The first royal tombstone reads: _"Here lies Rikoru no Mikoto. He loved to build. He once built a small-scale Dainichi Mikoshi. It was six feet tall and immensely vivid."_ Rikoru dreamed of building a tower even taller than the Dainichi Mikoshi, which would glorify him. He was the first Sunchild, and it was during his reign that Abrax was declared a traitor and imprisoned. The second tombstone reads: _"Here lies Isumenasu no Mikoto. On his free days, he would go boating, consulting his map of the country."_ Isumenasu believed that Enkanomiya was a vast country, so when his spirit saw the map of Teyvat, he mistook it for a fake.

**Dainichi Mikoshi**
====================
![Image 211: A large structure, seemingly an abandoned castle or fortress, appears in a desaturated, teal-toned landscape with snow-covered ground and a waterfall in the foreground](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/228b53a4b6d6ed0870c7b409be7f6f98_1217433798452027494.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Dainichi Mikoshi, which was once called Helios, "the chariot of the sun," can be reached from The Narrows. When the civilization now named Enkanomiya sank into the Dark Sea, it was terrorized by the

Dragonheir Vishaps

of the Depths from the Light Realm. Without sunlight, people could only survive until one day the Sage

Abrax Aberaku

designed a tall tower that represented the earth, the element between wind and water. Helios became an artificial sun, with which people illuminated the Dark Sea and drove the Dragonheir of the Depths back into the dark. Helios established the alternation of day and night; the day was called Whitenight, and the night was called Evernight. It was said that: "Now that the Dainichi Mikoshi has been built, though this land is in everlasting night, we can at least tell black from white." The Dainichi Mikoshi allowed the creation of a barrier to protect the residents of Enkanomiya, but in order to enter, it is necessary to remove this barrier with the "Golden Bridle." According to legend, this is a small device which name is simply a tribute to the original culture of Enkanomiya. According to legend, the

sun Hyperion

and the moon are carried by the chariots of the gods, and the bridle was part of this chariot. This device represents the highest authority in the nation and gives its owner the power to control the Evernight and the Whitenight. By removing the barrier around the Dainichi Mikoshi, one can enter the center of the tower and activate the device to switch between the Whitenight and Evernight.

![Image 212: Stairs leading up to a shrine in a fantasy world are overgrown with bright blue moss](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/57c81f6730b95248ece73a07a4040891_2729339922815005032.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

During the Evernight, shadows of the past, echoes of thoughts and emotions, can be encountered in Enkanomiya. Although their stories have already ended, their images remain, and they can even interact with people. Such unique phenomena of the arteries of the earth are known as "Sinshades" or "Shades of Tokoyo," and strong emotions are called "Sins of Tokoyo." Since "to know sin is to be free of it," afterimages cannot know that they are the shadows of former beings, or they will dissipate. Near the activation device in the Dainichi Mikoshi, one of the Shades of Tokoyo,

Argos,Aru

can be found, who, unlike the other afterimages, is aware of his death. 

![Image 213: Two elemental dragon creatures stand guarding a glowing power source in a cave or dungeon](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/1f3476e22b0be946de07452ea9607513_5340628273101357731.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When spoken to, Argos talks about the next stage of the test to obtain the Bloodbranch Coral, an item needed to perform the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri ritual in Sangonomiya. To do this, one must restore the Reins of Revival and claim this land as one's own. The Reins of Revival, or rather the "Reins of recovery of control over things that return from beyond the grave," like the Golden Bridle, were a national treasure of Enkanomiya. It was made of the same material as Helios and could make dark spirits speak and search for Key Sigils nearby. The three parts of the Reins are fastened to the Bridle to remove the seal from The Emanant Skylight and ascend to the Gate of Heaven, where the trial is conducted. This opens a passage under the high tower where the Bathysmal Vishaps are located, from whose bodies the Bloodbranch Coral must be extracted. These Vishaps have been modified specially so that fragments of Bloodbranch Coral can take root on them, but these changes also make them exceptionally large.

![Image 214: Pictograph of a flying birds on a dark rock](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/b5174389f3b750063b8b37126ec9b34f_4701047331172174152.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Beneath the Dainichi Mikoshi is a suspended prison where the special officer corps

Chthonios,Jibashiri

the armed judges of the nether in Enkanomiya, have placed those suspected of stealing the forbidden book "Before Sun and Moon." When the Traveler and Paimon found Oogura and Ooshima, they protested their innocence and asked to find the third man who had been imprisoned with them,

Antigonus.Antei

He was an apprentice of the Jibashiri, had a quarrelsome nature, and was physically strong. Grasping small ledges on the cliff, he climbed up and fled, leaving bird signs to mark his path. Antigonus had heard about the birds from the Inazuman ambassador, who said that the creatures flew on wings and symbolized freedom. The man was going to go up, get the equipment he had hidden in advance, and then head towards The Serpent's Heart following the trail of the delegation from Khaenri'ah. Antigonus was ready to risk his life to prove their innocence.

![Image 215: Holographic image standing on stone steps between burning candles in a stone structure](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/6e1efa70e99dea7bee86ceaf2d613384_7738583899118281004.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Under the high tower, in a secret room, an afterimage of Helios's creator,

Abrax,Aberaku

can be found. He dreamed of driving out the darkness with the help of Helios, but he did not know then that the real, all-consuming, eternal night lurked in the black hearts of greedy people. A few years after the artificial sun was created, the nobles seized power and accused Abrax of treason. When he died, his soul was scattered across the land of Enkanomiya, and many of his memories were lost. His clothes, crown, and bones were hidden in three different places: in The Narrows, the Evernight Temple, and The Serpent's Heart. When all three offerings are collected and given to the afterimage, his soul will become whole, and he will be able to open the way to the very top of the Dainichi Mikoshi, to the closed spaces hidden by the veil of Evernight. At the very top of the artificial sun, the Divine Bridle can be obtained from Abrax, which is a symbol of power in Enkanomiya. Near the tower, the statue of Orobashi's divine wassals is located.

![Image 216: Tombstone with candles surrounded by grass and blue flowers](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/7c741e09afcc8d81a7ee1dfe0711da91_5293753639995058.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Near Helios, one of the royal tombs of the Sunchildren can be found: _"Here lies Orupeusu no Mikoto, who was skilled in music as a youth, specializing in playing the lyre. His voice was so lovely that even the very earth would be moved."_ Orupeusu swore that he would not sing until he heard the voice of his housekeeper, Clymene, but he never did, since she was forbidden to speak to children. The night before the Rite of Solar Return, he wished to hear her voice and told her that no matter how terribly she sang, he wouldn't laugh. He didn't know that this Solar Return would be his last. In addition, near the Dainichi Mikoshi is the hiding place of Bunkoku, one of the four great puzzles of Enkanomiya. According to one legend, Bunkoku was the second Prime Minister in the history of Enkanomiya. He and the Sunchild bled the people white through heavy taxation and made a huge fortune. After that, he hid his treasure in a secret chamber inside the Dainichi Mikoshi. Finally, he concealed the treasure chamber using the Sunfire Phantasms and summoned vengeful spirits and tainted beings from the Ley Lines to guard it. The secret chamber can be opened using nine stone tablets located in The Narrows, The Serpent's Heart, and the Evernight Temple. When the Traveler and Paimon found all the tablets and solved the puzzle to open the chamber, they discovered a vengeful guardian spirit and a Sinshade of a man named Koyanagi. He and his friend set out for the treasure chamber, but Koyanagi was possessed by one of the vengeful spirits summoned by Bunkoku and attacked his friend.

![Image 217: A blue human-shaped ghost stands on a gray brick floor, with roots, leaves, and debris around it](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/c5723761bd454b75e6eadb8cee4a9b86_7607567327712276047.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In the room behind Dainichi Mikoshi, the Sinshade of Kabayama can be encountered after sitting on a rock in his room. He moved around a lot in his youth, so he had few friends. He would often wander around the area alone, admiring the views, but he had no one to share them with. When his Shade of Tokoyo met the Traveler, he invited them to visit his favorite places and share their experiences. One such place is beneath a stone gate at the highest point in The Narrows, another one is an open space surrounded by corals near the Evernight Temple, and the last one is beside the towering ruins at The Serpent's Heart. In all of these places, Kabayama hung a lantern to light the way.

![Image 218: Floating islands in the sky are made of rock and covered in ice](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/20/237301566/e2db443fbbd918c35ee85879b24616e5_5903006898166977420.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

To the north of the Dainichi Mikoshi, on an uncharted island in the library, a secret Vishap research facility where experiments on the Dragonheir of the Depths were conducted under Orobashi's personal supervision can be found. It was in this laboratory that they tried to transplant Orobashi's Bloodbranch Corals to the Dragonheir of the Depths, but at first they were rejected, since the serpent belonged to the Human Realm, and the Vishaps to the Light Realm. The researchers found out that the Vishaps were capable of evolution. They tried to lower the temperature in the habitat of young heat-resistant Vishaps, and as a result, the grown Vishaps were weak, but their offspring had a high percentage of body fat, slept more, and possessed the Cryo element. Some Vishaps received the Electro element, but none of them developed traits indicating the Pyro element. It is not known whether this had any effect, but in Natlan, the Pyro Vishaps lost the primal flame's purity due to evolution and gradually disappeared. The researchers made an educated guess that the Bathysmal Vishaps had the ability to awaken their "seed" before maturation freely, and their mothers can also create new "seeds" to pass on to their offspring if they encounter unprecedentedly difficult living conditions. During experiments to determine the intelligence of the Vishaps, it was discovered that the fourth-generation Vishaps had linguistic understanding comparable to that of a 12-year-old child. After this, many of the laboratory staff advocated for such experiments to be stopped. According to the prophecy, the Hydro Sovereign was to be born in human form, and this could not be allowed to happen in Enkanomiya. It is unknown whether Orobashi's experiments affected the fulfillment of the prophecy, but the Hydro Dragon appeared in Fontaine in the body of a man named Neuvillette.

![Image 219: Three elemental dogs are positioned in an indoor arena](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/db21dc9372c8ebad49177b4d69648723_1387355020781724993.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In the center, the shade of Tokoyo, Michiya, who possesses the Bathysmal Vishap Experimental Records, can be found. He hid his notes in a room, the path to which could be opened by activating the elemental monuments that attract the Vishaps. Michiya planned to release the Dragonheir of the Depths after everyone left Enkanomiya. All the Vishaps were specially enhanced, and their special properties were supposed to be passed on to their offspring. When the Traveler descended into Enkanomiya thousands of years later, they encountered many Bathysmal Vishaps, possessing both Cryo and Electro elements that had been bred in the laboratory. Michiya, like some other Enkanomiyans, considered the experiments on dragons a sin and hoped that Enkanomiya would once again become their world when humans rose to the surface.

**The Serpent's Heart**
=======================
![Image 261: An old stone ruin with a blue hue has vines growing on the sides](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/e224cdaf400c3d7acc72dec5e345a82b_1730394534163074110.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

From the Dainichi Mikoshi, The Serpent's Heart can be reached by crossing a bridge. During these ancient times, The Serpent's Heart was called Delphi, the land of snakes. In ancient times, Enkanomiya worshiped the Cosmic Serpent, Ouroboros, who was depicted in ancient paintings and statues as a scaleless serpent. With the arrival of Orobashi, the name of the land of snakes remained unchanged, but the god was depicted as a serpent with the corals. In the center of The Serpent's Heart is an altar, which is considered the

Heart of Heart of

the Cosmic Serpent.Ouroboros

Ever since the ancestors of the Enkanomiyans discovered this place, it had already played host to a unique phenomenon in which space itself might overlap in a certain locale. 

![Image 262: A stone cliff with a glowing blue light](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/9d4a017536ce237d42d5d5a3b5fa2e69_2556362038957417346.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Over time, the Enkanomiyans, using Sunfire Phantasms, decided to take advantage of this phenomenon to add another dimension and build an altar that was used to guard secrets, imprison criminals, and worship the great imaginary serpent Ouroboros. This altar was a sealed storage device for important items, and in order to retrieve items from it, one must strictly follow the entry procedure. Codes to access the altar are scattered throughout Enkanomiya. Inside the altar, one of the fragments of the Reins of Revival, which is needed to enter the lower part of the Dainichi Mikoshi, is hidden. On the cliff, a giant statue of the divine vassals is located, the lantern of which can only be seen during Evernight.

![Image 263: Stone shrine at the center, surrounded by glowing blue grass, features columns, a stone tablet with glowing runes, and burning candles](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/a36da088b45c403982ad7f753101131d_3017034186135851042.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In addition to the fragments of the Reins of Revival, the altar contains the book "In the Light, Beneath the Shadow," which is submitted to the library and the leader of the resistance,

Spartacus the Righteous.Supada no Hiko

For his crimes against the Sunchildren, he was blinded and thrown into a deep prison for eternity, where his emotions became a Shade of Tokoyo. Spartacus's afterimage forgot his name and identity, but even after his soul was corrupted and tortured, he remembered how he fought for the freedom of Enkanomiya against the nobles. They claimed to have received some divine decree to fly the flag of the gods, but they only sought to satiate their base desires. The nobles were supposed to guard the Sunchildren, but in truth, they were the real rulers of the nation. When the Traveler and Paimon discovered Spartacus's afterimage, he asked them to find his followers and tell them never to give up, for hope lived among them. To convince the resistance to trust the Traveler, Spartacus told them their secret password: _"After the sun, the darkness starts, but true light hides within our hearts."_ The leader of the resistance never knew that his followers had stopped fighting, and his sacrifice had been in vain.

![Image 264: A grave is nestled among rocks and lit by candles at night](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/31daf48b4dc491ae53bb90bb8ff0333f_8167454699730928825.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In The Serpent's Heart, by using the five Key Sigils, a trial to obtain the Offering of The Serpent's Heart, which contains the remains of Abrax's thoughts, can be activated. There are also two royal graves to be found there. The first tomb reads, _"Here lies Ion no Mikoto, versed in fortune-telling and sigil-signs, but who often predicted falsely, never errant only when reading the span of his own years."_ Since many of the Enkanomiyans were destined for misfortune, Ion deceived them by telling them that good fortune awaited them to give them some happiness. For this, he was called a charlatan and was considered incapable of fortune-telling. When Ion's afterimage tried to read Paimon's fortune, he could not even see anything, although he claimed he usually doesn't fail to get a reading. The second tomb reads, _"Here lies Piramumon no Mikoto. Oft did he insist that there must be a world beyond our skies, but they were just wild claims."_ He loved books and said that one day he would escape the Dainichi Mikoshi and venture into paths beyond. When the Traveler and Paimon told the spirit of Pyramumon about Mondstadt, he was glad that the world was not limited to Enkanomiya. He wanted to drink juice with the Traveler, but he had to go to the "Rite of Solar Return" first.

![Image 265: A Ruin Guard in Genshin Impact sits on a hillside at night](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/de358082baff6e5a50b552e1b929aa01_5661367113194088836.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

To the south of The Serpent's Heart, on a small island, following the bird symbols, Antigonus, who escaped from prison in the Dainichi Mikoshi to return the stolen book, can be found. He worked as a bodyguard for the foreigners from Khaenri'ah, and when they stole "Before Sun and Moon," he found traces of the delegation and destroyed them. Antigonus fought a long time with a giant

mechanical Ruin creature,Guard

and eventually managed to tear out the core of the mechanism, but he received severe wounds from which he later died, and his anxious state of mind turned into a Sinshade. The broken robot fell and crushed the book, and only after thousands of years did the Traveler and Paimon return it to the library. After meeting the Traveler, Antigonus realized that he was only a shadow of himself.
_"What divine law have I broken... Why do the unfortunate rely on the gods?_

_Do my deeds have meaning, now that my earnest deeds have earned me a sinful name?"_

![Image 266: A ghost stands in the middle of a blue field full of glowing butterfly-shaped flowers next to ruins](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/e82520bad3dec1a9ff29d0e223c3ca51_4614414424944000312.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Near the altar of the Cosmic Serpent, during Evernight, the afterimage of the priestess of Enkanomiya,

Erebos,Eboshi

can be encountered. When Orobashi and Inazuma agreed to resettle the Enkanomiyans to the surface, a disagreement arose between Erebos and Lady Sangonomiya. Sangonomiya believed that one should not try to preserve the Sinshades, the past, the history, and the truth, which would not disappear even if left to their own devices, but rather to forget them. The test of receiving the Bloodbranch Coral, according to her plan, was intended to limit the number of descendants who could learn the truth. Erebos has always stood for preserving the truth, and Orobashi allowed her to add her own test, revealing their secrets after passing them. These tests of wisdom, insight, and valor can be found in Kunado, Yachimatahiko, and Yachimatahime's Loci. Once all the tests are passed, Erebos will be able to answer questions about the Dragonheir of the Depths, Orobashi, the Dainichi Mikoshi, and the world order before Enkanomiya fell into the Dark Sea.
_"In the faintness of everlasting night, beyond the rushing of the river Styx, within the sinless flow of heavenly light."_

![Image 267: Round, glowing pool of water in a dark cave with swirls of light and what appear to be tadpoles](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/6d4d5af08c144bb2fbc08f481eab3bdb_3898770497766303690.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In the south of The Serpent's Heart, a small lake with a school of Ghostfish is located. These fish can lead to the portal that connects The Serpent's Heart and Kunado's Locus.

**Evernight Temple**
====================
![Image 293: A blue eerie spirit stands next to a ruined structure](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/cca9922672b446a91ec525ab15e19664_3607119114284482035.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

To the east of the Dainichi Mikoshi, the Evernight Temple is located. The afterimage of Clymene can be seen here at night. She was once the housekeeper, responsible for the daily life of the Sunchildren. When, after the creation of Helios, the nobles seized power, they proclaimed the power of the Sunchild — a child was chosen as the Sunchild and put to rule. Children could not know how the world worked, so they remained puppets, agreeing with those who pulled their strings, remaining behind the throne. And the greed of those who stood behind the throne knew no bounds. They grew fat on the labor of people, controlling the Sunchildren, pushing them to disgusting deeds. To prevent the children from understanding that they were being manipulated, on one of their birthdays, they were taken to the inner sanctuary of the Dainichi Mikoshi, dressed up as those attending birth rites, and in high spirits. The temperature of the Dainichi Mikoshi is such that its light can warm all of Enkanomiya, so the Sunchildren were reduced to fragments of souls that returned to the Locus. This ceremony was known as the Rite of Solar Return. The Sunchildren were birthed from the Dainichi Mikoshi, and they would again return to the seat of the sun before the mortal world could taint them.
_"The hallowed Sunchild, their birth-rite begun, on Pegasus shall ride to the feast of the sun."_

![Image 294: A platform structure with glowing blue lights, set over a body of water and surrounded by underwater ruins](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/e95ecb837235754234309cf117fd3184_5366515685331549757.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When the people's ire rose, many of the sins were laid at the feet of the Sunchildren. Clymene understood that ignorance was their greatest sin, and that sin, even committed in ignorance, hurt others. But although she knew that they were doing wrong and understood that they were being manipulated, the Sunchildren were still children who had grown up before her eyes. She pitied them, grieved for them, and could not hate them. Although her work meant being with them every day, she was closely watched and was not allowed to speak. But when they were suddenly alone, when they were helpless and afraid, they told her so many things. Clymene regretted that she had never dared to say anything to them. She could not appear before them like this, so she asked the Traveler and Paimon to find all seven royal graves of the Sunchildren and place the Sango Pearls as a sign of respect so that their souls could travel to the Locus.

![Image 295: Figure standing in front of candle stacks](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/2429b07f5d9a583fd26f17f8770cbe0d_7475697801131844020.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

After the Traveler and Paimon paid their respects to all the Sunchildren, Clymene was able to open the path to the Locus to add her memories to what was left of their souls. By throwing the Divine Bridle that the Traveler received from the Sage Abrax into the waters of the Soul Guide's Locus, she was able to revive the children's souls so that they would become whole again and be able to travel to a new reincarnation. In the Evernight Temple, two royal graves can be found where the Sango Pearls must be placed. The first tomb has the inscription: _"Here lies Surepio no Mikoto, who contracted a terrible illness as a young child, and upon recovering, gained some knowledge in the realm of medicine."_

Asclepius Surepio

dreamed of becoming a great doctor, so that even with his weak body, he could leave his room in good health and have fun at his own pleasure. On the second tomb, it is written: _"Here lies Risutaiosu no Mikoto, who loved to imitate the craftsmen who molded with clay, creating sculptures of the female officials of the court that were exquisite and lifelike."_ When the afterimage of Risutaiosu saw the modern clothes of the people of Teyvat, he considered them, although new, shameless.

![Image 296: The eerie blue-lit stone ruins in a video game stand overgrown with plants](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/c5dfffbb08f98f7af3fee23131ea97a5_3526130876034695169.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In the Evernight Temple, the five Key Sigils can be used to start a trial to obtain the Offerings of the Temple, which contain the remains of the Sage Abrax's thoughts. In addition, in a secret part of the temple, the gates of which only open at night, a fragment of the Reins of Revival can be found. The fragment contains the power of the "Serpent-Seeker Rule," which attracts the Vishaps, so their tracks can be followed to find the fragment. 

![Image 297: Cave lit by magical blue light, with water, grass, and flora](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/588ea7213a7997c78a3910a35e0b1413_2506638774976564171.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

River Lethe, known as Tokoyo Reisen, also flows through this location. By watering the Dragonbone Flower with this water, a Dragonbone Orb can be grown.

![Image 298: A futuristic blue puzzle-like structure is being built on top of an ancient stone temple ruins in an environment filled with fog](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/2aa0490f84ea0f8a404e5f2a6a37d769_8196402874267411387.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

At the very east of the Evernight Temple, a huge labyrinth built by the labyrinth artist,

Daedalus,Date

can be found. He considered himself the second most important architect after Abrax and created two labyrinths: "Neopathos" and "Heterodoxa." Since Daedalus' father, Eurydates, was very rich, Daedalus did not skimp on time, money, or space. To build it, he studied the book "Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku" from the library and learned everything about the supporting structures, underground space, potential problems with water leakage, and even took into account the principles of Feng Shui. His labyrinths are based on interactions with triangular mechanisms that can be activated by attacks from a certain distance, daises of day and night, and places of essence worship. The places of essence worship are divided into Suncores and Mooncruxes. They each contain the power of Whitenight and Evernight, and are capable of bestowing such powers upon those who come to pay obeisances. With this energy, it is possible to activate the mechanisms in the opposite state at the time of day. It is possible to switch Evernight to Whitenight with special mechanisms using the Golden Bridle of Enkanomiya. Shield-Lights of Tokoyo present during Whitenight are dispelled during Evernight and vice versa, and Sunfire Phantasms can dissipate or manifest when switching between day and night. After completing all of Daedalus's labyrinths, the secret room can be entered, where he left "Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku," to return the book to the library.

![Image 299: A round, turquoise pool surrounded by grass and a dirt path is in a forest clearing with old trees, plants, and stone ruins](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/ae4921c468a26c9841f96d4a7685934d_1058817492835816143.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In the north of the Evernight Temple, a small lake with a school of Ghostfish is located. These fish can lift a person to the portal that connects the Evernight Temple and Yachimatahime's Locus. And in the south of the location, Akashi's Sunshade can be met. The real Akashi wanted to farm unagi, but to do this, he first needed to catch a few fry, which can barely be distinguished with the naked eye. He decided that since archers can hit targets from very far away, they must have good eyes, and experienced Jibashiri advised him on how to train his keen eyesight:_"Akashi, you have to take training slowly. You can only make steadier progress once you've laid a good foundation. Unagi fry are small and move about wildly, so you need to start with static targets. And not ones that are too close, either — if you want to do things right, you've got to do things seriously."_ On their advice, he began to practice shooting, but never hit a target. Having met the Traveler, Akashi's Sinshade suggested that they practice shooting and hit all the targets from the stone platform.

**Kunado, Yachimatahiko, and Yachimatahime's Loci**
===================================================
![Image 319: An ancient temple is surrounded by blue mist, with a staircase leading down to another temple structure](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/bff524d74427c7614c4d4f4023ac5fe9_8713497361611490345.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In ancient Enkanomiya, there was a tradition of worshiping triangles. According to the beliefs of those times, Enkanomiya is a crossroad between three realms: the Light Realm, the Human Realm, and the Void Realm, so at the three corners, the Kunado, Yachimatahiko, and Yachimatahime's Loci, the Towers of the Three Realms, were built to harmonize the three worlds. Originally, these places were guard posts against the Vishaps and were also a spiritual hub for the three forces that intersected in Enkanomiya. Their ancient names were lost over time, and they were renamed after the arrival of Orobashi. The triangle between these towers was a place of protection where people could live in safety from the Dragonheir of the Depths. The Towers of the Three Realms were built in places that were not aligned with either the wind or the water, in order to stabilize the tendencies of Enkanomiya and control its winds and waters. Because these places were extremely important and if they were to be threatened, the entire nation would suffer, they were hidden using secret arts, and only the priestesses and divine vassals were able to summon them. Some time after the Traveler obtained the Bloodbranch Coral, Enkanomiya was engulfed by the darkness emanating from the Void Realm, and the towers were damaged. Thanks to the unexpected help of one of the creatures of the Void Realm, the towers were restored, as was the protected space between the Towers of the Three Realms.

![Image 320: Ruined stone building with light in the center](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/26/237301566/cf1fab77c833728784f3f330a30ab063_6078500225998983953.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In the places where the Towers of the Three Realms stand, one can complete the trial of the priestess of Enkanomiya, Erebos. In Kunado's Locus, the afterimage of Daimon of the Jibashiri, who will offer to complete the trial of "valor," can be met: _"Valor is the power to defeat all your foes, regardless of the method used."_ To complete the trial, one must defeat the illusions born from Sunfire Phantasms and imprinted in the heart, and release the Flames of the High Gate to open the passage. In Yachimatahiko's Locus, the Sinshade of Uda, who will offer to complete the trial of "wisdom," can be met. In this trial, all the puzzles need to be solved to return the Flames of the High Gate. _"It is not bravery that advances bereft of wisdom, but foolhardiness instead!"_ The final trial of "insight" can be found in Yachimatahime's Locus. To pass, all the hidden objects have to be found, and the Flames of the High Gate have to be returned to their rightful places. _"The battlefield is ever-changing. Only by keeping your eyes and ears wide open at all times may you grasp the situation and master all these variables."_

**Bloodbranch Coral**
=====================
![Image 326: Blue artwork shows a landscape with ruins and a large wave crest-shaped pattern](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/07/237301566/290cfa259b61d31da19257549fda7675_2342156676239804.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

About six thousand years ago, a war between the

Primordial One Heavenly Principles

and the Second Who Came broke out in Teyvat. The heavens collapsed, the earth was split apart, and the civilization now known as Enkanomiya sank into the Dark Sea, hidden from the sight of the gods. This place used to be inhabited by pure elemental beings, the

Dragonheir of the Depths,Bathysmal Vishaps

who were forced to leave Teyvat after the war between the Dragons and the Heavenly Principles. There was only darkness in this place, and so their hunting grounds were untrammeled. Upon their arrival at the Dark Sea, the humans drove the Vishaps into the shadows with thousands of lanterns, and the latter hunted humans from the darkness. One day, a man named Abrax revealed his wisdom, and under his leadership, Helios was built, dispelling the darkness. A year after the artificial sun was created, humans tried to find a way to the surface, but the entrance was sealed. Soon after, the nobles seized power and appointed the rule of the

Sunchild,Phaethon

declaring Abrax a traitor. During the tyranny of the Sunchildren, humans formed a resistance, but it fell apart after their leader was captured. It was only when the god Orobashi, who had fled to the Dark Sea from the Archon War, appeared in Enkanomiya that the people were able to overthrow the rule of the Sunchildren and the nobles. During his reign, the Serpent began to experiment on the Dragonheir of the Depths, grafting his corals onto them. Orobashi's appearance meant that the ban on leaving the Dark Sea was weakened, and the people could rise to the surface. After making an agreement with Inazuma, Enkanomiya began to prepare for the great migration, learning the Inazuman language and traditions. Since then, the underwater kingdom has been called Enkanomiya, as opposed to Sangonomiya, which rises above the sea. The island that the Enkanomiyans landed on was called Watatsumi, which means "god of the sea."

![Image 327: Artistic rendering showcases abstract foliage, stylized in cool blues and purples, with a central coral-like structure and ethereal glowing accents](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/07/237301566/2086e64ad2eee032a9cd2a8ce13ef962_3203592989599891796.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When the Enkanomiyans emerged on the surface, the Holy Soil began to spread across Sangonomiya, expanding the habitat of the Dragonheir of the Depths and strengthening the primordial elemental power of the three realms. It was believed that just as the human heart runs deep and water flows downhill, the spirit of Watatsumi Island constantly feels the call of Enkanomiya, down in the depths. As a result, the soil slowly bleaches, becoming Holy Soil. Every few hundred years, when the spirit veins flowed smoothly, people would break the barrier between Enkanomiya and Sangonomiya, descend into the underwater kingdom, and retrieve the Jade Coral Branch left behind by Orobashi, which was used to suppress the Dragonheir of the Depths. They would then use the Jade Coral Branch to perform the

Watatsumi Mitama Omatsuri Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri

ritual, thus causing the sunken "spirit" to return, which would stop the erosion of the Holy Soil. A variation of the phenomenon existed in Natlan, where phlogiston-rich soils were suppressed using divine nails. The spread of the Holy Soil on Watatsumi is probably related to the geological structure of the island. As the seawater is absorbed, the land becomes dry and solid, the salt displaces nutrients, and the soil becomes inert to the elements and unsuitable for farming. And the Coral Branches contain the power of Orobashi, which can restore the elemental nature of the soil and reverse the effect of bleaching. The Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri ritual is essentially designed to use the serpent god's life force to awaken its second familiars: the Sangacorallia. They are creatures that break down raw, primitive elemental energy into the milder elemental energy of the human realm, and their mass awakening causes a transformation in the ecological environment of Enkanomiya. The giant coral is a symbol that the Sangacorallia have been awakened by the serpent's blood.

![Image 328: The Guardian of Apep Oasis from Genshin Impact has a dark brown and gold mask-like face, with gold decorative protrusions on the head and shoulders, and red accents in the eyes, forehead, and chest area](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/07/237301566/7db3b9feada1531e2ee5071e009c79a1_451701779957585920.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When the time for the next Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri ritual had come, the Divine Priestess, Sangonomiya Kokomi, asked the Traveler and Paimon, who had helped her in the civil war, to descend into Enkanomiya and retrieve the Bloodbranch Coral. After removing the seal and obtaining the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, they opened the entrance to Enkanomiya and descended into the underwater kingdom. There, in the library, they met a strange man named Enjou, which means "above the depths." He introduced himself as a scholar who was sent by someone to help the Traveler and Paimon translate ancient texts. Using his clues, the Traveler and Paimon were able to find the Golden Bridle to remove the protective barrier from Helios and activate the artificial sun. But despite the help he provided, Enjou was acting suspicious and untrustworthy, and one of the Shades of Tokoyo reported that the scholar had the power to dispel his existence. When the Traveler and Paimon found all the fragments of the Reins of Revival needed to open the passage to the Bathysmal Vishap Herd and defeated them, removing the Bloodbranch Coral from them, Enjou suddenly appeared. It turned out that he was an Abyss Lector from the Abyss Order, and his main goal in Enkanomiya was to find the forbidden book "Before Sun and Moon," in which he wanted to find information about Celestia's alien origin. Enjou couldn't find the book in the library or anywhere else, so he assumed the Traveler had it and attacked. When he failed to win the fight, he disappeared, and the Traveler and Paimon rose to the surface to give the Bloodbranch Coral to the Divine Priestess.

**Three Realms Gateway Offering**
=================================
![Image 364: Glowing crystal tower with golden branches sits atop an icy platform floating in space](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/07/237301566/3eedbb236edfd30079133e20c2099bc9_9155306630120246409.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Some time after the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri ritual, the Divine Priestess, Sangonomiya Kokomi, noticed that something was wrong with the ritual. Instead of reversing the Holy Soil phenomenon, the ritual only stopped it. This was the first time in Sangonomiya's history that such a thing had happened, so Kokomi sent several troops to Enkanomiya, but they didn't succeed and were seriously injured. All of Enkanomiya was engulfed in darkness from the Void Abyss that neither humans nor Vishaps could bear, and previously unknown monsters, the Black Serpent Knights, appeared. The priestess Tsumi, who was not on Sangonomiya's list, came down to help the injured. The "priestess" wore an unusual snake mask that covered half of her face, explaining that she had a facial injury that she did not want to frighten others with. Some soldiers said they saw snake pupils behind the mask. With the Sentou Ceremony, she was able to illuminate the Dainichi Mikoshi, where the injured were staying. To find out what had happened, Kokomi again asked the Traveler and Paimon to descend to Enkanomiya. Before they descended, Kokomi gave them a piece of the Sangonomiya relic that would help them when they faced a difficult choice.

![Image 365: Scene from the game Genshin Impact, with an isometric view of the Watatsumi Island location, including water, bridges with ropes and bells, and a statue](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/07/237301566/b948ac47f0b6ddf32f00f30046bf7c80_1077600166197844810.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

After descending into Enkanomiya, the Traveler and Paimon received the Bokuso Box from Tsumi, which could gather light around itself and dispel darkness. They also learned that due to the overwhelming power of the Void Realm, everything in the Light Realm and the Human Realm had frozen, and they needed to go to the three corners of the triangle protecting Enkanomiya. The Towers of the Void at the corners had been restored by a member of the Abyss Order, Enjou, whom the Traveler and Paimon had previously met. He used the Towers of the Void to spread the energy of the Abyss, causing great torment to the Sangacorallia and Bathysmal Vishaps. To get rid of the darkness, they needed to climb to the tops of the towers and activate the Light Realm Chisel, which would let in the energy of the Light Realm. When the Traveler and Paimon connected all the towers and activated the Light Realm Chisel, the darkness began to dissipate, but the Dainichi Mikoshi was enveloped in shadows.

![Image 366: The character with large crown, dark robes, and a cape looks at a dark tower-like structure with glowing branches](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/07/237301566/a6281ca7f0f17746bdbdc3b43d3cecc6_4235814674161287787.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Traveler and Paimon believed that the darkness in the Dainichi Mikoshi was due to Enjou's influence, so they went to meet him. Enjou revealed that Tsumi was an evolved Vishap. There was a legend in Enkanomiya that after their defeat, the Bathysmal Vishaps had to evolve to survive, and they began to imitate the victors. Over time, Vishaps that were indistinguishable from humans except for the shape of their pupils began appearing. They were called the Vishap-people. In the legend, they infiltrated Enkanomiya to replace humans in important positions. As Tsumi had snake-like pupils, the Traveler and Paimon believed that she was using them to take revenge on Enjou, who had betrayed her. He made an alliance with the Vishaps, promising to plunge Enkanomiya into darkness so that they would send the best of the best to the Dainichi Mikoshi to rescue their imprisoned kin. In exchange, they were to guarantee the safe passage to the Abyss Order through their lands and help them rebuild the Towers of the Void. But the Vishaps did not know that the darkness of the Abyss was a terrible poison for elemental beings. Since Enjou's quest to Enkanomiya had been fruitless, he decided to help the Traveler and Paimon channel the light and dispel the darkness in the Dainichi Mikoshi using the mechanisms he had left behind. As a parting gift, he gave them a piece of the ornament he had found in the Dainichi Mikoshi. This piece was the third part of an ornament and was similar to the one Kokomi had given them.

![Image 367: The character is standing in a blue scene with candles](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/07/237301566/400feccc825e5dac9ba0493623ef48aa_4916453309848461991.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

After activating the mechanisms and purifying the Dainichi Mikoshi, the Traveler and Paimon returned to Tsumi. Even though the darkness over the Dainichi Mikoshi had lifted, Tsumi felt as if the tower could hear her wishes. It would change its brightness with just a thought. If Tsumi had wished for it, the tower would have collapsed before her. With a single thought, as if with a snap of the fingers, the source of the great suffering of the Vishaps would have collapsed. But Tsumi could not do this. When the Traveler gave her the two pieces of the medallion at their meeting, Tsumi combined them with her own, and they formed a medallion in the shape of three entwined snakes. 

![Image 368: A mysterious spirit in the shape of a person wearing a hood holding a magical tree branch on one arm and a lantern on the other, surrounded by plants in a bluish landscape](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2025/08/07/237301566/dd24b9b451e2ae8db2f2d645c7b48153_6251536462468880765.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Orobashi's first familiars were

divine vassals.Vassals of Watatsumi

According to legend, these half-human, half-snake creatures helped the Enkanomiyans repel the attack of the Bathysmal Vishaps. Since they lived among humans, they gradually began to resemble them in everything except for their snake pupils, the main distinguishing feature of the Vassals. After Orobashi spent all his strength on creating Watatsumi Island, no more Vassals of Watatsumi were born. However, there is a mention in the records of the last of the Vassals, who was supposed to be the link between the dragons and humans. When she was just an infant girl, she and her guardian shrine maiden were attacked by Vishaps at the border of Enkanomiya, who then raised the girl. The medallion with intertwined snakes belonged to the beginning of the era when Orobashi reorganized the court and reformed Enkanomiya. The three pendants were given to the Dainichi Mikoshi, the Sangonomiya lineage, and the Vassals of Watatsumi. The original intention was that the common folk, the officials, and the divine vassals would all hold each other accountable. Tsumi's medallion fragment was a perfect match for the fragments from Sangonomiya and the Dainichi Mikoshi, only because she was the last Vassal of Watatsumi, but she refused to accept this and returned to the Dragonheir of the Depths.
_"There is a saying in your human books that I've never understood until right now._

_'People belong where they are born, but creatures belong where they are fed.'_

_I am a vishap, not a human. So I'm going back to where I belong._

_I guess the Dainichi Mikoshi isn't my concern. But we'll be back one day."_

When Enkanomiya was cleared and the Traveler and Paimon returned to Sangonomiya Kokomi, she found it necessary to come up with a new way to deal with the Holy Soil so as not to harm the Vishaps anymore. She also said that the legend about the vishap-people is just a fiction, and no records of them exist in the classified records of Sangonomiya.
