**Administrative Area. Dormitory Block**
========================================
![Image 755: A cylindrical tower, embedded with glowing clockwork devices, is in the center of a vast chamber, lit by beams of light from above](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/628776a84b2687d0fe14d98aee9dbdcd_8372827204582201289.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

On the upper level of the Administrative Area, situates the Dormitory Block, where the Dormitories, the Mail Room, the Infirmary, and the Rift of Erosion are located. The Dormitories are the sleeping quarters for prisoners and are one of the main areas where inmates spend their time.

![Image 756: A dimly lit room with stone tile flooring has golden decorations](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/389ae1d8c4159e91f7c6e34e254bfc6b_576172327002414285.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Mail Room is opposite to the Infirmary. In exchange for Credit Coupons, Lutz will help inmates at the Fortress send letters to the surface. The Mail Room is infamous for being the slowest moving queue in the Fortress of Meropide due to Lutz's embellishing of the letters as he types them out. The inmates then have to re-check the letter to make sure they are happy with the results which has a tendency to slow things down. If the inmate passes out, they will only have to start all over again the next day. One person failed three times in a row to send a letter, people call him "Unlucky Decembre." The first time Decembre overslept and couldn't send his son a letter. Next time he woke up early, skipped breakfast, and fainted by the afternoon. He was out cold, and by the time he regained consciousness, the Mail Room was closed for the day. Once, Decembre asked the Traveler to help deliver a birthday letter to his son on the surface, however, in the end, it turned out the letter belonged to someone else.

![Image 757: The image depicts a room that has a table with books on it, two beds, and a character standing by a table in the room](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/30/237301566/fc2a33f9351c6c32fbb9f97f681429c5_8375521877014712432.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The infirmary is where inmates seek help from Sigewinne when they feel unwell. Sigewinne is the head nurse of the Fortress who cares about her patients. Although she's called the head nurse, she handles all the nurse-related work all by herself. She leaves the infirmary a half hour before lunch because usually everyone is busy around that time and there are no patients to look after. A Melusine Ottnit from the Marechaussee Phantom often comes here on her day off to talk to her friend. When Sigewinne gathers with her Melusine friends, they often bet over who'd be able to put more stickers on the Duke's belongings.

![Image 758: A cute cartoon character wearing a white dress with a blue and pink bow on the head, and a red and black bag](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/30/237301566/707a80f16d1238008ffa59d1f9399e4d_8618240651510151459.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Sigewinne herself was once an inmate in the Fortress. Many years ago, Sigewinne became friends with a human girl, but she fell ill. The Melusine was already studying medicine and wanted to cure her friend, but the girl’s parents forbade her since Sigewinne was not human. Sigewinne turned to her teacher, and the doctor gave her a potion that could change her appearance. The Melusine became human-like and was able to save her friend, but was accused of a crime. An ancient law in Fontaine prohibited any attempt to transform other species into a human, so she was sent to the Fortress of Meropide. 

![Image 759: An illustration depicting a young girl sitting at a table, absorbed in reading a book with a group of people silhouettes around her](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/30/237301566/4df69b13083cac59bb566a799dfdc9e2_8854795599681965994.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

After serving her sentence, the Melusine remained there, becoming an important part of the local administrative system. Now Sigewinne is the head nurse of the Fortress, and for patients, she seems like an angel descended from heaven, and the "sun" of the Fortress, which brings a radiant warmth to their dark, damp prison. To thank the "angel" for her kindness and care, the guards added another "unwritten rule" to the set of numerous rules of the Meropide fortress: any who are rude to Sigewinne are punished extra harshly. The inmates, for their part, also have an unspoken agreement that any particularly wild and violent newcomers must receive a "warning" upon being admitted. Sigewinne herself is blissfully unaware of all these customs that have cropped up around her, and simply serves her patients as she always has.
When the Fatui Harbinger Arlecchino, sent Lyney, Lynette and Freminet from the House of the Hearth to investigate the disappearance of another Harbinger, Lynette was supposed to investigate the infirmary, but Sigewinne figured out her plan. Behind the crates, there was a secret passage leading to the Wingalet factory, which the researchers Lourvine and Jurieu used.

On the upper level of the Administrative Area, a former Senior Researcher, Edwin Eastinghouse, and "Intrepid Valberry" can be found. Edwin first was accused of the destruction of the Central Laboratory in the Fontaine Research Institute and was presumed dead, but later found hiding in the Erinnyes Forest. Although he claimed to be innocent, he was sent to the Fortress for harming the institute. "Intrepid Valberry" is "Tricky Bulle Fruit's" friend who left the Fruity Order. Although he and "Tricky Bulle Fruit" live nearby, "Intrepid Valberry" still thinks that his friend is dead while "Tricky Bulle Fruit" believes his eyes deceive him.

![Image 760: Pathway leading to a cave with light streaming from the entrance](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/c5e15180f9f96fa572b329ef88188cd7_1093455000006843264.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Next to Eastinghouse, there's a passage to the Rift of Erosion. Since it connects to the outside, it has to be put under surveillance. The Research Terminal was created to seal the passage and help save manpower. It requires two people to operate it simultaneously. The former researcher from the institute, Clynes, modified it a little and the final form is now deployed at the Geode Mine Shaft.

A girl named Lanoire lives in the Dormitory Block in the room with books. Her mother Agness gave birth to her in the Fortress and didn't have a chance to prepare documents for her daughter. Agness died because of the illness, and Lanoire was left in prison because she didn't exist by documents. She became friends with Caterpillar, who lived in the Fortress of Meropide for 400 years. In this room, Lanoire, Caterpillar, the Traveler, and Paimon gathered to discuss their plans. The Traveler and Paimon also slept there during their time in prison.
In the Dormitory Block, certified TCG players, Rosolino and Carranza, can be found. Rosolino is a staff member of the Fortress who seems to have quite the reputation amongst younger folks, and Carranza is an inmate who loves to engage in theorycrafting, which he has put to good use in analyzing his deck.

**Production Zone**
===================
![Image 796: Steampunk themed room in warm tones with clock faces and lights](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/99275f6d3741bd88bd3461995f8c3856_6233638928344464350.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Production Zone Upper Level is situated directly beneath the Administrative Area, accessible only via the lift from the Production Zone Lower Level. Typically, in the Fortress of Meropide, criminals spend the majority of their time either in the production zone or in their sleeping quarters. The Production Zone is the primary method for earning Credit Coupons, although individuals with alternative skills can opt out of their shifts and acquire coupons through other means. A reporter, Nelly usually spends her time here, "fishing" for good stories. She wants the Platinum Collection to gain new levels of respect for her.

![Image 797: An elaborate clockwork mechanism fills a large, dimly lit space](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/fb1349082aec5e47fb71d3de190fdfd4_2113769819437964899.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Production Zone Lower Level is the main factory for Mek production, where most of the inmates work. There's a special press to process Meks' parts. There is a "hidden rule" of the production zone that people are not supposed to work three days in a row, and if they do, they'll get "strange meat" in their welfare meal. Although the meal looks terrifying, it's cooked by the head nurse Sigewinne. She often visits the production zone to observe the workers' health, and makes a note of anyone who has worn themselves out after three full days of work. Out of her sense of duty as the head nurse as well as her genuine concern for the workers' health, Sigewinne visits the cafeteria right before lunch, and cooks an "extra dish" for those who can use the stamina boost. Sigewinne has only the best intentions with her "surprise gift," and doesn't want anyone to find out about what she does, but as she perceives the world differently from humans, her sense of aesthetics can be very alien to the inmates.
Due to his work in the Production Zone, an inmate Lechlade began to feel dizzy. He thought that the yellow-green stones nearby were affecting his health and that he was going to die there. His symptoms were headaches, heart palpitations, hands and feet growing cold, and a feeling that his head was going to burst. When the Traveler asked the Fortress doctor, Arderne, for help, it turned out that Lechlade misdiagnosed a patient when he was still on the outside, ignoring some early warning results, and healthcare outcomes, and had been paranoid ever since. Receiving the "Pure Water," a mysterious potion said to be the legacy of a certain genius Potioneer, the man immediately started feeling better.

**Abandoned Production Zone**
=============================
![Image 811: A fantasy control panel sits in a steampunk-style chamber](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/2aa62ec24f507bfb216d169d2f7d7b5a_2120635574057118347.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Abandoned Production Zone is the lowest level of the Fortress. It consists of five chambers; one large central chamber, which then connects to four smaller ones via separate passageways. The Multidirectional Connection Control Drive Valve can be used at the center chamber to open the four passageways, one of which is the Geode Mine Shaft. In the past, someone tinkered with the drive valve and trapped their own companion. The Traveler used it to open the passage to Supply Warehouse 1 and rescue Mitul, who uses this space to create fresh "health drinks."

![Image 812: Abstract landscape with a body of water that reflects the bright, vertical formations of green and yellow crystals](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/9157bc96802403ebddda9147d86fbb71_5740311504101191400.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Geode Mine Shaft is filled with Arkhium crystal and is patrolled by Flying Energy Thieves. The Flying Energy Thief is a trial product that has not undergone internal or peer review. It pursues any entity carrying an energy storage device and disables the said device. Loss of control or explosions occurring during the trial product's operation are considered unfortunate accidents for which the manufacturer is not liable. All work related to the Shaft has been suspended, and the connecting paths have been sealed. No one comes there due to its closure. If someone requires one of the connecting paths to be opened for official Fortress business, they must operate the drive valve only under the supervision of a technical expert to prevent accidents. This route has been used by the Traveler, Paimon, and their friends, Caterpillar and Lanoire, to escape the Fortress of Meropide and return to the surface. The guard Noailles tried to stop them but with the help of other guards, Estienne and Maupoil, they escaped the Fortress.

In the Abandoned Production Zone, certified TCG player, Camden, can be found. He seems less enthusiastic about his work as a guard in the Fortress of Meropide than about playing cards. As someone who obtained his certification via correspondence, his true skill is unknown.

**Waters near the Fortress**
============================
![Image 828: Fontaine's Lordly Lamp Whale surrounded by glowing fish in an underwater environment](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/c12edf5ba4ad40e52cc0311310fc95e1_4765907161731430514.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

North of the Fortress, there's an underwater cave where the Millennial Pearl Seahorse resides. It is one of the two sovereigns standing at the apex of the Fontemer Aberrants, along with the Emperor of Fire and Iron. As the greatest predator that can arise from seahorses, this being's evolutionary journey is not the same as that experienced by other Fontemer Aberrants. It did not start from a base form before growing larger and stronger, but instead grew limbs and a horn that have no place on an ordinary seahorse. Even its musculature and skeleton have changed. It really seems to resemble a fantastical beast from legend more than its original shape. In the imaginations of poets and authors, even seahorses can frolick upon the earth.

![Image 829: Aetherium War Hunt Boss, an abstract digital artwork, is shown in purple with glowing accent lighting](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/750d5b3ed6a0a894ee82f45ad35e84fa_3994233532105108946.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Poets and authors often proclaim it to be proud and noble due to its solitary tendencies, but the true reason behind such adulatory descriptions is its elegant and slender body. As such, it is a "Pearl Seahorse," while the suzerain of the Armored Crabs is an "Emperor." In the legends and rumors of Fontaine, a brutal war was once waged among the Aberrants of the Fontemer, leaving only the "Millennial Pearl Seahorse" and "Emperor of Fire and Iron" splitting the great lake into two courts, one ruling over the north, the other the south. In the "Song of Dobharcu," the writer describes the outcome of the war: the great Hunter's Ray known as the Stormlord stirred huge waves in its death throes, causing what is now known by the people as the "first diluvian period." 

![Image 830: The purple and pink dragon has a blue jewel on its chest](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/fdd9aeb39dce966b39b22e6821f55329_8611331725160706177.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Of course, all of this is nothing more than the romantic imaginations of people who are unwilling to accept the bland realities of the world. For the Fontemer Aberrants are in fact just simple aquatic animals, and they have no grand courts nor fallen kingdoms, nor do they possess words meant to exalt or curse.

After his trip to Natlan, Ranjit, a chef of creative cuisines, decided to "befriend" the Seahorse because of its resemblance to a famous flying Saurian, Iktomisaurus. Iktomisaurus was a companion of Kuntur, Unloved of the Sun. There's a story that he became the target of the sun's hatred due to a mistake his father made. He was ostracized in his tribe, and no other Saurian would become his companion.

![Image 831: Golden machine rests in an underwater setting with rocks, flora, and a stone tile platform](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/aa0fc9459ec54a9e42d0339d09a5cc11_8054730622535405438.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Above the Millennial Pearl Seahorse's cave, there's an Imperfect Underwater Patrol Mek, New-Type Patrol Mek M-7.

There's a tunnel at the intersection of Liffey Region and Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region leading from the Seahorse's cave to a secret forging press at Bravais' Press Works which was abandoned after Senior Researcher Bravais' death.

![Image 832: Construct golem stands near a campfire and glowing disk in a campground scene](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/c1b662efc7cef54781ee5caba2f5dd14_1224997123471031911.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

One of the Imperfect Meks of the Fontaine Research Institute, New-Type Purification Mek D-503, stands in this tunnel. The tunnel also leads to the Kuisel's Workshop in the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region. The Press requires seven pieces of Mysterious Ore combined into Arkhium Stock to produce Arkhium Lumenite. This special key can open Bravais' Hidden Study.

![Image 833: Submerged, machine-like structure in teal underwater depths](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/30/237301566/59d4d89591394548a3a9dff7fa7d7ed2_4274570679530522347.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Working on the Forging Press has several rules. Before initiating the pressing process, the operator must wear protective gear at all times, perform a comprehensive equipment inspection, and ensure the Arkhium Stock has been placed correctly. The equipment's energy supply system has to be checked. 

![Image 834: A golden industrial tower stands in a large room with a floor patterned with gold trim](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/30/237301566/74881a598b992f81fd66b9f09502e1ab_1251908849876494402.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

To produce Arkhium Lumenite, the operator has to activate the press using the hammers with the right timing. To facilitate the operator's self-inspection, a fail-safe system has been installed on the base of currently available equipment models. The operator can troubleshoot system problems based on the errors reported by the fail-safe system. Some common errors include insufficient energy supply, system overheating, water entering the system, and blocked emergency drainage pipes. During one of the press's maintenance, leaks were discovered in the cooling system. If someone were to remove the seals that cover the leaks and operate the cooling system, the whole room would be instantly filled with a huge amount of water, and the Forging Press would be utterly ruined.

**House of the Hearth**
=======================
![Image 852: Anime woman with closed eyes and long flowing red hair stands in front of a window with an art deco design, holding a book with glowing light patterns on its cover, while wearing black gloves, a black cape, and a jeweled choker](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/a32cc8c6f80c32247adf3b48836b4993_3009902221930885354.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Crucabena was the original Knave, the fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. During her time as the director of the House of the Hearth orphanage, she taught the children to fight and forced them to duel each other. One would then be crowned the victor and the "king" of the House after having proved themselves most worthy of inheriting the title. She forced her daughter Clervie to join the House of the Hearth as a means to demonstrate her own impartiality as a "Mother" — to show that she treated all her children equally. It's difficult to estimate the number of children who died or were maimed in the process. The ones that emerged with permanent injuries would be handed over to The Doctor, second of the Fatui Harbingers, to be experimented on; or sent away on dangerous missions; nothing more than tools to be used and then discarded.

![Image 853: Two anime characters with swords engaged in combat, in an anime scene](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/a201b815a1a4c359a701255778b2a388_3616433964507356012.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Arlecchino, then known as Peruere, was a child within the House of the Hearth and suggested taking down "Mother" herself. Clervie, who had become her close friend at the time, rejected that proposal claiming that, as a famous Harbinger, Crucabena possessed an unimaginable amount of power. Clervie never gave another reason, but Peruere could see Clervie still thought of Crucabena as her mother, and killing her own flesh and blood was a line she couldn't bring herself to cross.

![Image 854: Massive explosion happening over water surface with light blue vortexes around it](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/6867de4c8209319eb8e517a65e92c411_7997600774634647148.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Ultimately, Clervie decided to let Peruere end her life so that Peruere could kill "Mother." When Peruere killed Crucabena a year later , she was taken as a prisoner to Snezhnaya and the Tsaritsa pardoned her for her crimes. Peruere then became a Harbinger and was bestowed a new name by the Tsaritsa, Arlecchino. After Crucabena was defeated, the moniker of "Mother" died with her. Arlecchino rebuilt the House of the Hearth under a new identity, not only as Arlecchino, but as "Father."

![Image 855: Two anime girls with light hair sit with a book on a blue stage in front of a decorative blue window](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/42020152b5a1ae69aa0d7f28d3d202d2_1946223361810276792.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

After death at Peruere's hand, Clervie had become a shadow, an illusion born of flame. Although she died at 16 years old, her shadow was much younger. She would look after the children and even saved some of their lives. Other times, she would hide from Arlecchino and become obsessed with revealing the "truth" about the House to anyone who would listen. As shadows don't have the capacity to learn or grow, any new information they encounter has been quickly forgotten over time. Clervie was unable to recognize that the present House of the Hearth was unlike the one she grew up in under Crucabena, and Arlecchino needed to deal with Clervie to resolve the matter.

![Image 856: An arena-like area filled with many red stalagmites and a character in the center, set against a red-tinted sunset sky](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/d5344c6e55386888dd387779781f5f1b_3375078380423470229.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

One day, some of the children of the House of the Hearth arrived at the Scattered Ruins with the "traitors," Filliol and Nanteuil. Arlecchino had labeled them as traitors as they acted against the interests of the House of the Hearth, and for that, they were to be executed. Lyney, Lynette, and Freminet chose to conceal a threat to the House, Clervie, so they were also to be punished later. Arlecchino planned to perform an execution but Lyney begged her to stop, arguing that her actions would tear the family apart. Chapleau sided with Lyney which led Arlecchino to agree to a duel. The Traveler, Lynette, and Freminet also sided with Lyney and began to duel with the Knave, however, they were no match for the Harbinger and they were defeated. Moved by their determination to spare the ''traitors,'' Arlecchino was willing to change the rules and allow Filliol and the others to leave if they wanted to. They ultimately decided they did want to leave and Arlecchino gave them bottled flames, which would "kill" the House version of them by wiping all the memories they made while they were members.

![Image 857: Anime characters against mountainous background with greenery, a small waterfall, and a temple structure](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/20/237301566/799f5ff50df9f2389c46c869b81d41e8_8889551073379338694.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When everyone left, Arlecchino spoke with Clervie, who followed the children to the ruins of the previous House of the Hearth, and told her the truth about what had happened in the past. The Knave then released Clervie from the House, fulfilling her dream to see the sun. As Clervie faded away in peace, Arlecchino admitted there was more she wanted to tell her.The potion had been administered to those who wanted to leave, however, Lyney, Lynette, and Freminet chose not to consume it and remain members of the House of the Hearth. Arlecchino saw Lyney as a "King" because his conviction was strong, and she knew he would only continue to grow stronger. This same conviction helped her win against Crucabena despite their difference in strength at the time.

**Fortress of Meropide**
========================
![Image 871: Elaborately designed scales holding glowing blue water drops inside a golden room](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/f9637e460d788f9ba3c8144200245850_8215231806489262316.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

When the Traveler visited Fontaine, the city was experiencing a series of disappearances, and authorities had accused Childe, eleventh of the Fatui Harbingers, of being the culprit. Despite the actual culprit having already been exposed and sentenced during the trial, Childe was imprisoned at the Fortress of Meropide after being found guilty by the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale, a large mechanical scale located in the Court of Fontaine's Opera Epiclese which was created by the Hydro Archon Focalors. The Oratrice delivered precise judgments, and regardless of the Chief Justice's, Neuvillette, opinion during the trial, the Oratrice held the final verdict. After a period of time, Childe disappeared.

![Image 872: Arlecchino from Genshin Impact sits at a table with a turquoise lamp and a purple teacup, resting her chin on her hand with a thoughtful expression](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/bcd22c2364dddfabdd2d02d5d2dc0ee0_8866879075450635765.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Another Fatui Harbinger, The Knave, soon sought a diplomatic meeting with Furina which Neuvillette also attended. During the meeting,

Arlecchino The Knave

requested Childe be turned over to Snezhnaya, citing their diplomatic roles and responsibilities. However, since the trial concluded, Fontaine saw the case as settled, and Neuvillette denied The Knave's request. The Harbinger then proposed visiting the Fortress of Meropide to check on Childe, but Neuvillette explained the Fortress of Meropide falls outside the court's jurisdiction and offered an alternative proposal. As Childe has vanished from prison, with no sightings reported outside, he proposed delegating someone else to investigate, which she reluctantly accepted.

![Image 873: Vault-like golden metal door that is set in a dark room with golden accents](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/399b775edc930c1479685ea47dc886e3_3348882611891200546.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Traveler and Paimon made an agreement with Neuvillette to investigate Childe's disappearance under the guise of being prisoners in order to gather information on the Harbinger's whereabouts. The Fatui had sent their own infiltrators as informants to both the prisoners and guards, but they vanished. Subsequently, Lyney, Lynette, and Freminet were dispatched to infiltrate the fortress and gather intelligence. The "Father" of their House, The Knave, instructed them to conduct an investigation into the secret the Fortress of Meropide was hiding. The House of the Hearth had been investigating for a very long time, trying to uncover the mystery, when all of their informants, including the ones that had infiltrated the guards, suddenly vanished. Additionally, Arlecchino had somehow managed to confirm that Focalors did not possess Hydro Gnosis. It was this information that led them to suspect that Fontaine's Gnosis might be in the Fortress of Meropide, and related to that "secret." The Knave used the situation with Childe as a pretext to negotiate with two high-ranking officials in the Court of Fontaine. Childe was almost like a bargaining chip for her.

During their investigation, Lyney uncovered the fact that the Fortress of Meropide has a "forbidden zone" which was confirmed by the guards. After some persuasion, the Duke of the Fortress, Wriothesley, agreed to escort the Traveler and Paimon into the forbidden zone. They arrived at one of the three giant isolation gates, where only Wriothesley was allowed inside. The concentration of the Primordial Sea in the waters surrounding the Fortress of Meropide had started to rise, and the "forbidden zone" contained a massive sluice gate that was holding back the Primordial Sea.

![Image 874: Cosmic leviathan silhouette dominates a swirling, galaxy-like background, punctuated by a minuscule human figure](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/fe528b8667e756f11c1c864866b74822_7540592123183275540.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The rise of the Primordial Sea was especially concerning due to a prophecy circulating throughout Fontaine that said that every person in Fontaine was born with "sin," and one day, the water levels in Fontaine would rise causing the sinful people to slowly drown. _"In the end, the people will all be dissolved into the waters, and only the Hydro Archon will remain, weeping on her throne."_ Later it was revealed that Childe's disappearance was linked to a mysterious voice he heard while in the Fortress of Meropide. Following this voice, Childe escaped the Fortress and ended up in the Primordial Sea where he lost consciousness. He awoke with a massive narwhal swimming before him. He proceeded to battle with the Narwhal and inadvertently delayed the prophecy from coming true.

![Image 875: Enormous steampunk airship floats through the sky above the clouds with a giant fog water jet shooting from underneath](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/06/17/178140791/30e52c0f12e3a9272267dce7b8a66666_8035890872333343610.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In an attempt to save people should the prophecy come true, Wriothesley recruited Jurieu and Lourvine to help build a gargantuan ship which was also kept at the Fortress. According to the legend, the Remurian God King, Remus, came to Fontaine after being inspired by divine revelation and found the seer Sybilla, who had taken on the form of a Golden Bee. Taking Sybilla with him and riding on a huge ship, the Fortuna, he created his nation above the surging waves. Wriothesley was inspired by the legendary Fortuna and began constructing a boat when he suspected the Primordial Sea lay beyond the gate. When the Prophecy of Fontaine came to fruition, the Duke deployed the gargantuan ship, The Wingalet, to help with rescue operations. Once the waters receded, the ship returned to the prison and was placed in storage, garnering significant media attention and intriguing several researchers.

18.content:
The full schedule for Masquerade of the Guilty.

         ![Image 1](https://assetsio.gnwcdn.com/Genshin-Impact-4.2-release-date%2C-4.2-Banner-and-event-details-cover.jpg?width=690&quality=85&format=jpg&dpr=3&auto=webp)

Image credit: HoYoverse

The **4.2 Banner and event details** have been officially announced for the latest patch, titled Masquerade of the Guilty.

As always, there are two Banner phases and new time-limited events in the latest update, with [Genshin Impact](https://www.eurogamer.net/games/genshin-impact) version 4.2 featuring one new 5-Star character, and another expansion to [Fontaine](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-fontaine-guide-characters-archon-quests-world-9326).

Below, you can find out the **4.2 release date and time**, who the returning characters are, and what the **4.2 Banners and events schedule** is for the upcoming patch.

Be sure to also check out our [Genshin Impact codes](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-codes-livestream-active-working-how-to-redeem-9026) page to get free Primogems that can be used towards unlocking new [characters](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-tier-list-best-characters-main-dps-healer-support-9026) and weapons.

On this page:

*   [4.2 Banners](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-4-2-release-date-time-banner-schedule-events-9326#section-1)
*   [4.2 events](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-4-2-release-date-time-banner-schedule-events-9326#section-2)
*   [4.2 release date and time](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-4-2-release-date-time-banner-schedule-events-9326#section-3)

Genshin Impact 4.2 Banners
--------------------------

The version 4.2 Banners debut new 5-Star character **Furina**, the Hydro Archon of Fontaine, and new 4-Star **Charlotte**.

Phase 1 of the 4.2 Banner schedule begins with **new Hydro 5-Star Furina**, featured in her Chanson of Many Waters Banner Banner, and **returning Dendro 5-Star Baizhu** featured in his Immaculate Pulse Banner. New Cryo 4-Star Charlotte also debuts in both Furina and Baizhu's Banner.

As usual, the 4.2 Phase 1 Banners will run alongside each other, and are available from Wednesday 8th November until they end on Tuesday 28th November.

![Image 2: furina, baizhu, and charlotte event wish preview with their spalsh art and chibi version of the female traveler, furina, and neuvillette in the bottom right](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-banners-4.2-furina-baizhu.jpg)

Image credit: HoYoverse

In Phase 2 of the 4.2 Banner schedule we have **returning Electro 5-Star Cyno**'s Twilight Arbiter Banner and **returning Hydro 5-Star Ayato**'s Azure Excursion Banner.

These Phase 2 Banners are expected to run from Tuesday 28th November until they end on Tuesday 19th December - the day before the expected release date of the 4.3 update.

![Image 3: cyno and ayato event wish preview with their spalsh art and chibi version of the female traveler, furina, and neuvillette in the bottom right](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-banners-4.2-cyno-ayato.jpg)

Image credit: HoYoverse

In summary, all of the new characters and returning 5-Star characters you can Wish on during 4.2 in Genshin Impact are:

*   **[Furina](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-furina-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations) (Chanson of Many Waters Banner - Phase 1)**: New 5-Star Hydro character who uses a sword.
*   **[Baizhu](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-baizhu-ascension-talent-materials-best-build-team-weapon-artifact-constellations-9326) (Immaculate Pulse Banner - Phase 1)**: Returning 5-Star Dendro character who uses a catalyst.
*   **Charlotte (Chanson of Many Waters and Immaculate Pulse Banners - Phase 1)**: New 4-Star Cryo character who uses a catalyst.
*   **[Cyno](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-cyno-ascension-talent-materials-best-build-weapon-artifact-constellation-team-9026) (Twilight Arbiter Banner - Phase 2)**: Returning 5-Star Electro character who uses a polearm.
*   **Ayato (Azure Excursion Banner - Phase 2)**: Returning 5-Star Hydro character who uses a sword.

There will also be a new weapon in Phase 1 of the version 4.2 weapon Banner: the 5-Star Splendor of Tranquil Waters sword, Furina's signature.

![Image 4: new sword weapon 'splendor of tranquil waters' on a blue background and chibi version of the female traveler, furina, and neuvillette in the bottom right](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-new-weapons-4.2-phase-1.jpg)

Image credit: HoYoverse

To keep up to date with who the boosted 4-Star characters and weapons will be, and all other Banner changes, check out our regularly updated [Banner schedule](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-next-banner-current-list-all-history-9026) page.

* * *

_Version 6.2 has brought the new 5-Star [Durin](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-durin-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations) and the new 4-Star [Jahoda](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-jahoda-materials-ascension-talent-kit-constellations). So don't forget to redeem [new codes](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-codes-livestream-active-working-how-to-redeem-9026) for [Primogems](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-primogems-free-daily-how-to-get-wishes-9026) to help pull them, and check out our regularly updated [tier list](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-tier-list-best-characters-main-dps-healer-support-9026). You need luck from the [Pity and 50/50 systems](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-hard-soft-pity-50-epitomized-path-system-explained-9026) to [Wish with Fate](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-how-to-wish-get-fate-intertwined-acquaint-explained-9026) for characters on [Banners](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-next-banner-current-list-all-history-9026), and you always need the right [Adventure Rank](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-increase-adventure-rank-world-level-genshin-impact-9026) for events. Elsewhere, we have [tips and tricks for beginners](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-beginners-guide-tips-tricks-9326)._

* * *

Genshin Impact 4.2 events
-------------------------

The Genshin Impact 4.2 update includes:

*   Act V of Fontaine's Archon Questline
*   Furina Story Quest
*   Two new [Fontaine](https://www.eurogamer.net/genshin-impact-fontaine-guide-characters-archon-quests-world-9326) areas
*   New Boss
*   New World Quests
*   Quick start for Weekly Bosses
*   Stellar Reunion update
*   Quest notification optimizations when logging in on different platforms
*   New TCG cards and improvements, including deck sharing codes and more decks
*   Story Quest optimizations
*   Ley Line Overflow event (11th December to 18th of December)

![Image 5](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-4.2-events-1.jpg)

In addition to this content, we're getting the usual **four events** during the 4.2 update to Genshin Impact. Here's everything we know about every time-limited event in Genshin Impact 4.2:

### Misty Dungeon: Realm of Water

Misty Dungeon: Realm of Water **starts on Thursday 9th November and ends on Monday 20th November**. You need to be at least [Adventure Rank](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-increase-adventure-rank-world-level-genshin-impact-9026) 20 in order to take part.

Misty Dungeon is a standard combat event that pits you against waves of enemies, but each challenge has a different Ley Line buff to encourage you to change up your party. There are also trial characters available to test out.

![Image 6](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-4.2-events-8.jpg)

Image credit: HoYoverse

### Graph Adversarial Technology Experiment Log

Graph Adversarial Technology Experiment Log **starts on Friday 17th November and ends on Monday 27th November**. You need to be at least [Adventure Rank](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-increase-adventure-rank-world-level-genshin-impact-9026) 20, and have completed the Prologue Act 3 'Song of the Dragon and Freedom' Archon Quest in order to take part.

This is a daily location event that requires you to take pictures of sample types described in clues, and you can handily swap sample types with your friends to help complete challenges.

Beware that any unused film will be cleared at the end of each day.

At the end of this event quest, you get the Zoom Lens for the Kamera gadget, which lets you zoom in and out when taking photographs. However, don't worry if you don't complete the event quest, as the Zoom Lens is available even after it ends.

![Image 7](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-4.2-events-7.jpg)

Image credit: HoYoverse

### Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures

Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures **starts on Thursday 23rd November and ends on Monday 11th December**. You need to be at least [Adventure Rank](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-increase-adventure-rank-world-level-genshin-impact-9026) 20, and have completed the Prologue Act 3 'Song of the Dragon and Freedom' Archon Quest in order to take part.

For the Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures, the traveller and Paimon help Freminet make some improvements to his clockwork penguin throughout three gameplay stages: Basic Circuit Structure, Record of the Search, and Swirling Vortex's Paean.

**Basic Circuit Structure** is a puzzle mini-game where you reconnect wires to circuits, **Record of the Search** is a collectible task where you have to use an Echoing Conch item to find items needed to repair Freminet's penguin, and **Swirling Vortex's Paean** pits your team and Freminet's penguin against enemies in combat challenges.

When you complete enough challenges, **you get the 4-Star Freminet character for free**.

![Image 8](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-4.2-events-5.jpg)

Image credit: HoYoverse

### Lil Fungi's Fan-tastic Fiesta

The Lil Fungi event **starts on Wednesday 6th December and ends on Monday 18th December**. You need to be at least [Adventure Rank](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-increase-adventure-rank-world-level-genshin-impact-9026) 20, and have completed the Prologue Act 3 'Song of the Dragon and Freedom' Archon Quest in order to take part.

Haniyyah returns with another Fungi event in Fontaine! This is the top-down mini-game variety, which involves sending your Fungi creatures out to defeat enemies in a small tactical battlefield. There are more enemy types to defeat in this version of the event, including Slimes.

![Image 9](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-4.2-events-6.jpg)

Image credit: HoYoverse

Genshin Impact 4.2 release date and time
----------------------------------------

Genshin Impact 4.2 will release on **Wednesday 8th November**. It should follow the usual maintenance schedule for new updates, with 4.2 releasing at 3am (GMT). Due to time zone differences, 4.2 releases in the United States on Tuesday 7th November at 7pm (PT).

For other time zones, the **Genshin Impact 4.2 release date and time** is:

*   **East Coast US**: Tuesday 7th November, 10pm (ET)
*   **Central US**: Tuesday 7th November, 9pm (CT)
*   **West Coast US**:Tuesday 7th November, 7pm (PT)
*   **Australia**: Wednesday 8th November, 2pm (AET)
*   **Japan**: Wednesday 8th November, 12pm (JST)
*   **Europe**: Wednesday 8th November, 4am (CET)
*   **UK**: Wednesday 8th November, 3am (GMT)

As this is only an approximate time for how long the servers are down, you might be able to play the 4.2 patch a little before or after the times above - although previous update estimates have been fairly accurate.

![Image 10](https://www.eurogamer.net/Genshin-Impact-4.2-release-date-and-time-1.jpg)

Image credit: HoYoverse

Hope you have fun during version 4.2!

![Image 36: Genshin Impact - Fortress of Meropide Location and Lore](https://img.game8.co/3765198/de1ee7a0eecd80d22a1517e8c479bff4.png/show)

Fortress of Meropide in Genshin Impact 4.1 is an underwater prison located in the Liffey Region of Fontaine, where criminals are exiled as punishment for their crimes. See its location, how to unlock, map and areas, puzzles, and lore details here!

List of Contents

*   [How to Unlock](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hl_1)
*   [Location](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hl_2)
*   [Puzzles](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hl_3)
*   [Quests](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hl_4)
*   [Lore](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hl_5)
*   [Related Guides](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hl_6)

How to Unlock Fortress of Meropide
----------------------------------

### Use the Lift During Chapter 4, Act 3

![Image 37: Genshin - Fortress of Meropide Archon Quest Entrance](https://img.game8.co/3770882/eadd76e2e2db64625c6d53a92e7dd781.png/show)

You can enter the Fortress of Meropide through an elevator behind the Opera Epiclese during the **Chapter 4: Act 3** Archon Quest!

[Chapter 4: Act 3 Archon Quest Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426286)

### Get Caught by the Tower's Searchlight

![Image 38: Genshin - Fortress of Meropide Searchlight](https://img.game8.co/3770874/f96942740301b1b5f105f2fc7cdd15f6.png/show)

You can enter the Fortress of Meropide by entering the Searchlight's Detection Range in the underwater area of the Liffey Region. After staying in the Searchlight for too long, guards will detain you and take you inside the Fortress of Meropide.

### Enter the Underwater Pipe

![Image 39: Genshin - Fortress of Meropide Underwater Entrance](https://img.game8.co/3770875/4290a023ed1ec00b392d5adaf1c56306.png/show)

There is an underwater opening that leads to the Fortress of Meropide near the southern underwater waypoint in the Liffey Region. Simply enter the big pipe and get caught by an official on the way to enter the Fortress of Meropide!

Fortress of Meropide Location
-----------------------------

### Located on Liffey Region

![Image 40: Genshin - Fortress of Meropide Underwater](https://img.game8.co/3765081/b5ed790887d450a3edfeeea9f48aae30.png/show)

You can find the Fortress of Meropide in the [Liffey Region of Fontaine](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426430). Players will need to dive underwater to get to this underground location.

[Fontaine Map Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/398422)

### Heavily Involved with 4.1 Archon Quest

### Fortress of Meropide Map and Areas

![Image 42: Genshin Impact Fortress of Meropide - Maps and Areas](https://img.game8.co/3775106/ab90310ecbefa4aa06cc4ac834b17b24.png/show)

The Fortress of Meropide's map has 6 Levels, each corresponding to a certain area within the Fortress. Despite being a massive prison with a maze-like structure, there are only four Waypoints inside the Fortress, and one of which is Hidden!

#### All Fortress of Meropide Levels

![Image 43: Genshin Impact - Fortress of Meropide Map Guide - Fortress Layers](https://img.game8.co/3776736/c1430851b9c2fbc7ac663e03a4d7dd7a.png/show)

1.   [Reception Area](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hs_2)
2.   [Dormitory Block](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hs_3)
3.   [Administrative Area](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hs_4)
4.   [Production Zone Upper Level](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hs_5)
5.   [Production Zone Lower Level](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hs_6)
6.   [Abandoned Production Zone](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290#hs_7)

#### Reception Area

![Image 44: Genshin Impact Fortress of Meropide - Reception Area](https://img.game8.co/3775107/e98c88705e3671cb07023fcc39db4f76.png/show)

The upper-most level of the Fortress that we get to first visit only during the Archon Quest [Chapter 4, Act 3](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426286). The lift from the Reception Area connects directly at the entrance behind the Opera Epiclese.

#### Dormitory Block

![Image 45: Genshin Impact Fortress of Meropide - Dormitory Block](https://img.game8.co/3775108/b7db806244f2bfb89dfa135463183e7b.png/show)

The Dormitory Block is the next level beneath the Reception Area, but it's technically part of the floor where the Administrative Area is located. The Dormitory Block also has the Administrative Area Waypoint, located south of the Fortress!

The Dormitory Block houses **your cell**, the **Mail Room** and **Infirmary**, and the **Rift of Erosion**.

#### Administrative Area

![Image 46: Genshin Impact Fortress of Meropide - Administrative Area](https://img.game8.co/3775109/b980e9d66d043bd6655822f051075084.png/show)

The Administrative Area is the floor below the Dormitory Block, which you can access by either teleporting to the Administrative Area Waypoint then jumping down, or by teleporting to using the Fortress icon in the minimap!

This area acts as the main hall of the entire Fortress, where notable areas like the **Coupon Cafeteria**, [Rag and Bone Shop](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/428863), **Pankration Ring**, and [Wriothesley](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/Wriothesley-Best-Builds)**'s Office** are located!

#### Production Zone Upper Level

![Image 47: Genshin Impact Fortress of Meropide - Production Zone Upper Level](https://img.game8.co/3775110/9230f1c872997581efb3d3d9215d7ace.png/show)

The Production Zone Upper Level is directly located below the Administrative Area, but it can only be reached through the lift from the Production Zone Lower Level!

#### Production Zone Lower Level

![Image 48: Genshin Impact Fortress of Meropide - Production Zone Lowel Level](https://img.game8.co/3775111/9076ae1c46f04044874fb79053a84a50.png/show)

The Production Zone Lower Level has its own Waypoint to easily access it but, alternatively, you can use the lift in the Administrative Area located just past the Pankration Ring to get to this level.

#### Abandoned Production Zone

![Image 49: Genshin Impact Fortress of Meropide - Abandoned Production Zone](https://img.game8.co/3775112/e6c4307334058084ac94c728d22b7b93.png/show)

The Abandoned Production Zone is the lowest level of the Fortress, and is where the [Drive Valve](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/428264) mechanism is located. This valve opens to four locations, and one of which, is the **Geode Mine Shaft**, where the **hidden waypoint** of the Fortress is located!

Do take note that you can only unlock the Geode Mine Shaft and its waypoint by doing the [Unfinished Comedy](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/428383) Quest Line, specifically the **Eye for an Eye** subquest.

[Eye for an Eye Quest Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/428382)

### Coupon Cafeteria

![Image 50: Genshin Impact - Fortress of Meropide - Coupon Cafeteria](https://img.game8.co/3766199/baffc8660aa658811fc4aae3257ff3c9.png/show)

Like any other prison, the Fortress of Meropide provides meals to its inmates via the Coupon Cafeteria. Each inmate is entitled to one **Welfare Meal** a day, which includes a **free meal** and a **fortune slip.**

With enough [Credit Coupons](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426604), Travelers can purchase additional meals of their choice!

### Rag and Bone Shop

![Image 51: Genshin Impact - Fortress of Meropide - Rag and Bone Shop](https://img.game8.co/3766200/911deeddc0a51a2ae6782639661d616c.png/show)

The Fortress of Meropide also comes with a merchandise shop, Rag and Bone Shop, where Travelers can purchase a variety of items in exchange for **Credit Coupons**.

Some of these items can even be used to achieve victory in the Pankration!

### Pankration Ring

![Image 52: Genshin Impact - Fortress of Meropide - Pankration Ring](https://img.game8.co/3766201/1abf838dad03f54fe0a7173d9c53fc53.png/show)

The Pankration, or **Pankration Ring**, is an underground ring in the Fortress of Meropide that serves as its primary source of entertainment. It may be a place where Travelers can put their skills to the test!

### Energy Transfer Terminals

![Image 53: Genshin Impact Fortress of Meropide - Puzzles](https://img.game8.co/3775115/c0c136f250e31583554ee9462dbcfb54.png/show)

The Fortress of Meropide is not without its own share of tricky and mind-boggling puzzles and mechanisms! Within the Fortress lies several **Energy Transfer Terminals** and **Cipher Codes** to test your puzzle solving prowess!

Fortress of Meropide Lore Details
---------------------------------

### Governed by the Duke, Wriothesley

![Image 55: Genshin - Wriothesley Showcase](https://img.game8.co/3765046/006be049065738da75047193c2648861.png/show)

The administrator and warden of Fontaine's prison is none other than **Wriothesley**. It's said that the Duke protects the weak while keeping the exiled troublemakers at bay with his intimidating looks and powerful fists.

After getting into power, Wriothesley introduced new reforms to the prison, which created communities and culture amongst the convicts.

[Wriothesley Character Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/Wriothesley-Best-Builds)

### The Exiles' Life and Work

![Image 56: Genshin Impact - Fortress of Meropide - Workers and Meka](https://img.game8.co/3766205/acab73dcaa8f062962be0a1a46752101.png/show)

The Fortress is not just a prison but also a growing community of exiled criminals. They work through labor to get supplies, buy from shops, and facilitate busy work while imprisoned.

### Fontaine's Largest Clockwork Meka Manufacturer

![Image 57: Genshin - Fortress of Meropide Meka Manufacturing Factory](https://img.game8.co/3765197/8922b5c01d16470ef9d549bca412d1ee.png/show)

Apart from serving as housing for Fontaine's convicts, the Fortress of Meropide is also where the majority of Fontaine's [Clockwork Mekas](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/420292) are created.

### Draws Inspiration from Steampunk Aspects

![Image 58: Genshin Impact - Fortress of Meropide - Steampunk Design](https://img.game8.co/3766206/30edd0fe755bcfb40f713bddcd24757a.png/show)

Inspired by the steampunk aesthetic, the prison is filled with bending pipes and steel to give a sense of the soltitude and bleak lifestyle of the Fontaine criminals.

26.title: Genshin Impact Fontaine Region Guide - Genshin Impact Guide - IGN
26.description: The Genshin Impact Fontaine region is the place to be if you want to continue the Archon Quests, see a brilliant live performance at the Opera Epiclese, or go
26.content:
advertisement

The Genshin Impact Fontaine region is the place to be if you want to continue the Archon Quests, see a brilliant live performance at the Opera Epiclese, or go for a swim. This **Genshin Impact Fontaine guide** will point you towards every key location, quest, local specialty, and boss fight found in the Nation of Justice.

The Fontaine region was added in Genshin Impact 4.0, released on August 16, 2023. Fontaine is located in the northwestern part of Teyvat. If you haven’t discovered it yet, take a look at our [guide on how to reach Fontaine](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/How_to_Get_to_Fontaine) in Genshin Impact.

Fontaine Map
------------

The picture below shows the full Fontaine map as released in Genshin Impact version 4.0, including all three **Statues of the Seven**. Some parts of the map are underwater, with the most important underwater area being the large sea in the center. For more info on Fontaine's underwater world, take a look at our [Fontaine underwater exploration guide](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Fontaine_Underwater_Exploration_Locations_and_Tips).

The Fontaine maps shown below were added in Genshin Impact version 4.1. You can see the regular map on the left, and the "underwater" map on the right. This part of Fontaine lies north of the Court of Fontaine, and includes The Linney Region and the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region.

The map shown below was added in Genshin Impact Version 4.2. It shows the new Erinnyes Forest and Morte Region on the left, and the new underwater region on the right.

In Genshin Impact version 4.6, the Nostoi region was added to Fontaine. This region lies to the south of Fontaine, between Sumeru and Chenyu Vale. At first glance, the Nostoi region consists of nothing but sea and a small island, Petrichor:

However, if you follow the Canticles of Harmony world quest series starting on Petrichor, you'll discover a hidden map: the Sea of Bygone Eras. This special Fontaine sub-region is a submerged ocean world with additional cave mini-maps and a large palace.

Fontaine Key Locations
----------------------

The locations listed below play a key role in Fontaine's story. While most of them are pretty hard to miss, make sure you pay them a visit.

*   **Court of Fontaine**: the big city. You'll find shops, a blacksmith, and the Adventurers' Guild in this location.
*   **Opera Epiclese**: As one of the most famous buildings in Fontaine, this massive opera house is used for performances as well as court hearings. You can find this building in the northeastern part of the map.
*   **Merusea Village**: A large, underground area in the Beryl sub-region, southern Fontaine. It's home to the Melusine people. To reach Merusea Village, do the world quest called [A Brush of Seafoam and Crimson](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/A_Brush_of_Seafoam_and_Crimson "A Brush of Seafoam and Crimson (page does not exist)"), which is part of the Ancient Colors quest series. 
*   **Fortress of Meropide**: a massive underwater prison located in the Linney Region, northwestern Fontaine. Archon Quest Chapter 4 Act 3, "To the Stars Shining in the Depths", will take you there.
*   **Tower of Ipsissimus**: an enormous tower located in Fontaine's Morte Region - although its position might change once you've completed the world quest called "In the Wake of Narcissus". 
*   **Sea of Bygone Eras**: this mysterious sea region isn't part of the standard Fontaine map. Instead, the Sea of Bygone Eras is a Fontaine "subregion" that can be accessed from Petrichor Island. You'll find plenty of quests, caves, and old ruins here.

Fontaine Characters
-------------------

Fontaine isn’t short on interesting people, and many of them will eventually be released as playable characters. Here’s an overview of Fontaine’s characters so far:

*   **Lyney**: a 5-star Pyro character using a bow. Lyney was released in version 4.0, phase one.
*   **Lynette**: a 4-star Anemo character using a sword. Lynette was released in version 4.0, phase one.
*   **Freminet**: a 4-star Cryo character using a Claymore. Freminet was released in version 4.0, phase two. 
*   **Neuvilette**: a 5-star Hydro character using a Catalyst. Neuvilette was added in version 4.1, phase one.
*   **Wriothesley**: a 5-star Cryo character using a Catalyst. Wriothesley arrived in version 4.1, phase 2.
*   **Furina**: a 5-star Hydro character using a sword. Furina was added in version 4.2, phase 1. 
*   **Charlotte**: a 4-star Cryo character using a catalyst. Charlotte was added in version 4.2, phase 1.
*   **Navia**: a 5-star Geo character using a claymore. Navia was added as a playable character in version 4.3, phase 1.
*   **Chevreuse**: a 4-star Pyro character using a polearm. Chevreuse was released in version 4.3, phase 2.

Other upcoming Fontaine characters include Clorinde, an Electro character, and Sigewinne, a Hydro character. Their release dates have not been confirmed.

Fontaine Lore and History
-------------------------

Fontaine is the **Nation of Justice**, a watery land led by **Hydro Archon Focalors** (a.k.a. Furina). She's not one of the original Seven Archons, only taking her place after the original Hydro Archon died. Nonetheless, Fontaine's Archon is incredibly popular - rather than governing her people, however, she seems mostly interested in Fontaine’s **famous opera scene**. No wonder that Fontaine’s most famous building, the Opera Epiclese, is her favorite place to spend time.

While opera and other types of performance arts are a key part of Fontaine’s culture, this region is also home to talented engineers. The **aquabus** transportation system is just one example of Fontaine's technological advancement.

Besides humans, you may spot the fluffy-eared **Melusine** people around Fontaine. There used to be another type of creature in the Nation of Justice, the Hydro-like **Lochfolk**, but it is said that they left because they didn't get along with the new Archon.

Sadly, not all is well in the land of Hydro. An **ancient prophecy** warns that the sea will swallow the sinful people of Fontaine, only allowing the Hydro Archon to survive. While initially regarded as a mere legend, the waters of Fontaine have started to rise, suggesting that the prophecy may be true after all…

Fontaine Quests
---------------

There's a lot going on in Fontaine, both in the form of spectacular Archon Quests and intriguing side stories. Here's an overview of every quest in Fontaine, divided by their type.

### Fontaine Archon Quests

Archon Quest Chapter IV takes place in Fontaine. You need an Adventure Rank of 40 or higher to start these quests:

*    Chapter 4, Act 1: [Prelude of Blancheur and Noirceur](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Chapter_4,_Act_1:_Prelude_of_Blancheur_and_Noirceur)
*    Chapter 4, Act 2: [As Light Rain Falls Without Reason](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Chapter_4,_Act_2:_As_Light_Rain_Falls_Without_Reason)
*    Chapter 4, Act 3: [To the Stars Shining in the Depths](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Chapter_4,_Act_3:_To_the_Stars_Shining_in_the_Depths)
*    Chapter 4, Act 4: [Cataclysm's Quickening](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Chapter_4,_Act_4:_Cataclysm%E2%80%99s_Quickening)
*    Chapter 4, Act 5: Masquerade of the Guilty

### Fontaine World Quests

The Fontaine world quests are optional side quests, indicated by a blue exclamation mark. They often lead to previously locked areas on the map.

*    A Certain Notice

Fontaine Materials
------------------

All that salty water, and yet Fontaine is a fertile place with lots of flowers and fruit trees. However, don't just search the ground for Fontaine materials - you'll have to look underwater as well.

Take a look at our more detailed [Fontaine materials farming guide](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Fontaine_Materials_Farming_Guide) for the best resource locations. If you're just looking for an overview, here you go:

*    Rainbow Rose - local specialty
*    Lumidouce Bell - local specialty
*    Romaritime Flower - local specialty
*    Beryl Conch - local specialty
*    Lumitoile - local specialty
*    Lakelight Lily - local specialty
*    Spring of the First Dewdrop - local specialty
*    Subdetection Unit - local specialty
*    Condessence Crystal - ore
*    Marcotte - cooking material
*    Tidalga - cooking material
*    Pluie Lotus - material
*    Bulle Fruit - food 

Fontaine Shrine of Depths
-------------------------

Unlocking Fontaine's Shrine of Depths is a great way to gather Primogems, Adventure EXP, and a selection of loot. Here's where to find every Shrine in the southern part of Fontaine:

Every Shrine of Depths in the northern part of Fontaine:

Every Shrine of Depths in the eastern part of Fontaine:

And finally, every Shrine of Depths in the Sea of Bygone Eras, a Fontaine sub-region:

For an in-depth description of how to find them, take a look at our [Fontaine Shrine of Depths locations guide](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Fontaine_Shrine_of_Depths_Locations).

Fontaine Bosses
---------------

The first two Fontaine Bosses, Emperor of Fire and Iron and Icewind Suite, are located in the Belleau Region and near the Court of Fontaine. Two additional Fontaine bosses were added in Genshin Impact version 4.1: the Millennial Pearl Seahorse and Experimental Field Generator, both located north of the Court of Fontaine.

*   **Emperor of Fire and Iron** - To find Fontaine's intimidating Emperor boss, you need to swim through an underwater tunnel. The entrance is just west of the nearby Teleport Waypoints. For more info on how to reach this boss, plus helpful tips on how to defeat him, take a look at our [Emperor of Fire and Iron boss guide](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Emperor_of_Fire_and_Iron). 

*   **Icewind Suite** - Teleport to the Fountain of Lucine, in front of the Opera Epiclese, and follow the path to the right. See the two dancing mechs? Those are the bosses, but you need to speak with the nearby NPC, Maillardet, to start the fight. Our [Icewind Suite boss guide](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Icewind_Suite) can help you defeat the dancers. 

*   **Millennial Pearl Seahorse** - This Electro boss and its fishy minions are located in an underwater cave, in the northwestern part of Fontaine (the Liffey Region). To find the boss, follow the nearby underwater gorge (the deepest part of the ocean) towards the north, until you see a cave opening. Swim through this tunnel to find the Millennial Pearl Seahorse. Do you need some tips on how to defeat this Electro boss? Then take a look at our [Millennial Pearl Seahorse boss guide](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Millennial_Pearl_Seahorse).

*   **Experimental Field Generator** - This massive ruin boss is located in the northeastern part of Fontaine, between the Court of Fontaine and the Fontaine Research Institute. You'll find the Experimental Field Generator inside the large circular ruin, a short walk south from the nearby Teleport Waypoint. For more detailed information, including some useful tips on how to defeat this intimidating enemy, take a look at our full [Experimental Field Generator boss guide](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Experimental_Field_Generator). 

*   **Hydro Tulpa** – Fontaine’s monstrous Hydro Tulpa boss may be made from water, but that doesn’t make its slamming attacks less impactful. As you would expect, it’s immune to Hydro damage. To find the Hydro Tulpa Boss location, go to the western part of Fontaine, then look for an underwater tunnel opening in the location shown in the picture. Swim down the tunnel to find the Hydro Tulpa’s boss arena. 

*   **Statue of Marble and Brass** - Also known as the Legatus Golem, this Fontaine boss uses Geo powers to protect itself and Pyro power to deal damage. Upon defeat, it may drop a Fragment of a Golden Memory, which is one of [[1]](https://www.ign.com/wikis/genshin-impact/Genshin_Arlecchino_Ascension_Materials) Arlecchino's Ascension Materials. The Legatus Golem is found in a cave system underneath Petrichor - the small island in the southern sea between Fontaine and Sumeru. This cave is called the "Faded Castle". To unlock it, follow the Petrichor-based world quest named The Shadow Over Petrichor.

Fontaine Domains
----------------

Fontaine has a total of **seven Domains**: five Ascension and Artifact Domains and two Trounce Domains. Here's an overview of how to find the ones in the northern part of Fontaine:

*   **Scattered Ruins** (location 1) - A Trounce Domain home to The Knave boss. You will unlock this Domain by completing Arlecchino's story quest: the Ignis Purgatorius chapter, act 1. You'll need The Knave's Ascension Material drops to level Arlecchino as a playable character.
*   **Echoes of the Deep Tides** (location 2) - A weapon ascension materials Domain. It awards Fragment of an Ancient Chord, Dross of Pure Sacred Dewdrop, and Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea materials. It's located in the hills northwest of the Court of Fontaine.
*   **Pale Forgotten Glory** (location 2) - A talent level-up materials Domain. You can farm Teachings of Equity/Justice/Order here. The Domain is underwater, but not too deep. A short swim will take you there. 
*   **Shadow of Another World** (location 4) - A Trounce Domain home to the All-Devouring Narwhal. You will unlock this Domain by completing the Fontaine-based Archon Quest chapter 4, act 5: Masquerade of the Guilty. The All-Devouring Narwhal drops "Lightless" Ascension materials used by Navia, Chiori, and Charlotte. 

You'll find three more Domains in the southern part of Fontaine:

*   **Waterfall Wen** (location 1) - An artifact Domain that drops Song of Days Past and Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods artifacts. It's in the Belleau Region on the east side of the mountain. 
*   **Denouement of Sin** (location 2) - An artifact Domain that drops Marechaussee Hunter and Golden Troupe artifacts. It's on the island northeast of Romaritime Harbor.
*   **Faded Theater** (location 3) - An artifact Domain that drops Unfinished Reverie and Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy artifacts. It's on the northeast side of Petrichor, the small island in the south.

Fontaine Statues of the Seven
-----------------------------

By collecting Hydroculus around Fontaine, you can upgrade the Statues of the Seven. This will give you the following rewards:

*   **Reach level 2** (requires 20 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 5 Hydro Sigils, 80 Adventure EXP, Fontaine Shrine of Depths Key.
*   **Reach level 3** (requires 22 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 5 Hydro Sigils, 120 Adventure EXP, Memory of Running Stream (constellation upgrade for Hydro Traveler).
*   **Reach level 4** (requires 25 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 5 Hydro Sigils, 160 Adventure EXP, Fontaine Shrine of Depths Key.
*   **Reach level 5** (requires 28 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 10 Hydro Sigils, 200 Adventure EXP, Memory of Running Stream (constellation upgrade for Hydro Traveler).
*   **Reach level 6** (requires 30 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 10 Hydro Sigils, 240 Adventure EXP, Fontaine Shrine of Depths Key.
*   **Reach level 7** (requires 32 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 10 Hydro Sigils, 280 Adventure EXP, Memory of Running Stream (constellation upgrade for Hydro Traveler).
*   **Reach level 8** (requires 35 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 15 Hydro Sigils, 320 Adventure EXP, Fontaine Shrine of Depths Key.
*   **Reach level 9** (requires 38 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 15 Hydro Sigils, 360 Adventure EXP, Fontaine Shrine of Depths Key.
*   **Reach level 10** (requires 40 Hydroculi): 60 Primogems, 15 Hydro Sigils, 400 Adventure EXP, Fontaine Shrine of Depths Key.

There are 271 Hydroculi in the game, 270 of which are enough to reach the highest upgrade level of 10. If you manage to find them all, you'll keep one Hydroculus in your inventory.

Fontaine Reputation System
--------------------------

It's a bit hard to find the Fontaine Reputation System, but don't worry; it's there! You just need to do the **Steambird Interview** world quest, which is unlocked automatically after completing the Archon Quest Chapter 4 Act 2: **As Light Rain Falls Without Reason**.

The Steambird Interview quest is very (very!) short: fast travel to the Court of Fontaine and talk to Euphrasie. That's it! speak to Euphrasie anytime to check your Fontaine Reputation progress.

### In This Guide

![Image 4: Rosaria is shown on screen with the background being a blue grass landscape with mountains behind her. She has a mask in her hands with a light shining behind them. She is wearing a red outfit and red boots](https://kotaku.com/app/uploads/2023/11/a420cd91e2f5f97c18f62d6623954882.jpg)

 Screenshot: Hoyoverse / Kotaku 

The anime-inspired action-RPG _Genshin Impact_ will get a pretty substantial update later this month that introduces two new playable characters, an expanded region to explore, and a couple of formidable bosses waiting to beat the brakes off you.

1/1 Skip Ad Continue watching after the ad![Image 5: Loading Pods](https://kotaku.com/genshin-impact-4-2-release-date-banner-trailer-fontaine-1850990307)Visit Advertiser website[GO TO PAGE](https://kotaku.com/genshin-impact-4-2-release-date-banner-trailer-fontaine-1850990307#)

Dubbed the “Masquerade of the Guilty,” [update 4.2](https://kotaku.com/genshin-impact-4-2-banner-livestream-codes-1850958096) brings the usual assortment of new areas, bosses, and playable characters. The upcoming update will also introduce new events for you to play through and earn rewards from. Here’s everything we know about _Genshin Impact_’s imminent content drop.

_**Genshin Impact**_**4.2 Release Date**
----------------------------------------

Developer Hoyoverse has announced that this latest update will launch on November 8 for mobile (Android and iOS) devices, PC, and PlayStation consoles. Since HoYoverse is based in China, that means players in North America can typically access the new content slightly earlier, at around 11 p.m ET on November 7.

Like the base game, update 4.2 features cross-progression and coop functionality, meaning you can play with your friends and pick up from where you left off on any platform since _Genshin Impact_ is free-to-play. Nice.

_**Genshin Impact**_**4.2 New Areas**
-------------------------------------

Teyvat’s newest region, the France-inspired land of Fontaine, will expand when update 4.2 launches. The watery location will now include two new eastward areas, Erinnyes Forest and Morte Region, that’ve been plagued by bacterial mats. You’ll cleanse these mats with the help of the Xenochromatic Ball Octopus, an aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles**,** as you continue the world quest The Narzissenkreuz Adventure in the Tower of Ipsissimus. You’ll need to defeat a couple of powerful new foes, the All-Devouring Narwhal and The Foul, in order to bring some semblance of order back to a region slowly getting flooded.

_**Genshin Impact**_**4.2 Trailer**
-----------------------------------

Version 4.2 will mark the end of the Fontaine section of _Genshin_’s main story quest, which first kicked off in the 4.0 expansion earlier this year. The Traveler and their companions will face their most daunting challenge yet as they fight to preserve the safety of Fontaine and its people.

Here’s a rundown of what to expect in 4.2, courtesy of HoYoverse:

> “Fontaine is on the brink of destruction in the upcoming Archon Quest. The nation needs all hands on deck, even the Fatui Harbinger, Arlecchino, as the Primordial Seawater which can dissolve all Fontainians comes dangerously close to submerging the nation. The approaching waters are also awakening formidable enemies as well as fearsome monsters.”

You can check out the latest trailer for the latest expansion below:

![Image 6: Character from Genshin Impact stands front in a performance stage, and there is a huge male face on the background](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/1Ip43DfbkUw/hqdefault.jpg)

_**Genshin Impact**_**4.2 Banners**
-----------------------------------

Two new characters will become playable with update 4.2: The Hydro Archon Furina, who joins as a five-star Hydro sword user, and reporter Charlotte, who takes the role as a four-star Cryo-catalyst camera wielder. Furina is more graceful in her combat tactics, using what appears to be an umbrella and bubbles to land strikes with elegance. Charlotte, meanwhile, combines her elemental skills to snap damaging photos while providing healing in the field.

The first three-week banner cycle for 4.2 will start November 8, and offer players the chance to pull characters including Baizhu, Charlotte, Furina, and two other unannounced four-star characters.

Once the first three-week banner cycle wraps, the second one should get underway around November 29. That’s your chance to add the five-star Electro polearm user Cyno, the five-star Hydro sword-wielder Kamisato Ayato, and three other unnamed four-star characters to your roster.

_**Genshin Impact**_**4.2 Events**
----------------------------------

_Genshin Impact_ update 4.2 will also include several limited-time events, likeThelxie’s Fantastic Adventures, a collect-a-thon to upgrade the clockwork penguin, and Lil’ Fungi’s Fun-Tastic Fiesta, which lets you train and command fungi to take down powerful enemies. These events can reward you with some leveling materials, EXP books, Mora, and more rewards.

Genshin Impact's new Fontaine map looks absolutely huge
=======================================================

Genshin Impact 4.0 is about two weeks away, and once it goes live, we'll get a chance to see the largest underwater area in all of Teyvat thus far.

![Image 2: Genshin Impact Fontaine underwater map seems absolutely massive: anime boy sinking in water](https://www.pcgamesn.com/wp-content/sites/pcgamesn/2023/07/Genshin-Impact-4.0-Freminet-Underwater-550x309.jpg)

![Image 3: PCGamesN](https://www.pcgamesn.com/wp-content/themes/pcgamesn/dist/images/default_avatar.png)

[Ethan Anderson](https://www.pcgamesn.com/author/ethan-anderson)

Published: Aug 1, 2023

[Genshin Impact](https://www.pcgamesn.com/genshin-impact) 

**Genshin Impact** version 4.0 will bring a whole new region along with new ways of traversing the environment. It's no secret that Fontaine will bring underwater sections to the [anime game](https://www.pcgamesn.com/best-anime-games-pc), as they've been teased for some time now. But thanks to a recent leak, we're able to get an early look at just how large [Genshin Impact](https://www.pcgamesn.com/genshin-impact)'s new deep-sea areas actually are.

Fontaine's underwater exploration was first teased before the launch of Genshin Impact version 3.8, so we knew it was coming, but didn't know how big a part it would play in gameplay. Judging by the map size, it seems as though we'll be spending plenty of time submerged beneath the nation of Hydro.

The underwater section looks like it takes up the equivalent of about half of Fontaine's main map. Thank goodness HoYoverse finally decided to add in-game [underground mapping](https://www.pcgamesn.com/genshin-impact/sumeru-underground-map) because huge portions of Sumeru and Inazuma have been confusing to navigate for a long time.

The underwater map image comes from a leaker named '[babey](https://twitter.com/babeykun9/status/1685530338565709824?s=20)' on Twitter, so you can visit their profile to have a look for yourself. At a glance, Fontaine doesn't look to be a large nation, but with the underwater map, its size becomes a bit more daunting.

It's still unclear how the underwater gameplay will work in terms of potential oxygen supply limitations or movement, but HoYoverse will undoubtedly provide more details during [Genshin Impact version 4.0](https://www.pcgamesn.com/genshin-impact/4-0-release-date) special stream.

![Image 4: YouTube Thumbnail](https://img.youtube.com/vi/9SbgmM3mSps/sddefault.jpg)

Genshin Impact version 3.8 still has about two weeks to go, so we won't get to see what Fontaine has in store just yet. For now, you can still pull for Kokomi and the Wanderer on their rerun banners.

If you'd like some tips for your wishes, you can check out our [Genshin Impact tier list](https://www.pcgamesn.com/genshin-impact/tier-list-characters) after redeeming the available [Genshin Impact codes](https://www.pcgamesn.com/genshin-impact/codes-redeem-promo) to earn a few extra Primogems.

[Ethan Anderson](https://www.pcgamesn.com/author/ethan-anderson) Ethan is a Contributor for PCGamesN who focuses on news coverage. He can’t seem to stop playing [Genshin Impact](https://www.pcgamesn.com/genshin-impact), [Honkai Star Rail](https://www.pcgamesn.com/honkai-star-rail), and [Apex Legends](https://www.pcgamesn.com/apex-legends), so that’s what you’ll find him happily writing about most. He’s currently a freelancer with words at IGN and GameSpot, where he covers more of the same, along with the newest [RPG games](https://www.pcgamesn.com/15-best-rpgs-pc). He’s also a lover of all things Zelda, Tales, or Dragon Age-related. Don’t get him started on Inquisition because he’ll never stop singing its praises. When he’s not focused on the endless gacha game grind, you’ll find him impatiently waiting on sequels for each of the series listed above.

Genshin Impact has some of the best-written gods in the history of RPGs
=======================================================================

[Features](https://www.gamesradar.com/uk/features/)

By [Austin Wood](https://www.gamesradar.com/uk/author/austin-wood/) published 18 November 2023

Opinion | The Genshin Impact 4.2 Fontaine Archon quest delivers one of the best game stories of the year
